raw.description:
Red Nucleus is hiring a Medical Writer to join our global team! This is a remote role based out of the US.

Our purpose is advancing knowledge to improve lives. We succeed by being the premier provider of strategic learning and development, scientific advisory services, and medical communications solutions for the life sciences industry. Our global team is composed of nearly 1000 full-time employees whose commitment to creativity, quality, and on-time delivery is unrivaled in our space.

At Red Nucleus, we believe in providing a rich working environment that pushes us to innovate in ways that engages our employees to be their best selves. Our culture is about meaningful work, a true sense of community, and fun. We love to celebrate our people and we are proud to have been Internationally recognized as a “Great Place to Work".

How You Will Contribute

In this position, you will be working with our Medical Communications team. For more information about our team, please visit MedComms | Red Nucleus.

As aMedical Writerat Red Nucleus, your responsibilities will include researching, writing, and editing manuscripts, abstracts, slide presentations, posters, and other deliverables. We offer unique opportunities to collaborate on client projects that are highly visible and are engaged in inspiring pharmaceutical products and technologies within the medical field. As a valued team member, you will be a part of an organization that will provide you with the support, resources, and flexibility you need to succeed.

  • Understanding and familiarity with most current AMA style
  • Ability to understand and properly determine accuracy of scientific information and data in a variety of biological fields
  • Clearly communicates with team members to achieve goals regarding content development
  • Delivers work by designated deadline and understands the project development process
  • Works well in a team environment (onsite and remote)
  • Appreciates the appropriate time to ask for supervisor assistance
  • Understands various aspects of preclinical and clinical drug development
  • Exhibits knowledge of the components of a well-written piece of communication, across a range of deliverables
  • Ensures all versions of a deliverable are saved to the team file according to standardized file naming criteria
  • Reviews study data and distills into thorough and well-written deliverables
  • Displays working knowledge of good publication practices
  • Works with internal team in a respectful and productive manner

About You

  • MD, PhD in the life sciences, or PharmD required
  • Prior experience writing peer-reviewed publications, congress abstracts, posters, and slide decks
  • Ability to independently write and edit scientific manuscripts, abstracts, posters, and training materials
  • Excellent verbal communication skills and ability to effectively collaborate in a virtual setting
  • Outstanding organizational/time management skills and ability to meet deadlines
  • Understanding of the AMA writing style
  • Team player with a detail-oriented work ethic

What You Will Enjoy at Red Nucleus

  • Competitive pay, incentives, retirement, and income security programs
  • Comprehensive benefits and wellness programs focused on healthy lifestyles
  • Generous paid time off, employee assistance programs, and flexible work arrangements
  • Performance-driven environment including professional development and transfer opportunities
  • People-first culture fostering self expression, diversity, and a growth mindset
  • Celebrations! We love to celebrate service anniversaries, holidays, diversity and inclusion events, project milestones, and anything else that is meaningful to our employees
  • Support of the community organizations you are passionate about
  • Ongoing programs and events designed to bring our global team together

Diversity, equity and inclusion are valued at Red Nucleus and we believe we have a shared responsibility to provide equal opportunity and foster an inclusive spirit. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, national origin, religion, caste, sexual orientation, gender, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

To learn more about working at Red Nucleus, please visit Careers | Red Nucleus.

raw.description:
Job Description:

We are looking for a Part-Time Virtual Clinical Trial Navigator (Medical Doctor) based in the Philippines to provide one-on-one support to patients and families navigating the clinical trial process. This role requires strong medical knowledge, patient advocacy, and coordination skills, as well as experience in clinical research, patient education, or healthcare navigation. The ideal candidate will assist patients in understanding clinical trials, finding suitable studies, answering questions, and facilitating communication between research teams and participants.

This is a remote, part-time position with the opportunity to transition to full-time. Candidates must be willing to work overlapping hours with USA time zones.

Key Responsibilities:

    • Provide personalized guidance to patients and families considering clinical trials.
    • Assist in trial searches, helping patients identify suitable studies based on their diagnosis, medical history, and location.
    • Answer questions regarding trial participation, including eligibility, safety, travel, expenses, and potential risks.
    • Identify primary point of contact for clinical trial enrollment at various locations.
    • Facilitate communication between patients and research teams, ensuring a smooth connection with study coordinators.
    • Offer patient education and resources to help participants understand the trial process and make informed decisions.
    • Advocate for patients’ needs, ensuring they receive the best possible support throughout the clinical trial journey.
    • Overtime transitions more of a management role as the team of Trial Navigators grows.

Qualifications:

  • Must be a Licensed Medical Doctor (MD) based in the Philippines.

  • Clinical experience in patient care, oncology, research, or trial navigation is highly preferred.

  • Strong understanding of clinical trials, research protocols, and eligibility criteria.

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to provide medical guidance to patients and families.

  • Experience in clinical research, patient advocacy, or case management is a plus.

  • Familiarity with HIPAA regulations and patient confidentiality standards.

  • Ability to work remotely, with a stable internet connection and professional setup.

  • Availability to work part-time with overlapping hours in USA time zones.

raw.description:
About The Company:

Prismfly is a global agency focused on ecommerce conversion rate optimization and lifecycle marketing. We pair strategy with best-in-class design and development to create leading digital experiences. We work with top-tier brands and software partners. The team is made of humble experts, each with a strong desire to continually learn and grow.

Our culture is remote-first and we connect daily on Slack and video chat. Being part of a boutique, fast-growing company is exciting. The opportunities to grow and take ownership are endless. We make sure you have everything you need to do your best work and make a big impact.

Come join our fast-growing team! We are looking for a sharp, self-motivated Content Coordinator to own and evolve our content and social media presence. This role will collaborate lightly with our team for input, but take ownership from concept to publication.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Write engaging, well-structured social copy in fluent English
  • Clip, edit, and publish short-form video from existing material (e.g., using Klap or similar tools)
  • Create simple graphics using Figma
  • Research, test, and manage scheduling tools (e.g., AuthorUp)
  • Use UTM parameters to track social links and report on website traffic driven
  • Monitor content performance across platforms to refine strategy and increase engagement
  • Assist in writing intro/outro scripts and branding for recurring content series
  • You’ll be provided with rough ideas, outlines, or raw material - your role is to turn those into polished posts, clips, or visuals ready for review and scheduling. Over time, you’ll also be expected to bring original ideas based on your learnings, research, and what’s happening in the market.
  • Maintain a consistent posting cadence (approx. ~3-5 LinkedIn, ~2-3 TikToks/Youtube clips per week)

IDEAL CANDIDATE

  • Fluent written and spoken English
  • Proficient in use of AI tooling
  • Social media savvy; knows what makes content resonate on each platform
  • Self-starter with strong opinions and openness to feedback
  • Critical thinker with a bias toward action (e.g., you want to get going and avoid overthinking) and ownership (e.g., you care about your work)
  • Basic video editing and visual design skills
  • Positive, hungry to learn, and able to work 40 hours / week

REQUIRED TOOLS:

  • Riverside
  • Opus
  • Figmabuzz

COMPENSATION:

  • Based on experience and region
  • Remote role

raw.description:
Manifold a division of Lyft, whose purpose is to serve and connect. Together, we’re committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels they belong and has the opportunity to thrive.

Manifold produces world-class, award-winning experiences globally. From small pop-up activations to complex, multi-faceted largescale conferences, production is a core element of bringing visions to life. We feel strongly about creating true and lasting partnerships with our clients. In partnership with our Account, Creative and Operations teams, our goal is to collaborate closely with our clients throughout the lifecycle of an engagement, often creating a relationship that feels like we are an extension of their team.

As Creative Project Manager at Manifold, you oversee the end-to-end lifecycle of creative initiatives—from initial concept and design approval through print production and install.

You own the workback schedules, trackers, and status reporting that give every team a clear view of what's due and when and you coordinate design work so the right requests reach the right people at the right time. You're the steady hand that flags risks early and protects the creative team's focus, so the work ships on time and on standard.

Responsibilities:

  • Own the master workback schedules (internal and client-facing) pulling key dates and deliverables from source materials like briefs, RFI packets, and contracts, and keeping them aligned across teams.
  • Work closely with design counterparts to ensure their deadlines and deliverables are clear and achieved.
  • Keep all deadlines accurate and current across internal and client workback documents as timelines shift.
  • Maintain a centralized tracker and dashboard with deliverables, deadlines, documentation links, and status updates as the single source of truth for project health.
  • Drive internal accountability through regular communications, including weekly status reports, and keep timelines current in status meetings.
  • Keep the Creative Director and Creative Services Manager informed on overall project health.
  • Coordinate and manage all design requests from Account and Production, prioritizing by timeline and urgency.
  • Communicate regularly with Account and Production on deliverable status and progress.
  • Partner with Producers and Creative to identify upcoming deliverables, proactively flagging risks or blockers to the Creative and Account Director.
  • Partner with the Creative Services Manager and Creative Director on resourcing by monitoring team bandwidth and availability.
  • Track project scope and hours against plan, flagging potential overages early to the Creative Service Manager.

Experience:

  • 3+ years of project management or creative operations experience in an agency, studio, or in-house creative team.
  • A proactive ability to, “follow the crumbs” if answers don’t immediately seem clear.
  • Demonstrated strength with detailed record keeping for multiple concurrent projects.
  • Strong command of workback schedules and deadlines.
  • Confidence coordinating creative work and communicating status clearly across Creative, Account, and Production.
  • Sharp organizational judgment, you spot risks and blockers before they become problems.
  • A collaborative, low-ego style and calm under shifting priorities.
  • The ability to wear a lot of hats and support as each workstream needs.
  • (Preferred) Industry Experience: Prior work history within a top-tier creative agency or in-house marketing team.
  • (Preferred) Hands-on experience managing fabrication and print production within creative projects..

Benefits:

  • Great medical, dental, and vision insurance options with additional programs available when enrolled
  • Mental health benefits
  • Family building benefits
  • Child care and pet benefits
  • 401(k) plan with company match to help save for your future
  • In addition to 12 observed holidays, salaried team members have discretionary paid time off, hourly team members have 15 days paid time off
  • 18 weeks of paid parental leave. Biological, adoptive, and foster parents are all eligible
  • Subsidized commuter benefits
  • Monthly Lyft credits and complimentary Lyft Pink membership

Lyft is an equal opportunity employer committed to an inclusive workplace that fosters belonging. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regards to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, age, genetic information, or any other basis prohibited by law. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.

This role is fully remote in the United States, candidates for this role must be based in the United States area. #Remote

The expected base pay range for this position in the United States is $59,040 - $90,000, not inclusive of potential equity offering, bonus or benefits. Salary ranges are dependent on a variety of factors, including qualifications, experience and geographic location. Your recruiter can share more information about the salary range specific to your working location and other factors during the hiring process.

raw.description:
This is an FTC from the 1st November 2026 to mid-January 2027 | UK-based

About Greenpark

Greenpark is a global, award-winning digital agency specialising in omnichannel search and social. Our raison d’etre is to create amazing content that people and algorithms love. How? Through data-led and performance-driven search and social content to help brands create meaningful connections that impact people's lives. Our unique expertise in Omnichannel Search & Insights, Creative Content and Performance Tech are delivered to our clients via an ad agency and in-house models. We do this for a global client portfolio including Unilever, Campari Group, AIA, Sanofi, Nestle, Lipton, Kimberley Clark, Straumann, Ricola, Globe Telecom, and more.

Want the real inside scoop? Our Playbook gives you a peek into how we work, collaborate, and get things done at Greenpark. Check it out here

Our Values

As a company, we strive and act together in our ambition to make a positive impact for the people and brands we serve, we do everything with kindness and respect at the core. ‘We Strive’, ‘Acting Together’, ‘With Kindness’ are the values that guide us.

About the role

As a Service Design Lead – AI-Enabled Operations, you will lead the discovery phase of a content studio transformation, steering the work from the first stakeholder interview through to a clear, evidence-based case for change. Your insight will also shape a wider operational redesign workstream, helping the team embed AI in a way that is practical, responsible and built to last.

This is an in-house role within Greenpark, dedicated exclusively to supporting our pharmaceutical client. You will be fully embedded within the client team, working solely on their projects. This means you’ll collaborate closely with their teams, gain deep exposure to a global brand, and operate as an integrated part of their day-to-day organisation.

What you’ll do

  • Lead the discovery phase end to end, setting the approach, plan and priorities.
  • Plan and run all stakeholder interviews and workshops.
  • Map current-state processes, identifying pain points and opportunities for automation and AI.
  • Define future-state workflows and the operating model behind them, covering roles, responsibilities and governance.
  • Turn research, data and stakeholder input into clear insights, recommendations and priorities.
  • Build the business case for AI adoption and a phased transition roadmap, covering efficiency gains, sequencing, dependencies and risk.
  • Produce client-ready deliverables such as discovery reports, process maps, roadmaps and presentations.
  • Prototype or pilot new workflows, iterating on user feedback, and bring stakeholders with you through adoption.

About you

  • 7+ years in business consultancy, creative/content organisation design or senior UX research, ideally in a client-facing or agency setting.
  • Hands-on discovery experience: current-state mapping, pain-point and automation analysis, and future-state workflow design.
  • A track record of evidence-based recommendations, phased roadmaps and business cases for transitioning business models.
  • Experience defining and steering a new positioning for a business or service, and leading interviews and workshops at all levels.
  • Solid understanding of AI and working knowledge of a breadth of tools (LLM assistants such as Claude, ChatGPT and Copilot, automation platforms, AI features in productivity suites), with a realistic view of what each can and can’t do.
  • Understanding of how to embed AI into operating models (process redesign, roles, governance and change management, not just tool selection), with awareness of responsible AI and human-in-the-loop design.
  • Strong facilitation and communication skills, translating between technical and non-technical audiences.
  • A structured, analytical, change-oriented thinker who is comfortable with ambiguity early in discovery.
  • Based in the UK
  • You live & breathe Greenpark’s core values ‘We Strive’, ‘Acting Together’, ‘With Kindness’-
    championing openness, respect, innovation, and teamwork - so that every interaction, both internally and externally, reflects our commitment to our values.

At Greenpark, we believe the best ideas come from the widest range of perspectives. We welcome and celebrate every background, identity, and experience across our global workforce. By fostering a culture of respect, inclusivity, and collaboration, we’re committed to ensuring everyone’s voice is heard and everyone can thrive.

All applications shall be considered for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, neurodivergence, disability status or any other protected characteristics.

Would you like to be part of a team building a future to smile? What about having the opportunity to collaborate with teams across the world, full of stimulating discussions and making impactful contributions?

If this is how you see your career, Folks, Mumbai is the place to be!

Folks Mumbai is seeking talented Look Development Artists to join our creative team across all levels!

From the very beginning, we have been passionate about capturing the imagination. Based in Montreal, Toronto, Bogotá, Saguenay and now in Mumbai the artists who bring their rich and diverse experiences to our team have been making larger-than-life visual effects for film and television for the past 10 years.

Position Overview

You will be required to quickly create photorealistic textures and shaders for a wide range of assets including props, characters and environments, for a number of live action projects. Applicants presenting photo realistic work will be reviewed with priority.

Your previously held positions are likely to have included texture artist, look development artist, 3d generalist etc. You have previously textured and shaded an extensive range of models from props, characters, urban and city environments through to complex terrain, all with great speed and accuracy.

Your excellent communication and collaboration skills are highly regarded by your previous supervisors. You provide confidence to production because you have absolute clarity in what is expected of you in terms of consistency and quality.

Responsibilities


  • Create and deliver textures and shaders that meet the artistic brief.

  • Ensure every asset you create meets the requirements of those downstream.

  • Work with modellers, lighters and other texture and shading artists to produce consistent and accurate work.

  • Regularly demonstrate your work in progress.

  • Step into a lead position and lead other look dev artists and/or sequences as required.

  • Review your work prior to submission, ensuring it hits creative and technical notes, adjusting where necessary.

  • Demonstrate a strong understanding of shading principles and shader language.

  • Strong understanding of colour/bit depth/resolution and how they affect the texturing process.

  • Follow creative & technical briefs with regard to the production schedule.

  • Take ownerships of all notes and feedback relating to your shots.

  • Actively mentor and develop less experienced team members.

  • Promote a collaborative and enjoyable workplace influencing morale, fostering purposeful discussion and positive work ethic.

    • Required Skills and Experience


    • Minimum 4 years professional look dev / texturing / shading experience in VFX, working on live-action feature films.

    • Expert user of production ready software including Substance Painter, Maya, Mari, Z-Brush & Mudbox.

    • Some exposure to Nuke & Houdini is desirable, but not essential.

    • Ability to look dev from start to finish, that can be executed across many shots.

    • Real world understanding of proportion, depth, scale, and physical space.

    • Expert organisational and time-management skills.

    • Technical and creative problem solving with a can-do mindset.

    • Maintain a calm and professional demeanour in a delivery focused work environment.

The Company prohibits discrimination in employment against otherwise qualified applicants because of a physical or mental disability and will make reasonable accommodations to enable qualified persons with known disabilities to perform the essential functions of their job consistent with applicable law. The Company will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable law.

Are you looking for the next professional opportunity, that will challenge you and advance your career? Join our team now!

About Tickmill.

Tickmill is an award-winning, multi-regulated broker offering access to a broad range of asset classes, including CFDs on Forex, Stocks, Indices, Commodities, Cryptocurrencies, and Bonds, as well as Exchange Traded Derivatives like Futures & Options).

Founded in 2014, the Tickmill Group employs over 330 professionals across offices in London, Cyprus, Poland, Estonia, Seychelles and several other locations worldwide. 

Our culture is built on trust, transparency, and high standards.  We bring together ambitious professionals who are looking for an environment that supports them to dominate in their fields.  

Our diverse, multilingual teams are focused on innovation, delivering bold excellence, and raising the bar wherever we can. 

We offer competitive benefits packages, frequent team initiatives, and opportunities for professional growth. 

Join the Tigers!

About the role:

As the Chinese Head of Partnership , you will be responsible for leading and growing Tickmill's partnership business across the Chinese markets. You will develop and execute strategic partnership initiatives, manage and mentor a high-performing team of Business Development Managers (BDMs), and drive sustainable client acquisition through Introducing Brokers (IBs), affiliates, institutional partners, and strategic alliances.

You will be accountable for achieving regional revenue and net deposit targets while ensuring the team delivers an exceptional partner experience throughout the entire lifecycle—from acquisition and onboarding to retention and long-term growth.

Working closely with Marketing, Product, Operations, Compliance, Client Services, and senior management, you will identify market opportunities, influence product development based on partner feedback, and ensure our offerings remain highly competitive within the Chinese market.

What does the role look like?

  • Recruit, lead, coach, and develop a team of Business Development Managers to consistently achieve business objectives and KPIs.
  • Develop and execute the regional partnership strategy to drive client acquisition, trading volume, and net deposits.
  • Identify, recruit, and manage high-value Introducing Brokers (IBs), affiliates, institutional clients, and strategic partners.
  • Build long-term relationships with key partners by understanding their business needs and delivering tailored commercial solutions.
  • Analyse market trends, competitor activities, and client feedback to identify new business opportunities and improve our competitive positioning.
  • Work closely with Marketing to plan and execute regional campaigns, seminars, webinars, and partner engagement initiatives.
  • Collaborate with Product and Operations teams to enhance the client and partner experience through continuous product and process improvements.
  • Monitor team performance, pipeline health, and regional KPIs, providing regular reports, forecasts, and strategic recommendations to senior management.
  • Ensure all partnership activities comply with internal policies, regulatory requirements, and company standards.
  • Foster a high-performance, collaborative culture focused on accountability, continuous improvement, and commercial excellence.

What do you need to succeed in this role?

  • Proven experience leading Partnership teams within the online trading, CFD, Forex, or financial services industry in Chinese market.
  • Strong understanding of the Chinese market, including IB business models, competitors, client acquisition channels, and regional market dynamics.
  • Demonstrated track record of consistently delivering commercial growth, including client acquisition, net deposits, revenue, and trading volume.
  • Excellent leadership and people management skills with the ability to motivate, coach, and develop high-performing teams.
  • Strong negotiation, relationship management, and stakeholder engagement skills.
  • Commercially driven with excellent analytical and strategic thinking abilities.
  • Experience working cross-functionally with Marketing, Product, Operations, Compliance, and Client Services teams.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and make sound business decisions in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent presentation, communication, and interpersonal skills.
  • Native or professional proficiency in Mandarin Chinese and strong communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • Proficiency with CRM systems, business intelligence tools, and Microsoft Office applications.
  • Willingness to travel within the region as business needs require.

Will be considered as a plus:

  • An established network of Introducing Brokers, affiliates, KOLs, or institutional partners within the Chinese market.
  • Experience developing regional partnership strategies from the ground up.
  • Strong understanding of digital marketing, performance marketing, and lead generation strategies.
  • Experience launching new partnership initiatives, incentive programmes, or regional campaigns that delivered measurable business growth.
  • A passion for mentoring people and building high-performing BDM teams.

US-based Independent Contractor Veterinarian with Vetster

Location: Remote in Vermont

About Vetster

Vetster is revolutionizing pet healthcare by connecting pet owners with licensed veterinarians through our innovative digital platform. We provide convenient access to professional veterinary advice, diagnoses, and prescriptions, with a mission to make pet care accessible, affordable, and stress-free for every pet parent.

Join our Mission

Vetster is seeking Veterinarians licensed and in good standing in Vermont to join our platform and provide virtual care on the side. This is an exciting opportunity to join our platform and a growing network of veterinarians at the forefront of telemedicine. As a flexible, independent contractor, you’ll have the freedom to create your own schedule and work as much or as little as you’d like.

Experience with exotic species (small mammals, birds, reptiles, amphibians, invertebrates) is a strong asset and a plus, helping us service our public partnership with PetSmart, but all levels are welcome, including vets who primarily see cats and dogs.

What You’ll Do:

As a Veterinarian licensed in Vermont, you will:

  • Conduct virtual video appointments with pet owners through the Vetster platform
  • Provide thorough clinical assessments, triage guidance, and treatment recommendations within your scope of practice and applicable regulations
  • Complete accurate and timely medical records for each appointment within the platform
  • Deliver an exceptional client experience — communicating clearly, compassionately, and professionally
  • Adhere to Vetster's standards of care and platform policies
  • Maintain compliance with your provincial licensing requirements

You're paid per appointment with additional supplementary earnings programs designed to reflect the flexible, on-your-own-schedule nature of the work.

What You Bring:

  • You are a DVM/VMD licensed to practice veterinary medicine in the US in good standing, within the highlighted state
    • Bonus points if you are licensed in multiple states.
  • You have experience treating some or all of the following exotic species: guinea pigs, hamsters, mice, rabbits, lizards, turtles, snakes, tarantulas, scorpions, crabs, and birds
  • You are passionate about Telemedicine with a genuine belief in the power of digital health to expand access to care

Ready to Make a Difference?

Embark on a fulfilling journey with us and shape the future of pet healthcare through design. If you're driven by innovation, collaboration, and a love for pets, we’d love to connect.

Ready to get started?

Setting up your account is quick and free, and it's the best way to learn more about the platform and explore the opportunity. Once you sign up, our team will be in touch to help you get going.

Red Nucleus is hiring a Medical Writer to join our global team!

The role can be based in the US, Canada, or the UK.

Our purpose is advancing knowledge to improve lives. We succeed by being the premier provider of strategic learning and development, scientific advisory services, and medical communications solutions for the life sciences industry. Our global team is composed of nearly 1000 full-time employees whose commitment to creativity, quality, and on-time delivery is unrivaled in our space.

At Red Nucleus, we believe in providing a rich working environment that pushes us to innovate in ways that engages our employees to be their best selves. Our culture is about meaningful work, a true sense of community, and fun. We love to celebrate our people and we are proud to have been Internationally recognized as a “Great Place to Work".

How You Will Contribute

In this position, you will be working with our Medical Communications team. For more information about our team, please visit MedComms | Red Nucleus.

The Medical Writer is responsible for the development, scientific integrity, and accuracy of medical content for pharmaceutical and medical device clients. This role serves as the lead medical writer for assigned clients, brands, or therapeutic areas and contributes to additional projects as required.

The position oversees the research, development, updating, and editing of medical materials, ensuring that all content aligns with regulatory, compliance, and client standards across medical affairs and commercial initiatives. The Medical Writer participates in client interactions and collaborates with cross-functional teams to execute deliverables efficiently and to quality expectations.

The role may support strategic initiatives, including congress activities, advisory boards, workshops, and other client engagements, with appropriate senior oversight. In addition to content development responsibilities, the Medical Writer manages workload priorities, supports mentorship and training of junior team members, and maintains accountability for timely and accurate completion of assigned projects.

Responsibilities

  • Perform medical literature research and data analysis, to support project pitch development, new content development and regulatory review/approval. Develop medical and scientific copy, highlighting/tagging references as required for all sales and client driven initiatives.
  • Support project pitch development and delivery by providing medical and scientific expertise to client engagement teams
  • Provide medical and scientific support during client meetings, workshops, and advisory board meetings; These meetings may occur virtually or in person
  • Edit copy to correct errors of spelling, grammar and punctuation, ensure stylistic consistency, enhance readability, and ensure copy meets branding and referencing requirements
  • Work within copy deck formats that appropriately record changes, style decisions, source materials, and referencing requirements
  • Prepare and submit content for medical legal regulatory review in client submission/referencing systems
  • Participate in client calls/correspondence relating to content approval; record and clarify all content change requests and ensure relevant information is shared with other production team members
  • Collaborate with Design to ensure visuals are scientifically accurate and align with client preference/style guide and regulatory guidelines
  • Collaborate with Animation to write and review scripts, review storyboards and video output
  • Collaborate with the User Experience team to establish organization and flow of content; Review IA/wires/functional spec documents for scientific accuracy
  • Collaborate with editorial team members to ensure alignment with client branding and ensure accuracy of spelling, punctuation and grammar
  • Conduct end-to-end validation of the content of projects, reporting and resolving issues with relevant team members including the project manager and/or account management personnel
  • Assist with the creation of budget estimates for new/revised projects
  • Participate in the development, implementation and control of editorial standards and workflow optimization
  • Educate team members on scientific constructs, as needed, to ensure understanding and alignment on content development
  • Ensure alignment with other team members and clients on deliverables
  • Oversee communication with team members in Pune who support with regulatory submissions and scientific accuracy
  • Navigate daily tasks and support Project Managers to address resourcing challenges

Education

  • Advanced degree in life sciences (MSc, PhD, PharmD, or MD)

Experience

  • Minimum 2 years of relevant medical information, communications or marketing writing experience (agency, pharmaceutical or independent)

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Understanding of clinical research, the drug development process, and applicable regulatory guidelines.
  • Exemplary written, verbal, analytical, and editing skills.
  • Experience with presenting and interacting with medical and scientific experts, utilizing problem-solving skills.
  • Detail-oriented and highly organized individual.
  • Naturally inquisitive and attentive individual, who is able to ask and answer enquiring questions.
  • Enjoys challenge of interweaving multiple tasks within a deadline-oriented, fast-paced environment.
  • Team player with good interpersonal skills.
  • Previous experience working with health care clients in an agency setting
  • Prior experience in digital media, web applications or new technology

Physical Demands

  • Prolonged sitting at a desk or workstation while using a computer, attending virtual meetings, and performing job duties.
  • Repetitive hand and finger motions for typing, data entry, and use of standard office equipment (keyboard, mouse, phone).
  • Ability to lift and carry light items (generally up to 10–15 pounds), such as a laptop, files, or small office supplies.
  • Ability to maintain a safe and ergonomically appropriate home workspace in compliance with company guidelines.

Work Environment

  • Duties are performed primarily in a home‑based office or office environment.
  • The workspace should be free from excessive noise or distractions to support meetings and productivity.
  • Standard office equipment: Work is performed using typical office tools such as a computer, phone, printer, and other peripherals.
  • Prolonged screen exposure: Regular use of computer and video conferencing platforms.
  • Virtual collaboration: Frequent interaction with team members, clients, or stakeholders via email, messaging platforms, and video conferencing.
  • Standard Company work hours are Monday through Friday, 8:30am to 5:30pm EST.
  • This role may require occasional travel for team meetings or company events.

We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, national origin, religion, caste, sexual orientation, gender, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

POSITION:

As a Consultant, you will:

  • Own meaningful pieces of the work: lead defined analyses and project workstreams across research, data analysis, financial modeling, and pricing and market access topics.
  • Translate evidence into recommendations: turn data, research, and market insights into clear client-ready deliverables that support strategic decision-making.

Grow as a consultant and market access expert: deepen your expertise in pricing, reimbursement, access, and life sciences while contributing to proposals, knowledge assets, and a collaborative team culture.

WHY US

  • Join a team at the heart of global market access. Become part of NAVLIN's Global Pricing & Market Access (GMAP) team, a dynamic, international group that pairs deep in-house expertise with real-time intelligence on pricing, HTA, and regulatory developments through our industry-benchmark platform.
  • Work with tools that set the standard. Put advanced price-management software, launch-sequence simulation, and a fast-growing set of AI-enabled capabilities to work, turning complex data into strategic, well-grounded recommendations for our clients.
  • Lead work that shapes how therapies reach patients. Own high-stakes initiatives across Europe, APAC, and LATAM: launch sequencing and pricing for ATMPs and orphan drugs, indication-expansion planning, LOE strategy, forecasting, and asset due diligence.
  • Grow with a multicultural team that's expanding fast. Work alongside top talent from across Europe, blending local market nuance with real collaboration, in a team that grows year on year.
  • Enjoy flexible working, done properly. Do your best work remotely or from our satellite offices in London, Berlin, and Milan, all open to everyone and fully backed by robust IT.

KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS REQUIRED:

  • 2–3 years of relevant professional experience in Market Access & Pricing, management consulting, or a highly analytical pharma role.
  • Strong analytical and quantitative foundation, with the ability to structure complex problems and turn evidence into clear business implications.
  • Genuine ambition to grow into a Global Market Access & Pricing expert, building on either local market expertise or broader global exposure.
  • Clear career trajectory, with experiences showing increasing responsibility, learning agility, and potential to create value for clients.
  • Fluency in English.
  • Global and local MA&P experience (e.g. Spain), US market exposure, or a PhD/equivalent degree would be a plus
  • Curiosity about AI-enabled and proprietary analytical tool and confidence with Excel and PowerPoint

OUR CULTURAL BELIEFS:

Patient Minded I act with the patient’s best interest in mind.

Client Delight I own every client experience and its impact on results.

Take Action I am empowered and empower others to act now.

Grow Talent I own my development and invest in the development of others. 

Win Together I passionately connect with anyone, anywhere, anytime to achieve results.

Communication Matters I speak up to create transparent, thoughtful and timely dialogue.

Embrace Diversity I create an environment of awareness and respect.

Always Innovate I am bold and creative in everything I do.

Our team is aware of recent fraudulent job offers in the market, misrepresenting EVERSANA. Recruitment fraud is a sophisticated scam commonly perpetrated through online services using fake websites, unsolicited e-mails, or even text messages claiming to be a legitimate company. Some of these scams request personal information and even payment for training or job application fees. Please know EVERSANA would never require personal information nor payment of any kind during the employment process. We respect the personal rights of all candidates looking to explore careers at EVERSANA.

From EVERSANA’s inception, Diversity, Equity & Inclusion have always been key to our success. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer, and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, and backgrounds who share a passion for improving the lives of patients and leading innovation within the healthcare industry. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion, and many other parts of one’s identity. All of our employees’ points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility.

Follow us on LinkedIn | Twitter

At EVERSANA, we are proud to be certified as a Great Place to Work across the globe. We’re fueled by our vision to create a healthier world. How? Our global team of more than 7,000 employees is committed to creating and delivering next-generation commercialization services to the life sciences industry. We are grounded in our cultural beliefs and serve more than 650 clients ranging from innovative biotech start-ups to established pharmaceutical companies. Our products, services and solutions help bring innovative therapies to market and support the patients who depend on them. Our jobs, skills and talents are unique, but together we make an impact every day. Join us!

Across our growing organization, we embrace diversity in backgrounds and experiences. Improving patient lives around the world is a priority, and we need people from all backgrounds and swaths of life to help build the future of the healthcare and the life sciences industry. We believe our people make all the difference in cultivating an inclusive culture that embraces our cultural beliefs. We are deliberate and self-reflective about the kind of team and culture we are building. We look for team members that are not only strong in their own aptitudes but also who care deeply about EVERSANA, our people, clients and most importantly, the patients we serve. We are EVERSANA.

Join Vonage and help us innovate cloud communications for businesses worldwide!

About Vonage

Vonage is the emerging leader in the $100B+ cloud communications platform (CPaaS) market. Customers like Airbnb, Viber, WhatsApp, Snapchat, and many others depend on our APIs and SDKs to connect with their customers all over the world. As businesses continue to shift to a real-time, customer-centric communications model, we are experiencing a time of impressive growth.

Why This Role Matters

The RNE (Registration, Numbers and Enablement) group within Vonage's Foundation Engineering department works across four core product domains: Registration, Numbers, Number Intelligence, and Know Your Customer (KYC). As a Staff Engineer, you will be a technical anchor for the team, shaping the architecture of our cloud-native platform and influencing engineering culture across the group.

What You Will Do

  • Provide technical leadership and vision for the design and development of highly concurrent, distributed backend systems;
  • Drive and own significant architectural decisions, ensuring scalability, reliability and maintainability across the platform;
  • Lead performance optimisation initiatives and resolve the most complex system-level challenges;
  • Set the standard for testing practices, including Unit, Integration and Smoke tests, enabling fully automated promotion of code to production;
  • Define, evolve and enforce coding standards and engineering best practices across the team;
  • Act as a technical mentor and leader, supporting the growth of engineers at all levels;
  • Collaborate closely with product and engineering leadership to align technical strategy with business goals;
  • Provide out-of-hours support as part of an on-call rota.

What You Will Bring

Essential:

  • Extensive programming experience in Go (Golang) or deep expertise in JVM technologies (Java/Spring Boot) with a strong commitment to adopting Go;
  • Extensive, proven experience developing and maintaining enterprise-grade systems at scale;
  • Deep expertise in highly concurrent, distributed architectures and systems;
  • Extensive experience leading and owning architectural decisions at team and cross-team level;
  • Prior experience as a Team Lead or Tech Lead, with a track record of mentoring and growing engineering talent;
  • Experience with containerised applications and cloud-native infrastructure;
  • Expert-level performance profiling and optimisation skills;
  • Deep experience with relational and non-relational databases (e.g. PostgreSQL, Redis);
  • Exceptional communication and influencing skills, with the ability to align technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Nice to Have:

  • Deep hands-on experience with AWS (SQS, SNS, DynamoDB), Kafka, Kubernetes or Terraform;
  • Experience driving Continuous Delivery practices in cloud environments;
  • General understanding of the telecommunications industry.

How you’ll benefit:

  • Medical Insurance (Allianz)
  • Life Insurance (Uniqa)
  • Glasses Reimbursement
  • Kafeteria (My Benefit)
  • Discretionary Time Off (DTO)
  • Volunteer Time (VTO)
  • Ericsson Care Line

There’s no perfect candidate. You don't need all the preferred qualifications to make a valuable impact on our team. Our employees and customers come from diverse backgrounds, so if you're passionate about what you could achieve at Vonage, we'd love to hear from you.

To learn how we process your personal data during the recruitment process, please refer to our Privacy Notice.

Who we are:

Vonage is a global cloud communications leader. And your talent will further help brands - such as Airbnb, Viber, WhatsApp, and Snapchat - accelerate their digital transformation through our fully programmable-based unified communications, contact center solutions, and communications APIs. Ready to innovate? Then join us today.

Note: The purpose of this profile is to provide a general summary of essential responsibilities for the position and is not meant as an exhaustive list. Assignments may differ for individuals within the same role based on business conditions, departmental need or geographic location.

raw.excerpt: About Us Innovation.  Sustainability.  Productivity.
raw.description:
About Us

Innovation. Sustainability. Productivity. This is how we are Breaking New Ground in our mission to sustainably advance the noble work of farmers and builders everywhere. With a growing global population and increased demands on resources, our products are instrumental to feeding and sheltering the world.

From developing products that run on alternative power to productivity-enhancing precision tech, we are delivering solutions that benefit people – and they are possible thanks to people like you. If the opportunity to build your skills as part of a collaborative, global team excites you, you’re in the right place.

Grow a Career. Build a Future!

Be part of this company at the forefront of agriculture and construction, that passionately innovates to drive customer efficiency and success. And we know innovation can’t happen without collaboration. So, everything we do at CNH Industrial is about reaching new heights as one team, always delivering for the good of our customers.

Job Purpose

  • The selected candidate will support the development of next-generation off-road vehicles, contributing to engineering decisions from the earliest concept development phases through final product validation.
  • The Vehicle Performance & Fluid Power Engineer is responsible for defining, evaluating and optimizing vehicle-level performance through engineering analysis, virtual simulations, system modeling and experimental correlation activities, working across powertrain, driveline, hydraulic, electrified and vehicle systems.
  • The candidate will be requested to perform early-phase concept simulations, enabling architecture trade-off studies and virtual assessment of emerging technologies before hardware is available, within complex multidisciplinary projects coordinated across global engineering organizations.
  • The selected candidate will contribute to the evaluation of innovative solutions including advanced fluid power systems, hybrid powertrains, vehicle electrification and alternative fuel technologies, supporting the transition toward more sustainable and efficient off-road machines.

Key Responsibilities

Vehicle Performance Engineering

  • Analyze and optimize vehicle productivity, fuel efficiency, energy utilization and overall machine performance.
  • Support vehicle target setting and requirements definition.
  • Perform vehicle-level powerflow and energy balance analyses.
  • Assess driveline efficiency, traction capability and operational performance.
  • Conduct competitive benchmarking and technology assessments.

Fluid Power Engineering

  • Develop and validate hydraulic architectures, subsystems and components.
  • Analyze hydraulic efficiency and power losses at component, subsystem and vehicle level.
  • Optimize system performance considering control strategies, energy consumption and customer usage profiles.
  • Support definition of innovative fluid power solutions for future vehicle platforms.

Hybridization, Electrification & Alternative Fuels

  • Support feasibility studies and system integration activities for hybrid and electrified vehicle architectures.
  • Evaluate power management strategies between conventional and electrified subsystems.
  • Assess energy flows, battery utilization and overall system efficiency.
  • Analyze the impact of alternative fuels (HVO, Biodiesel, LNG, CNG, Hydrogen and future low-carbon solutions) on vehicle performance and efficiency.
  • Support technology roadmaps and concept selection activities for sustainable vehicle development.

Early Phase Concept Development & Virtual Engineering

  • Perform early-phase concept simulations to support architecture decisions before prototype availability.
  • Conduct trade-off analyses between competing concepts and technologies.
  • Develop virtual assessment methodologies for vehicle performance, fuel economy, productivity and hydraulic efficiency.
  • Support shift-left engineering initiatives through model-based development approaches.
  • Generate data-driven recommendations to accelerate development and reduce program risk.

Simulation & System Modeling

  • Develop and maintain high-fidelity and reduced-order simulation models.
  • Execute virtual validation activities at component, subsystem and full vehicle level.
  • Correlate simulation outputs with experimental measurements.
  • Support model-based engineering processes throughout the product development cycle.
  • Utilize simulation environments such as AMESim, MATLAB/Simulink and other engineering analysis tools.

Project Leadership & Stakeholder Management

  • Lead technical workstreams within complex multidisciplinary projects.
  • Coordinate activities among global engineering teams and multiple stakeholders.
  • Drive technical alignment and decision-making processes.
  • Present simulation results, technical recommendations and project updates to management and engineering leadership.
  • Support project planning, risk identification and mitigation activities.
  • Interface with suppliers, research partners and external engineering organizations when required.

Experience Required

HARD SKILLS

  • Master's degree in mechanical, automotive, energy or aerospace engineering, or equivalent
  • Professional industry experience in off-road, agriculture, construction, automotive or commercial vehicles industry - years of experience: 3-5
  • Knowledge of vehicle performance, powertrain, driveline and energy management principles
  • Knowledge of fluid power systems: hydraulic architectures, subsystems, components, efficiency and power losses
  • Knowledge of hybrid and electrified off-road vehicle architectures, vehicle energy management and alternative fuel technologies (HVO, Biodiesel, LNG, CNG, Hydrogen)
  • Knowledge of simulation environments such as AMESim, MATLAB/Simulink and other engineering analysis tools
  • Systems Engineering approach; Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) exposure would be an advantage
  • Advanced optimization techniques and Design of Experiments (DoE), data analytics and visualization tools
  • Digital engineering and virtual validation methodologies; Artificial Intelligence applications for engineering workflows (preferred)

SOFT SKILLS

  • Strong systems engineering mindset and excellent analytical skills
  • Ability to translate complex technical information into actionable recommendations that drive business and product decisions
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to present simulation results and technical recommendations to management and engineering leadership
  • Ability to coordinate activities among global engineering teams and multiple stakeholders (product engineering, controls, validation, manufacturing, program management, suppliers and technical partners)
  • Ability to work both autonomously and as part of a global multidisciplinary team
  • Commitment to deadlines, milestones and set timelines
  • Availability to Domestic and International travel.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Ready and willing to take accountability and responsibility in own actions and decisions
  • Strive towards autonomy
  • Open and transparent communication
  • Provide overwhelming support and go beyond the expectations
  • Goal and solution (and not obstacles) driven.

Pay Transparency

The annual salary for this role is EUR €39,000.00 - €52,000.00 plus any applicable bonus (Actual salaries will vary and will be based on various factors, such as skill, experience and qualification for the role.)

For roles open across multiple locations, the salary range indicated refers to the primary location. If a different location is considered, the applicable salary range will be communicated to candidates prior to the first interview.

What We Offer

We offer dynamic career opportunities across an international landscape. As an equal opportunity employer, we are committed to delivering value for all our employees and fostering a culture of respect.

At CNH, we understand that the best solutions come from the diverse experiences and skills of our people. Here, you will be empowered to grow your career, to follow your passion, and help build a better future. To support our employees, we offer regional comprehensive benefits, including:

  • Flexible work arrangements
  • Savings & Retirement benefits
  • Tuition reimbursement
  • Parental leave
  • Adoption assistance
  • Fertility & Family building support
  • Employee Assistance Programs
  • Charitable contribution matching and Volunteer Time Off

Our global team is composed of nearly 1000 full-time employees whose commitment to creativity, quality, and on-time delivery is unrivaled in our space.

In this position, you will be working with our Medical Communications team. For more information about our team, please visit MedComms | Red Nucleus.

The Medical Writer is responsible for the development, scientific integrity, and accuracy of medical content for pharmaceutical and medical device clients. This role serves as the lead medical writer for assigned clients, brands, or therapeutic areas and contributes to additional projects as required.

The position oversees the research, development, updating, and editing of medical materials, ensuring that all content aligns with regulatory, compliance, and client standards across medical affairs and commercial initiatives. The Medical Writer participates in client interactions and collaborates with cross-functional teams to execute deliverables efficiently and to quality expectations.

The role may support strategic initiatives, including congress activities, advisory boards, workshops, and other client engagements, with appropriate senior oversight. In addition to content development responsibilities, the Medical Writer manages workload priorities, supports mentorship and training of junior team members, and maintains accountability for timely and accurate completion of assigned projects.

  • Work within copy deck formats that appropriately record changes, style decisions, source materials, and referencing requirements
  • Prepare and submit content for medical legal regulatory review in client submission/referencing systems

Required Skills & Qualifications

Join Vonage and help us innovate cloud communications for businesses worldwide!

About Vonage

Vonage is the emerging leader in the $100B+ cloud communications platform (CPaaS) market. Customers like Airbnb, Viber, WhatsApp, Snapchat, and many others depend on our APIs and SDKs to connect with their customers all over the world. As businesses continue to shift to a real-time, customer-centric communications model, we are experiencing a time of impressive growth.

Why This Role Matters

The RNE (Registration, Numbers and Enablement) group within Vonage's Foundation Engineering department works across four core product domains: Registration, Numbers, Number Intelligence, and Know Your Customer (KYC). As a Staff Engineer, you will be a technical anchor for the team, shaping the architecture of our cloud-native platform and influencing engineering culture across the group.

What You Will Do

  • Provide technical leadership and vision for the design and development of highly concurrent, distributed backend systems;
  • Drive and own significant architectural decisions, ensuring scalability, reliability and maintainability across the platform;
  • Lead performance optimisation initiatives and resolve the most complex system-level challenges;
  • Set the standard for testing practices, including Unit, Integration and Smoke tests, enabling fully automated promotion of code to production;
  • Define, evolve and enforce coding standards and engineering best practices across the team;
  • Act as a technical mentor and leader, supporting the growth of engineers at all levels;
  • Collaborate closely with product and engineering leadership to align technical strategy with business goals;
  • Provide out-of-hours support as part of an on-call rota.

What You Will Bring

Essential:

  • Extensive programming experience in Go (Golang) or deep expertise in JVM technologies (Java/Spring Boot) with a strong commitment to adopting Go;
  • Extensive, proven experience developing and maintaining enterprise-grade systems at scale;
  • Deep expertise in highly concurrent, distributed architectures and systems;
  • Extensive experience leading and owning architectural decisions at team and cross-team level;
  • Prior experience as a Team Lead or Tech Lead, with a track record of mentoring and growing engineering talent;
  • Experience with containerised applications and cloud-native infrastructure;
  • Expert-level performance profiling and optimisation skills;
  • Deep experience with relational and non-relational databases (e.g. PostgreSQL, Redis);
  • Exceptional communication and influencing skills, with the ability to align technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Nice to Have:

  • Deep hands-on experience with AWS (SQS, SNS, DynamoDB), Kafka, Kubernetes or Terraform;
  • Experience driving Continuous Delivery practices in cloud environments;
  • General understanding of the telecommunications industry.

How you’ll benefit:

  • Medical Insurance (Allianz)
  • Life Insurance (Uniqa)
  • Glasses Reimbursement
  • Kafeteria (My Benefit)
  • Discretionary Time Off (DTO)
  • Volunteer Time (VTO)
  • Ericsson Care Line

There’s no perfect candidate. You don't need all the preferred qualifications to make a valuable impact on our team. Our employees and customers come from diverse backgrounds, so if you're passionate about what you could achieve at Vonage, we'd love to hear from you.

To learn how we process your personal data during the recruitment process, please refer to our Privacy Notice.

Who we are:

Vonage is a global cloud communications leader. And your talent will further help brands - such as Airbnb, Viber, WhatsApp, and Snapchat - accelerate their digital transformation through our fully programmable-based unified communications, contact center solutions, and communications APIs. Ready to innovate? Then join us today.

Note: The purpose of this profile is to provide a general summary of essential responsibilities for the position and is not meant as an exhaustive list. Assignments may differ for individuals within the same role based on business conditions, departmental need or geographic location.

About Us

Innovation. Sustainability. Productivity. This is how we are Breaking New Ground in our mission to sustainably advance the noble work of farmers and builders everywhere. With a growing global population and increased demands on resources, our products are instrumental to feeding and sheltering the world.

From developing products that run on alternative power to productivity-enhancing precision tech, we are delivering solutions that benefit people – and they are possible thanks to people like you. If the opportunity to build your skills as part of a collaborative, global team excites you, you’re in the right place.

Grow a Career. Build a Future!

Be part of this company at the forefront of agriculture and construction, that passionately innovates to drive customer efficiency and success. And we know innovation can’t happen without collaboration. So, everything we do at CNH Industrial is about reaching new heights as one team, always delivering for the good of our customers.

Job Purpose

  • The selected candidate will support the development of next-generation off-road vehicles, contributing to engineering decisions from the earliest concept development phases through final product validation.
  • The Vehicle Performance & Fluid Power Engineer is responsible for defining, evaluating and optimizing vehicle-level performance through engineering analysis, virtual simulations, system modeling and experimental correlation activities, working across powertrain, driveline, hydraulic, electrified and vehicle systems.
  • The candidate will be requested to perform early-phase concept simulations, enabling architecture trade-off studies and virtual assessment of emerging technologies before hardware is available, within complex multidisciplinary projects coordinated across global engineering organizations.
  • The selected candidate will contribute to the evaluation of innovative solutions including advanced fluid power systems, hybrid powertrains, vehicle electrification and alternative fuel technologies, supporting the transition toward more sustainable and efficient off-road machines.

Key Responsibilities

Vehicle Performance Engineering

  • Analyze and optimize vehicle productivity, fuel efficiency, energy utilization and overall machine performance.
  • Support vehicle target setting and requirements definition.
  • Perform vehicle-level powerflow and energy balance analyses.
  • Assess driveline efficiency, traction capability and operational performance.
  • Conduct competitive benchmarking and technology assessments.

Fluid Power Engineering

  • Develop and validate hydraulic architectures, subsystems and components.
  • Analyze hydraulic efficiency and power losses at component, subsystem and vehicle level.
  • Optimize system performance considering control strategies, energy consumption and customer usage profiles.
  • Support definition of innovative fluid power solutions for future vehicle platforms.

Hybridization, Electrification & Alternative Fuels

  • Support feasibility studies and system integration activities for hybrid and electrified vehicle architectures.
  • Evaluate power management strategies between conventional and electrified subsystems.
  • Assess energy flows, battery utilization and overall system efficiency.
  • Analyze the impact of alternative fuels (HVO, Biodiesel, LNG, CNG, Hydrogen and future low-carbon solutions) on vehicle performance and efficiency.
  • Support technology roadmaps and concept selection activities for sustainable vehicle development.

Early Phase Concept Development & Virtual Engineering

  • Perform early-phase concept simulations to support architecture decisions before prototype availability.
  • Conduct trade-off analyses between competing concepts and technologies.
  • Develop virtual assessment methodologies for vehicle performance, fuel economy, productivity and hydraulic efficiency.
  • Support shift-left engineering initiatives through model-based development approaches.
  • Generate data-driven recommendations to accelerate development and reduce program risk.

Simulation & System Modeling

  • Develop and maintain high-fidelity and reduced-order simulation models.
  • Execute virtual validation activities at component, subsystem and full vehicle level.
  • Correlate simulation outputs with experimental measurements.
  • Support model-based engineering processes throughout the product development cycle.
  • Utilize simulation environments such as AMESim, MATLAB/Simulink and other engineering analysis tools.

Project Leadership & Stakeholder Management

  • Lead technical workstreams within complex multidisciplinary projects.
  • Coordinate activities among global engineering teams and multiple stakeholders.
  • Drive technical alignment and decision-making processes.
  • Present simulation results, technical recommendations and project updates to management and engineering leadership.
  • Support project planning, risk identification and mitigation activities.
  • Interface with suppliers, research partners and external engineering organizations when required.

Experience Required

HARD SKILLS

  • Master's degree in mechanical, automotive, energy or aerospace engineering, or equivalent
  • Professional industry experience in off-road, agriculture, construction, automotive or commercial vehicles industry - years of experience: 3-5
  • Knowledge of vehicle performance, powertrain, driveline and energy management principles
  • Knowledge of fluid power systems: hydraulic architectures, subsystems, components, efficiency and power losses
  • Knowledge of hybrid and electrified off-road vehicle architectures, vehicle energy management and alternative fuel technologies (HVO, Biodiesel, LNG, CNG, Hydrogen)
  • Knowledge of simulation environments such as AMESim, MATLAB/Simulink and other engineering analysis tools
  • Systems Engineering approach; Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) exposure would be an advantage
  • Advanced optimization techniques and Design of Experiments (DoE), data analytics and visualization tools
  • Digital engineering and virtual validation methodologies; Artificial Intelligence applications for engineering workflows (preferred)

SOFT SKILLS

  • Strong systems engineering mindset and excellent analytical skills
  • Ability to translate complex technical information into actionable recommendations that drive business and product decisions
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to present simulation results and technical recommendations to management and engineering leadership
  • Ability to coordinate activities among global engineering teams and multiple stakeholders (product engineering, controls, validation, manufacturing, program management, suppliers and technical partners)
  • Ability to work both autonomously and as part of a global multidisciplinary team
  • Commitment to deadlines, milestones and set timelines
  • Availability to Domestic and International travel.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Ready and willing to take accountability and responsibility in own actions and decisions
  • Strive towards autonomy
  • Open and transparent communication
  • Provide overwhelming support and go beyond the expectations
  • Goal and solution (and not obstacles) driven.

Pay Transparency

The annual salary for this role is EUR €39,000.00 - €52,000.00 plus any applicable bonus (Actual salaries will vary and will be based on various factors, such as skill, experience and qualification for the role.)

For roles open across multiple locations, the salary range indicated refers to the primary location. If a different location is considered, the applicable salary range will be communicated to candidates prior to the first interview.

What We Offer

We offer dynamic career opportunities across an international landscape. As an equal opportunity employer, we are committed to delivering value for all our employees and fostering a culture of respect.

At CNH, we understand that the best solutions come from the diverse experiences and skills of our people. Here, you will be empowered to grow your career, to follow your passion, and help build a better future. To support our employees, we offer regional comprehensive benefits, including:

  • Flexible work arrangements
  • Savings & Retirement benefits
