raw.description:
Head of IT & Security

About us:

At Fullbay, our mission is simple — to create safer roads for our families and yours. As leaders in the heavy-duty repair industry, we power shops with technology that helps them run smarter and more efficiently. As an AI-First company, we invite artificial intelligence to eliminate friction, spark innovation, and drive efficiencies in every conversation— for our teams and our customers. Fullbay is the number one cloud-based shop management software for commercial repair shops and is growing fast. This is an exciting opportunity to join a high-performing team and help shape the next phase of growth for the company.

Position Overview:

Fullbay's Security and IT Manager owns two functions that are usually split across two people: the security program that keeps Fullbay's systems, people, and customer data safe, and the IT operations that keep the business running day to day. Reporting to the VP of IT, this role designs the security and IT program from the ground up and owns its execution end-to-end — there's no existing playbook to inherit and no separate team to hand the work to.

This role is well-suited to someone who has built a security program before, not just operated inside one — someone comfortable being the primary responder when an MDR alert escalates, the person who leads SOC 2 through an actual audit, and the same person who's also the company's escalation point when someone's laptop won't image. This is a player-coach role: you set the standards, and you personally execute the work.

Success here looks like passing SOC 2 audits with no major findings, on schedule; security incidents that get triaged, contained, and resolved fast enough that they stay incidents, not breaches; IT support that doesn't make employees wait, with devices provisioned before day one and tickets closed without a saga; and a risk posture leadership can see clearly at any time, not just when an audit forces the question.

The Right Wrench for the Job

A shop's most dangerous moments are never the ones people see coming. The person who wires the electrical panel, checks the fire suppression, and makes sure the alarm actually calls someone when it goes off isn't thinking about any one repair — they're thinking about what keeps the whole building standing. This role does that for Fullbay's systems and data, and then still picks up the phone when someone's laptop won't turn on.

You're the right fit if you've built a security program from a blank page before — not just operated inside one someone else designed — and you know the difference between a control that looks good on paper and one that actually holds up when an auditor or an attacker tests it. You can walk into a SOC 2 evidence review in the morning, triage a real MDR alert at noon, and still be the person who gets a new hire's laptop imaged and ready before their first day.

This isn't the role for someone who wants to own strategy and hand off the keyboard. If your instinct is to write the policy and let someone else enforce it, this isn't your shop. But if you're the kind of person who'll design the program, defend it to an auditor, and still crawl under the desk to fix a network cable — we'd like to talk.

Primary Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Security Program Ownership: Design, build, and continuously improve Fullbay’s security program using NIST CSF 2.0 as the governance architecture and CIS Controls v8.1 (IG1 to IG2) as the tactical execution roadmap.
  • Security Operations Oversight: Manage Fullbay’s always-on MDR platform, which provides automated threat detection and triage across endpoints and cloud environments. Serve as the primary responder for escalated alerts requiring human judgment, and lead investigation, containment, and remediation for confirmed incidents, including participation in an on-call rotation for high-severity escalations.
  • SOC 2 Readiness and Audit Management: Lead all SOC 2 readiness activities including control mapping, evidence collection, gap remediation, and audit firm coordination for Type I and Type II engagements.
  • Tool and Platform Governance: Own and configure Fullbay’s security tooling stack, including the MDR platform, MDM, email security, anti-phishing, and security awareness training. Tune and maintain tools to Fullbay standards, and evaluate new tools or vendors as needed.
  • Policy and Standards Development: Author, maintain, and enforce information security policies, standards, and procedures across the organization. Ensure policies align with regulatory requirements and audit frameworks.
  • Identity and Access Management: Oversee IAM posture across Google Workspace, including passkeys, MFA, SSO, and privileged access controls, including MDM and Apple Business Manager configuration.
  • Incident Response: Develop and own the incident response plan. Serve as the primary responder for security events escalated by the MDR platform or identified through other internal monitoring. Lead response activities and post-incident reviews.
  • Risk Management: Maintain a risk register. Identify, assess, and track security risks across people, process, and technology. Communicate risk posture to the VP of IT and senior leadership.
  • Security Awareness: Oversee the security awareness training program, including phishing simulations and compliance-based training cycles.
  • Vendor and Third-Party Risk: Assess security posture of third-party vendors and new software applications. Maintain a vendor risk inventory and drive remediation for identified gaps.
  • End-User IT Support: Serve as the primary escalation point for company-wide technical support, resolving hardware, software, network, and account issues for employees across the organization.
  • Device & Asset Lifecycle Management: Own procurement, provisioning, and deprovisioning of company devices, coordinating imaging and configuration through Apple Business Manager and NinjaOne, and maintaining an accurate IT asset inventory.
  • SaaS Application Administration: Manage user provisioning, licensing, and configuration across Fullbay’s core SaaS applications, including Google Workspace and other business tools, ensuring accounts are created, modified, and deactivated promptly.
  • Onboarding & Offboarding: Own the IT components of employee onboarding and offboarding, including account creation, device setup, access provisioning, and timely access removal.
  • IT Vendor & Procurement Management: Manage relationships and contracts with IT vendors and service providers, evaluate new tools, and control IT spend.
  • Adheres to all confidentiality and compliance regulations.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

Minimum Education & Work Experience:

  • 7-10 years of combined experience across IT operations and security, cybersecurity, or information security required; 10+ years preferred.
  • Experience managing and responding to alerts from an MDR/EDR platform, including triage, investigation, and remediation of confirmed incidents, required.
  • Demonstrated experience owning a compliance or regulatory program (SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, or equivalent) required.
  • SOC 2 audit experience (Type I or Type II) strongly preferred.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Security, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
  • Hands-on experience administering Google Workspace, MDM platforms (e.g., NinjaOne, Apple Business Manager), and providing general end-user IT support required.

Key Skills and Qualifications:

  • Deep knowledge of security frameworks including NIST CSF 2.0 and CIS Controls v8.1.
  • Working knowledge of MDR/EDR platforms and MDM solutions, with the ability to investigate and respond to escalated alerts.
  • Required platform experience: Google Workspace administration and security configuration, Apple Business Manager (ABM), NinjaOne endpoint management.
  • Preferred platform experience: Proofpoint email security, Ironscales anti-phishing.
  • Strong understanding of IAM concepts including SSO, MFA, passkeys, and privileged access management.
  • Ability to operate as a player-coach: design the security program, set the standards, and personally execute the work.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to present security risk and program status to executive leadership.
  • Experience working cross-functionally with Engineering, Legal, Finance, and business stakeholders.
  • Preferred certifications: CISSP, CISM, CISA, CCSP, CompTIA Security+, or CASP+.
  • Strong general IT troubleshooting skills across Mac and Windows environments, networking fundamentals, and common business SaaS applications.
  • Experience with IT ticketing/helpdesk systems and asset management tools.

Physical Demands and Work Environment:

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions

  • Regularly required to sit at a desk in front of a computer and use hands to finger, handle, or feel objects, tools, or controls (including a computer keyboard and operating a telephone), lift and/or move up to 10 pounds.
  • Frequently requires the use of hands and arms for reaching, as well as the ability to walk and communicate effectively through speaking and listening.
  • Specific vision abilities required by this position include close vision, color vision, and the ability to adjust focus.
  • Noise level in the work environment is usually moderate.
  • Type on a computer keyboard and look at a computer monitor, and operate a cell phone or a computer-based phone

Matrix New World Engineering, a part of True Environmental and its partner firms, have united their strengths to establish the nation's premier environmental and engineering services consulting firm. This powerhouse organization offers an extensive range of services aimed at revolutionizing the built environment and preserving the natural one. Its diverse expertise encompasses environmental remediation, urban planning, engineering iconic coastal and marine structures, developing sustainable energy sources, and pioneering resource extraction methods. Explore further at and to discover the full scope of our capabilities.

Matrix New World Engineering, a part of True Environmental, is seeking a Groundwater Modeler /Hydrogeologist to join our team in Phoenix, AZ. The position will be a full-time position, with flexibility to work in our Phoenix office or remotely and will provide full company benefits that will be provided during interviews. Matrix is an equal opportunity employer.

Our Arizona Water Services group focuses on hydrogeological and environmental consulting with offices in Phoenix and Prescott, and remote staff located in North and South America. The ideal candidate will participate in groundwater flow and contaminant transport modeling and support hydrogeologic investigations for water resources and environmental consulting projects.

What You'll Do

    • Build, calibrate, and apply numerical groundwater flow and solute transport models under the direction of senior technical staff.
    • Perform sensitivity, uncertainty, and predictive analyses for water resource and remediation modeling projects.
    • Compile, evaluate, and manage spatial and subsurface datasets (including geologic, hydrogeologic, and water quality data) to support Conceptual Site Model (CSM) development.
    • Assist with technical aspects of projects supporting regulatory frameworks, such as the Arizona Department of Environmental Quality (ADEQ) permitting programs such as Aquifer Protection Permit (APP) and Arizona Pollutant Discharge Elimination System (AZPDES) permit applications
    • Assist with ADWR Assured and Adequate Water Supply (AWS) applications including aquifer impact analysis.
    • Assist with Hydrogeologic characterization in support of developing managed aquifer recharge (MAR) sites and aquifer storage and recovery (ASR) wells, including projected groundwater mounding
    • Assist with data collection, aquifer testing analysis, and data interpretation.
    • Draft technical reports, memos, figures, and technical appendices for project deliverables.
    • Support Project Managers with cost estimation, proposal preparation, and task management.

Minimum Requirements

    • Education: Bachelor's degree in Geology, Hydrology, Environmental Science, or related field; Master’s degree preferred
    • Professional Experience: 3 years of experience with a Master’s degree or 6 years of experience with a Bachelor’s degree in groundwater modeling, hydrogeology, water resources, or environmental consulting
    • Modeling Software: Hands-on proficiency with numerical groundwater flow and transport modeling software, including MODFLOW, MODPATH, and MT3D. Familiarity with pre-processing applications such as Groundwater Vistas.
    • Support Software: Proficiency in Geographic Information Systems (ArcGIS Pro) and other post-processing methods such as Fortran, Python, Grapher, Surfer.
    • Modeling Experience: Groundwater modeling experience and familiarity with the unique groundwater challenges and regulations in Arizona and the arid Southwestern United States
    • Additional Requirements: Strong technical writing and communication skills, with experience preparing technical reports and deliverables.
    • Ability to prioritize tasks and work efficiently on multiple projects both independently and as part of a dynamic project team.
    • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills for managing model files and datasets

Preferred Requirements

    • Familiarity with parameter estimation tools such as Parameter Elimination (PEST)
    • Advanced data processing skills using Python, R, FORTRAN or script-based programs and dataset management tools
    • Experience interpreting complex geologic and hydrogeologic data to develop Conceptual Site Models (CSMs)
    • Prior experience supporting field characterization programs (e.g., well installation, logging, or pumping tests).

About Matrix

    Matrix, a part of True Environmental and its partner firms, have united their strengths to establish the nation's premier environmental and engineering services consulting firm. This powerhouse organization offers an extensive range of services aimed at revolutionizing the built environment and preserving the natural one. Its diverse expertise encompasses environmental remediation, urban planning, engineering iconic coastal and marine structures, developing sustainable energy sources, and pioneering resource extraction methods. Explore further at www.MWNE.com and True-Environmental.com to discover the full scope of our capabilities.

    Matrix’s local Arizona offices have extensive expertise in groundwater flow and transport modeling; water resources; production well design, installation and testing; water system engineering; various water, pollutant, and land permitting; Environmental Site Assessments (ESAs); soil and groundwater characterization / remediation; petroleum leaking underground storage tank (LUST) site assessments; developing site assessment and remedial action plans; CSM development; design of drilling programs for installation of groundwater monitor wells and soil vapor extraction (SVE) wells; GIS and much more.

You’ll be responsible for building and maintaining dashboards for various teams across the organization. raw.description:
Please note: This role is posted as Customer Support & Monitoring Specialist - Emergency Response for candidate sourcing purposes only. The official title for this position is Wildfire Response Specialist

Please note: We do not accept unsolicited candidate introductions, referrals, or resumes from external recruiters or staffing agencies.

Location: Remote (U.S. based). This role supports Frontline customers in every market we serve and requires availability for rotating shifts, including overnights, weekends, and holidays. Candidates located in PST/MST time zones are preferred.

Background Check Requirement

As part of our hiring process, Frontline Wildfire Defense conducts comprehensive background checks for all new hires. These checks typically cover the past 7–10 years and may include employment and education verification. For roles that require work in the field, driving record verification is also required. Employment offers are contingent upon the successful completion of these background checks.

About Frontline Wildfire Defense

Founded in 2017, Frontline developed the first fully integrated wildfire defense system to stop the leading cause of home loss in wildfires: ember-driven ignition. The system combines exterior sprinklers, full-coverage design, and connected software for remote monitoring and response, allowing homes to protect themselves long after families evacuate or infrastructure fails.

Proven effective during the 2025 Los Angeles wildfires, 96% of homes with Frontline systems survived. That success has earned top industry recognition, including Frontline being recognized as one of TIME’s Best Inventions 2025 in the Green Tech category and receiving the PCBC Gold Nugget Award for “Most Innovative Housing Concept” and the Best of IBS Award for “Best Home Technology.”

As wildfires grow hotter and more frequent, our vision is to give people the tools and strategies to live safely with fire. We’re building a mission-driven team creating real-world solutions in wildfire safety and climate tech.

About This Opportunity

When a wildfire is moving toward a Frontline customer’s home, you will be the calm, knowledgeable voice on the other end of the line. As a Wildfire Response Specialist, you will be part of Frontline’s dedicated 24/7 response team, helping homeowners and commercial customers make sure their wildfire defense systems are ready, running, and doing their job when it matters most.

Every Frontline system is designed to protect a property even after its owners have evacuated. Our fire-tracking software alerts customers when a wildfire comes within 10 miles and starts an automatic activation countdown. Each system has a connected controller with Wi-Fi, cellular, and satellite connectivity and a backup battery. When it activates, eave sprayers and roof rotors wet the home and up to 30 feet around it with water and Class A foam, switching to a pool, tank, or well if water pressure drops. Your job is to make sure the people behind those systems are never on their own: before, during, and after a fire.

You will answer inbound calls and messages around the clock, reach out proactively to customers in a fire’s path, troubleshootsystem and connectivity issues in real time, and coordinate with our engineering and field service teams so every issue is resolved. Off-peak, you will help customers get ready for fire season and help us build the playbooks, tools, and processes this team runs on. This is a remote, hourly role with rotating shifts.

Key Responsibilities

Active Fire Response

  • Monitor active wildfire incidents and Frontline’s fire-tracking alerts, identify customers within alert range, and prioritize outreach based on fire proximity. behavior, and evacuation status.
  • Proactively contact customers in a fire’s path to confirm they received their alerts and understand their system’s status, and guide them through activation or override decisions in the Frontline app.
  • Verify system readiness in real time, including controller connectivity, backup battery, water pressure, and secondary water source, and resolve or escalate issues immediately.
  • Provide calm, clear guidance to customers who are evacuating or under stress, always reinforcing that personal safety and official evacuation orders come first.
  • Track incidents using official sources (e.g., CAL FIRE, InciWeb, National Weather Service Red Flag Warnings, and local evacuation zone maps) and share accurate, timely updates with customers and internal teams.
  • Log system activity and performance during fire events, including activation, runtime, water source changes, and faults, and escalate failures to on-call engineering and field service without delay.

24/7 Customer Support

  • Respond to inbound calls, texts, emails, and app messages from homeowners and commercial customers at any hour, in fire season and out of it.
  • Troubleshoot the Frontline app, controller, alerts, and connectivity (Wi-Fi, cellular, and satellite) over the phone, and walk customers through solutions step by step.
  • Follow a defined escalation matrix to bring in engineering, field service, or leadership when an issue goes beyond first-line support, and own the issue through resolution.
  • Create and manage service tickets and dispatch requests so field technicians have everything they need to act.
  • Keep detailed, accurate records of every interaction, decision, and follow-up in our ticketing and customer systems.

Post-Fire Recovery

  • Follow up with every affected customer after a fire event to confirm system status and schedule foam and water refills, inspections, or repairs with our field service team.
  • Document system performance and property outcomes after each event so the data can inform product improvements and Frontline’s performance reporting.

Readiness & Continuous Improvement

  • Lead proactive readiness check-ins before fire season and during Red Flag Warnings: confirm the app is installed, contacts are current, and systems are healthy.
  • Help build and refine the response playbooks, call scripts, escalation protocols, and knowledge base this team will run on.
  • Spot recurring issues and customer pain points and share them with Product, Engineering, and Field Services so we fix root causes, not just symptoms.
  • Performs additional related tasks as assigned.

Qualifications

Must-Have:

  • 2+ years in a high-pressure, customer-facing role such as emergency dispatch, alarm or central station monitoring, a network operations center, crisis support, or technical support for connected devices.
  • A calm, steady presence under pressure, with proven ability to de-escalate distressed callers and communicate clearly and with empathy.
  • Comfort troubleshooting connected technology over the phone (apps, Wi-Fi, cellular devices, controllers) and explaining it in plain language.
  • Sound judgment and the ability to prioritize quickly when several urgent situations happen at once.
  • Strong documentation habits and experience with ticketing or CRM systems.
  • Availability to work rotating shifts, including overnights, weekends, and holidays, and to take on extra shifts or on-call time during active fire events.
  • A quiet, private home workspace with reliable high-speed internet and a backup connectivity plan.
  • Proficiency in Google Workspace (Gmail, Sheets, Docs, Drive) and Slack.
  • High school diploma or equivalent.

Nice to Have:

  • Emergency communications or monitoring training as APCO or NENA telecommunicator training or The Monitoring Association (TMA) operator training.
  • Incident Command System familiarity (e.g., FEMA IS-100 and IS-700) or wildland fire coursework.
  • Working knowledge of wildfire behavior, Red Flag Warnings, and evacuation zone tools such as Genasys Protect or Watch Duty.
  • Experience with irrigation, plumbing, sprinkler, smart home, or security system installation or support.
  • Experience with ServiceTitan or similar field service management software.
  • Bilingual in English and Spanish.
  • Experience in a high-growth startup or a role that helped build a new team or process from scratch.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Salary Range: $29.00 - $36.00 per hour, based on experience (non-exempt; overtime eligible).
  • Company-provided cell phone and laptop
  • Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
  • 401(k) retirement plan
  • Flexible time off + 14 paid holidays (yes, your birthday is one of them!)
  • Work-from-home stipend to support your remote setup
  • Remote-first work environment, fostering work-life balance and autonomy
  • Company-provided equipment
  • Join a high-performing, mission-driven team doing work that truly matters
  • And much more!

Join Our Mission!

If you're excited about building technology that protects homes and families from wildfire disasters, we want to hear from you! Apply today and become part of a fast-growing team with purpose and innovation at its core.

Diversity and inclusion are essential values at Frontline. We know we'll do our best and most impactful work when we feel represented, and we belong. We encourage talented people from a wide variety of backgrounds and experiences to apply. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

We do Consulting Differently

The Integrated Health Solutions (IHS) practice at Berkeley Research Group (BRG) provides end-to-end advisory support to healthcare providers, payers, investors, and other stakeholders navigating complex strategic, operational, financial, and clinical challenges. Led by seasoned healthcare executives, operators, physicians, nurses, and other clinicians, IHS partners with organizations to drive sustainable performance improvement and long-term growth through strategic growth, operating model transformation, AI and digital enablement, clinical quality and patient care optimization, and revenue strategy—helping clients build resilient, future-ready healthcare enterprises in an increasingly complex environment.

 

Our four core service offerings include: 

  • Clinical and Quality Transformation
  • Business Transformation Advisory
  • Margin & Operational Improvement

raw.description:
CancerNavigator is an early-stage healthcare company (remote, headquartered in Washington, D.C.) dedicated to supporting cancer patients in their hour of need.

Our Mission & Our Work, in Brief

Cancer is the number one cause of death for commercially insured Americans and the top cost driver for health plans. And, cancer patients are struggling.

CancerNavigator is a white-glove, end-to-end, cancer support service for patients and their families. We work with health plans across the country to provide 1-1 support to members facing a cancer diagnosis. All of our support is delivered through dedicated Oncology Certified Nurses, who work with members to catch cancer early, get them to fantastic experts for their care, and help them through the thousands of other problems patients and their families face.

Join us to help serve cancer patients in their hour of need.

The “Research Associate” Role

The number one priority of a research associate is to produce high-quality research that will help patients understand crucial information in their hour of need. Research Associates support the following efforts:

  • Creating Custom Documents for Patients: The Patient Service Team’s mandate is to help cancer patients make decisions in this difficult hour of need, and our mechanism for serving patients is education. The primary responsibility for a researcher on our team is to create excellent tailored documents for patients, and to collaborate with our oncology nurse navigators to teach each patient what they need to know about their specific situation. This is an “on-demand” function – when patients need help, our entire team jumps into action.
  • Enhancing Our Research Base: Our team has spent over five years building a deep research foundation on nearly every cancer type and subtype, which we use to inform the education and guidance we deliver to patients. The cancer landscape is continually evolving, and our research base requires updating regularly to reflect changes in diagnostics, treatment protocols, techniques, and more. A central function of a research associate is to assist in the enhancement of our core research base by identifying gaps in our research as we serve patients, and occasionally performing research “deep dives” to fill in those gaps.

The Requirements

The right person for this role would be eager to jump in immediately and begin mastering the clinical content. More specifically, we are looking for someone with:

  • 1-2 years of professional research experience on clinical topics
  • Experience reading and examining academic literature on medical subjects
  • Ability to quickly master complex clinical content in both depth and breadth
  • Ability to execute research projects autonomously
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)

Preferred Qualifications

  • Masters degree requiring research in a related field
  • Willingness to work MST hours

Compensation and Benefits

  • Salary Range: $71k-76k (dependent on qualifications and experience)
  • Remote-first work; live where you want within the continental U.S.
  • All-company on-sites 2-3 times per year in Washington D.C. (HQ) or other locations
  • Medical and Dental Insurance (80% employer paid), Vision Insurance (100% employer paid)
  • Healthcare and Dependent Care FSA
  • Group Life and AD&D Insurance (involuntary with the option to buy-up coverage)
  • Unlimited PTO

Our Culture & Values, In Brief

We’re building a company where what we do matters. The goal couldn’t be clearer – serve cancer patients. As the business grows, and the work becomes more complex, we need to become more, not less, committed to why we are doing this.

We have three company values, which guide our company:

  1. Patients first, always: In everything we do, we put the cancer patient (and their families) first; we exist to serve them in their most urgent moments.
  2. Respect for our responsibility: We strive, as a team, to respect the gravity of the responsibility we bear to patients, always acting and producing in a way that is worthy of the trust they have placed in us.
  3. Kindness to and respect for others: We treat our teammates well, no exceptions. We are one team.

At CancerNavigator, we believe a well-rounded and diverse team is a key to our success. We never discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status.

California Consumer Privacy Act - Job Applicant Notice

We want to let you know how we handle your information under California privacy law (CCPA/CPRA). When you apply, we collect things like your name, contact info, and resume details. If we move forward, we will also collect reference and background check information. We use this information to review your application, schedule interviews, and verify your background. This information is only shared with people who help with hiring, such as the People Op team, hiring managers, and our internal recruiting platforms (e.g., background check, ATS, etc.). Typically, we keep this data for up to two years after the hiring process, unless we need to keep it longer for legal or business reasons. If you live in California, you can ask to see, correct, or delete your information - or ask questions about how it’s used.

Thanks for applying!

raw.description:
As a Contract Senior Salesforce Developer at Scaled Agile, you will be a key member of a high-performing, Agile engineering team responsible for building and maintaining our Salesforce platform and the integrations that connect it to the rest of our business. This includes the customer-facing Community built on Experience Cloud, Sales Cloud, the managed LMS package that powers our learning and certification programs, and the Salesforce APIs that power Studio, our React-based learning platform. Salesforce sits at the center of a heavily integrated environment, exchanging data with our payment, credentialing, exam, tax, and finance systems as well as our internal services platform. You will own complex Apex, design and harden integrations, and bring strong engineering practices to a platform with high data volumes and direct customer impact.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Design, build, and maintain Apex (triggers, batch and queueable jobs, invocable actions, REST services) and Lightning Web Components that implement certification, renewal, fulfillment, and licensing business logic.

  • Build and operate integrations with external systems using named and external credentials, REST callouts, platform events, and Salesforce-exposed REST APIs, spanning payments and subscriptions, license provisioning, credentialing, exams, tax, and finance.

  • Own the Salesforce-exposed APIs consumed by our customer-facing applications and internal services.

  • Diagnose and resolve production issues across the stack: governor and SOQL limits, trigger recursion, managed package exceptions, failed order fulfillment, and data mismatches between systems.

  • Ship changes through our version-controlled CI/CD pipeline (SF CLI, GitHub, Copado) with Apex unit test coverage rather than configuring production directly, and help mature our release tooling.

  • Maintain secrets and security hygiene: credential rotation, secret storage, connected app and permission set reviews, and remediation of secret scanning and audit findings.

  • Build scalable batch and data management solutions for large volumes (hundreds of thousands of user and learning records): deactivation, archival, deduplication, user merge, and storage reduction.

  • Partner with product, support, finance, and the full-stack and infrastructure engineers on your team to scope work, run technical spikes, estimate, and write clear designs and acceptance criteria.

  • Use AI assistants to accelerate development, impact analysis, test generation, and issue investigation.

  • Stay current with Salesforce releases and assess their impact on our codebase and integrations.

  • 5+ years of Salesforce development experience, including Apex, SOQL, Lightning Web Components, and Flow on Sales Cloud and Experience Cloud.

  • Proven experience designing and operating integrations between Salesforce and external systems: REST and JSON, OAuth, named and external credentials, webhooks and platform events, retry and error handling.

  • Hands-on experience integrating with a payment or subscription platform; Stripe strongly preferred.

  • Deep understanding of governor limits, bulkification, asynchronous Apex (Batch, Queueable, Scheduled, Future), and trigger frameworks.

  • Experience working inside large managed packages, including version upgrades and troubleshooting package behavior you cannot modify.

  • Experience with version-controlled deployments (SF CLI, Git, CI/CD) and Apex unit testing.

  • Strong production troubleshooting skills with large data volumes.

  • Hands-on experience using AI assistants in technical work.

  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to document technical designs clearly and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.

  • Understanding of Agile principles and practices, with a strong desire to work in a fully Agile team.

Nice to Have:

  • Copado or similar Salesforce DevOps tooling

  • Platform Developer I or II, System Architect, or Application Architect certification

  • Experience with a Salesforce-native LMS package

  • Experience with Node.js or TypeScript backend services

  • Exposure to Stripe, OwnBackup, Avalara, Credly, NetSuite, or Marketo

Location: This is a US based remote role. You will work from your US home office and collaborate with your colleagues virtually.

Compensation:
Scaled Agile is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. The target compensation range for this contract role is $100/hr - $145/hr. Pay is based on a variety of factors, including a candidate’s relevant experience, skills, and certifications.

This is a "full time" contract opportunity with normal US based business hours. This person will accrue 35-40 hours per week.

We Welcome All:
Scaled Agile Inc (SAI) is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to a diverse and inclusive work environment. 
Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or any other classification protected by law.

AI Use:
At SAI we use technology, including artificial intelligence (AI), to support our recruiters in streamlining our hiring process. You can rest easy knowing that an actual human reviews your qualifications, compares it to the needs of each open role, and makes recommendations regarding your candidacy. Throughout the process decisions are made my people, not AI.

Application Acceptance Timeline:
We will accept applications for this position for an undetermined amount of time/ ongoing basis.
We encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

Work Differently. Build the Future.

Scaled Agile, Inc. (SAI) is a global training and enablement platform helping enterprises thrive amid rapid change and AI-driven work. Through SAFe®, the world’s most trusted system for enterprise agility, and a growing portfolio of AI education programs, we serve a 400+ partner network and 2 million+ trained professionals worldwide.

About SpyGlass Pharma:

At SpyGlass Pharma (NASDAQ: SGP), we are focused on improving and preserving the vision of patients living with chronic eye diseases, while minimizing the burden treatment can place on their daily lives. We are advancing innovative long-term ophthalmic drug delivery technologies designed to provide sustained therapy through cataract surgery and help improve patient outcomes.

We have built a highly collaborative team with deep expertise across ophthalmology, drug delivery, pharmaceuticals, and medical devices. Our scientists, engineers, and clinical leaders bring decades of experience developing and commercializing breakthrough technologies, united by a shared commitment to patients and our guiding principle: “We create for patients.” That mindset shapes how we build our products, our teams, and our culture.

Backed by strong clinical progress, significant funding, and a growing organization, SpyGlass Pharma is entering an exciting stage of growth as we advance our lead program, the SpyGlass BIM-IOL, through Phase 3 clinical development.

Summary:

We are seeking a Medical Science Liaison (MSL) to join our team at SpyGlass Pharma. This field-based role will support SpyGlass Pharma's clinical development programs, with an immediate focus on Phase 3 clinical trial execution and site engagement across an assigned territory. The MSL will serve as a key scientific resource to investigators, healthcare providers, and study site personnel, supporting protocol education, trial awareness, patient identification and referral initiatives, and effective study execution. The role will also contribute to broader scientific engagement and the continued development of SpyGlass Pharma's field medical capabilities as the organization grows.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Execute field medical activities supporting Phase 3 clinical trial execution and site engagement within an assigned territory.
  • Develop and maintain strong scientific relationships with clinical investigators, key opinion leaders (KOLs), healthcare providers (HCPs), academic institutions, and other relevant stakeholders.
  • Support investigator and study site engagement activities, including trial awareness, protocol education, patient identification strategies, and OD referral initiatives.
  • Serve as a scientific resource to investigators and site personnel, providing clinical, scientific, and protocol-related support throughout study execution.
  • Partner closely with Clinical Operations to identify site-level needs, support enrollment objectives, and address scientific or educational barriers impacting study execution.
  • Facilitate compliant scientific exchange with healthcare professionals regarding clinical data, disease state education, and SpyGlass Pharma's clinical development programs.
  • Represent SpyGlass Pharma at scientific congresses, investigator meetings, advisory boards, and clinical insight sessions, as appropriate.
  • Support scientific congress activities, including external engagement, meeting coordination, and collection of relevant field medical insights.
  • Gather, synthesize, and communicate field insights, competitive intelligence, investigator feedback, and unmet medical needs to appropriate internal cross-functional teams.
  • Collaborate with Clinical Operations, Medical Affairs, Regulatory Affairs, and other internal stakeholders to ensure alignment of field activities with clinical development priorities.
  • Contribute to the continued development of field medical processes, tools, engagement approaches, and best practices as organizational needs evolve.
  • Maintain strong scientific and clinical knowledge of ophthalmology, glaucoma, ocular hypertension, and related therapeutic areas.
  • Ensure all activities are conducted in compliance with applicable regulatory requirements, company policies, GCP, and industry standards.
  • Travel extensively within the assigned geography and attend investigator meetings, scientific conferences, and corporate meetings as required.

Qualifications Required For Position:

  • Bachelor's degree in life sciences, pharmacy, healthcare, or a related scientific or clinical discipline required.
  • Advanced scientific or clinical degree preferred (PharmD, PhD, OD, MD, NP, PA, or equivalent).
  • Minimum of 3–5 years of relevant experience within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, clinical research, or healthcare industry.
  • Previous MSL, field medical, clinical development, or clinical trial support experience preferred.
  • Experience supporting ophthalmology, glaucoma, ocular hypertension, or related therapeutic areas preferred.
  • Experience supporting late-stage clinical programs or clinical trial site engagement activities preferred.
  • Working knowledge of clinical trial operations, GCP, FDA regulations, and compliant scientific exchange practices.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop effective relationships with investigators, healthcare providers, and other external stakeholders.
  • Strong scientific communication, presentation, and relationship-building skills.
  • Ability to understand and communicate complex scientific and clinical information to diverse audiences.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to independently manage multiple priorities and execute responsibilities across an assigned territory.
  • Demonstrated ability to work effectively within cross-functional teams and matrix organizations.
  • Ability to travel up to 50–75% domestically as required.

Please note: This is a U.S. based, remote position that requires regular travel across the country (50-75% domestically as required.). Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States and comfortable with a travel-based schedule.

Why SpyGlass Pharma?

  • We are offering a range of $175,000 - $200,000; with a higher range of $200,000 to $225,000 for candidates hired at the Senior level based on experience and qualifications, along with an Annual Bonus opportunity.
  • Share in our success with stock options, giving you a stake in the company’s future.

raw.description:
Graphic Design Course Editor

Course Editors play a crucial role in ensuring the quality of our credit-recommended college courses. This project aims to enhance and update college-level courses to ensure they meet current academic standards and industry requirements. This is an online, remote contract role.This is an online, remote contract role. All work is paid per hour.

Project Description

You will review and edit existing college-level Visual Communications course structure and materials. This is expected to include tasks such as (but not limited to):

  • Evaluating and adjusting recommended updates to existing course structure
  • Reviewing course learning outcomes and competencies for accuracy and alignment with current health informatics standards
  • Editing skill-oriented course sections and ensuring proper organization of topics such as electronic health records, health data management, and healthcare IT systems
  • Reviewing and refining response assignment prompts and rubrics
  • Evaluating existing multiple choice questions for quality and accuracy

Required Skills:

  • Master's degree or higher in Applied Philosophy/Ethics, with the ability to teach ethical reasoning at an introductory, non-technical college level
  • Hands-on fluency with generative AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or Copilot)
  • Familiarity with the ethical issues and regulation surrounding generative AI
  • Experience teaching courses in a college or university setting
  • Experience creating, updating, or revising courses at the college or university level

Education Level Required - including major if needed

  • Master's degree or higher in graphic design, visual communication design, communication studies, rhetoric, media studies, or journalism; OR

  • Bachelor's degree in one of these plus a master's in a closely related field; OR

  • Bachelor's degree in design plus 3+ years of professional design practice

Additional Preferred Skills:

  • Strong time management skills to meet due dates
  • Receptiveness to feedback and willingness to revise submitted work as needed
  • Ability to collaborate with curriculum designers to create high-quality course deliverables

Nice to Have

  • Experience teaching a survey-style visual communication course that pairs design principles with visual analysis
  • Familiarity with accessibility standards (WCAG, color contrast, alt text) and copyright, fair use, and AI-generated imagery issues in visual media

What We Offer:

  • Reliable Payments: You'll receive payments twice a month and automated invoicing for your work.
  • Remote Work: This is a fully online contracted work-from-home opportunity.
  • Flexibility: Basically, there are no requirements! Work when you want, where you want, as often as you want, with no minimums/maximums.
  • Support: Our supportive staff is available answer your questions and help you get up and running.

The Contract Process

  1. Complete the application and submit with your resume.
  2. Applications are approved and contracts sent on Wednesdays.
  3. Submit the contract within the 5-day signing window.
  4. The following Wednesday, you’ll receive onboarding instructions.

You can view a step-by-step overview of the contract process here: How to Become a Freelancer with Study.com

About Study.com

The mission of Study.com is to make education accessible, and over the last two decades we’ve become the leading online education platform, delivering a personalized learning experience across a broad continuum of education for over 30 million students, instructors, and professionals every month.

We help empower millions of learners to achieve their education and career goals. We focus on increasing access to education because we know information is the ultimate equalizer and that education is key to upward mobility.

Feel free to share this opportunity with any friends you think would be interested, too.

raw.excerpt: Verndale is a digital experience agency dedicated to driving growth by helping businesses create meaningful human connections in an increasingly digital world.
raw.description:
Verndale is a digital experience agency dedicated to driving growth by helping businesses create meaningful human connections in an increasingly digital world. With offices in Boston, Montreal, Los Angeles, Quito, and hubs across the Americas, we partner with marketing and technology leaders to deliver personalized web, mobile, and ecommerce solutions that elevate customer experiences.

At Verndale, we thrive on collaboration and innovation, offering a full range of services that span strategy, design, development, personalization, SEO, analytics, and digital advertising. We celebrate diversity and inclusion, striving to create a climate of respect essential for both individual and company success.

If you're ready to be part of a passionate team dedicated to making an impact and driving growth, we invite you to explore a career at Verndale.

About the role

As we expand our Marketing Services practice, we are seeking an Associate Director, Content Strategy: a senior, client-facing content strategist who can lead enterprise content programs across discovery, design, build, migration, governance, AI search, personalization, and performance.

This role sits within the Marketing Services team and reports to the VP, Content Strategy. The Associate Director will help turn content strategy from a project deliverable into a governed content system that fuels discoverability, relevance, and measurable business impact across human and AI-driven journeys.

The ideal candidate is strategic and hands-on. They know how to build content strategy into complex digital programs, integrate it with design, technology, analytics, SEO, AI search, and personalization, and produce polished client-ready deliverables. They must also be AI fluent and ready to build practical solutions using AI tools, not simply experiment with them.

Verndale is fully remote enabled. This position can be remote, with a preference for candidates based in Canada.

Responsibilities

  • Lead content strategy workstreams across discovery, design, build, migration, and optimization programs.
  • Oversee and execute editorial content strategy, including content inventories, content assessments, transformation strategy, message planning, and editorial planning.
  • Oversee and execute UX content strategy, including content audits, gap analyses, taxonomies, content hierarchies, copy planning, and content planning for design and migration.
  • Oversee and execute delivery content strategy, including content matrices, governance models, workflows, guidelines, migration support, and authoring guidance.
  • Facilitate client workshops, stakeholder interviews, content working sessions, and alignment meetings that connect content decisions to business goals and audience needs.
  • Present polished deliverables, recommendations, project updates, and decision points to marketing, digital, technology, and executive stakeholders.
  • Design content approaches that support AI Search, Answer Engine Optimization, Generative Engine Optimization, personalization, site search, related content, filtering, and content reuse.
  • Develop structured, governed, machine-readable content strategies, including taxonomy, metadata, schema guidance, content models, prompt-ready source content, and reuse patterns.
  • Use AI tools to improve content inventories, audits, gap analyses, taxonomy exploration, migration mapping, content QA, prompt testing, answer testing, and content performance review.
  • Build repeatable AI-assisted workflows, prompts, QA routines, documentation, and review protocols that improve speed and quality without sacrificing judgment, accuracy, or governance.
  • Influence the pilot, adoption, and improvement of content-related AI tools in partnership with Strategy, SEO and AI, Personalization, Analytics, Experience Design, and Technology teams.
  • Help clients understand where AI can improve content operations, where human review is required, and how to govern AI-enabled content workflows responsibly.
  • Define and improve content lifecycle processes across planning, creation, review, approval, publishing, optimization, maintenance, and retirement.
  • Set content quality standards, review criteria, performance indicators, and documentation practices that can be used consistently across programs.
  • Identify process gaps, quality risks, content ownership issues, and workflow blockers, then recommend practical improvements.
  • Create content governance models that clarify roles, responsibilities, decision rights, approval paths, editorial standards, and maintenance cadences.
  • Support compliance-aware content processes for clients in regulated, brand-sensitive, or multi-stakeholder environments.
  • Use analytics and performance data to assess content effectiveness and inform future content planning, optimization, and governance decisions
  • Develop taxonomies, metadata models, tagging strategies, and structured data approaches that help power navigation, search, personalization, content relationships, and reporting.
  • Guide information architecture work including navigation strategy, sitemaps, content hierarchy, page-level content planning, and content inputs for wireframes and visual design.
  • Lead content migration strategy, including inventories, keep/edit/kill analysis, migration mapping, content matrices, content models, authoring requirements, and migration readiness.
  • Help establish repeatable methods and level-of-effort guidance for taxonomy, information architecture, and migration work so these activities can be scoped and delivered consistently.
  • Partner with Business Development, Client Services, and Practice Leads to shape content strategy solutions for proposals, pitch meetings, and active accounts.
  • Scope and estimate content strategy activities across discovery, redesign, migration, AI search, personalization, content operations, and optimization programs.
  • Contribute to packaged content strategy offerings, delivery standards, internal templates, case studies, POVs, and thought leadership.
  • Serve as a senior content strategy voice on strategic accounts and as an escalation point for content strategy delivery and quality.
  • Help identify opportunities to grow content strategy revenue within broader Marketing Services and Experience engagements.
  • Coach cross-functional teammates on content strategy methods, client facilitation, deliverable quality, and content decision-making.
  • Create enablement materials that help internal teams understand content strategy, AI-ready content, taxonomy, migration, and governance.
  • Lead through example, advocacy, and mentoring while supporting a collaborative, high-performing team culture.
  • Help build fluency in AI-assisted content workflows across the practice, including prompt development, source evaluation, quality review, and responsible tool use.

Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in content strategy, content design, content operations, digital strategy, or a closely related discipline.
  • 3+ years of experience leading workstreams, mentoring content strategists, enabling cross-functional teams, or guiding client stakeholders.
  • Deep experience across editorial content strategy, UX content strategy, delivery content strategy, content governance, and content operations.
  • Strong knowledge of digital redesigns, platform implementations, CMS programs, content migrations, and enterprise digital transformation activities.
  • Experience with content management systems and digital platforms such as Sitecore, Optimizely, Adobe Experience Manager, Contentstack, Drupal, WordPress, or similar systems.
  • Demonstrated ability to create taxonomies, metadata models, content models, information architecture inputs, content matrices, migration plans, and governance documentation.
  • AI fluency, including practical experience using generative AI and LLM-based tools to support content strategy, content operations, research synthesis, content QA, taxonomy development, migration planning, and optimization.
  • Readiness to build AI-assisted tools and workflows, including reusable prompts, review protocols, QA checklists, source-of-truth practices, and team enablement materials.
  • Working knowledge of how content strategy supports AI Search, AEO, GEO, site search, personalization, structured content, and measurable experience performance.
  • Experience defining content quality standards, performance measures, review criteria, and lifecycle processes for complex content programs.
  • Comfort using analytics, search data, content performance data, and qualitative research to inform recommendations.
  • Proven ability to facilitate workshops, lead client conversations, influence stakeholders, and present executive-ready recommendations.
  • Experience scoping and estimating content strategy work for proposals, statements of work, and active engagements.
  • Strong writing, storytelling, documentation, and communication skills across technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Experience in an agency, consulting, enterprise, healthcare, financial services, higher education, or other complex stakeholder environment preferred.
  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, English, Journalism, Digital Strategy, UX, Information Science, or a related field preferred, or commensurate experience

Ten Great Reasons to Work at Verndale

  1. We are a rapidly growing company that is just as scrappy and entrepreneurial today as when we were founded in 1998.
  2. We are relentlessly curious and enthusiastically solve our clients’ complex business problems through technology, data, and design.
  3. We foster a culture that enables every person in the organization to do the best work of their career.
  4. We offer regular training and professional development to move careers forward.
  5. Client and employee satisfaction are our two most important business metrics.
  6. We celebrate and champion diversity, equity, and inclusion.
  7. We offer generous paid company holidays, vacation, and paid sick time to every employee starting on day one.
  8. We offer top-of-the-line Health Insurance, plus monthly perks customized to meet individual employees’ needs.
  9. We support a healthy work/life balance.
  10. We are fully remote enabled and embrace the evolving definition of the workplace

Compensation & Benefits

In accordance with applicable law, the salary range provided is Verndale's reasonable estimate of the salary for this role. The actual amount may vary, based on non-discriminatory factors such as location, experience, knowledge, skills and abilities. In addition to salary, Verndale also offers a competitive benefits package.

Verndale is proud of the fun, diverse, and respectful company environment we enjoy on a daily basis. Competitive compensation and comprehensive coverage for medical, dental, life, disability and an RRSP savings plan are offered to all salaried, full-time employees. Ample company paid holidays and personal time off make having a work-life balance possible. For some roles, remote work is a definite possibility; we believe in hiring the best and keeping our own happy and motivated.

Verndale is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All employment decisions shall be made without regard to age, race, creed, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, citizenship status or any other basis as protected by federal, state, or local law.

  • Expert-level command of Google Ads (AdWords) — search, bidding strategies, account structure and optimisation

  • Experience in the Italian market (strong advantage); Italian language a plus

  • Data-driven mindset, fluent in analytics, attribution and continuous testing

WHAT WE OFFER:

  • Fully remote, freelance engagement with the freedom to organise your own work
  • A significant, established monthly ad budget to work with from day one
  • Proprietary in-house technology and real-time reporting instead of off-the-shelf tools

DISCLOSURES

The statements contained in this document describe the general scope and level of services expected under this engagement and are not intended to be all-inclusive. Responsibilities may evolve over time based on business growth, campaign performance needs, platform changes, or strategic direction. The Company will notify the contractor of any material changes to the scope of work.

ABOUT THE COMPANY

Enterprise Management Solutions, LLC (“EMS”) provides operational infrastructure, staffing solutions, marketing systems, and revenue enablement services for companies in real estate, property management, hospitality, healthcare, and service-based industries throughout the United States.

As EMS expands its in-house digital marketing division, the Company is building a structured performance marketing team that integrates paid media, funnel systems, CRM tracking, and creative strategy into a unified growth engine.

This role is central to that structure.

CLASSIFICATION: Exempt – Independent Contractor (Non-U.S., W-8BEN)

COMPENSATION RANGE: Equivalent to approximately USD $6.00–$7.50 per hour, based on experience, creative capability, and performance impact.

LOCATION: Philippines (Remote)This is an Philippines -based independent contractor engagement. This is NOT a U.S.-based position

POSITION TITLE: Creative Marketing Manager (Paid & Organic Content Strategy Lead)

DIVISION: Marketing & Sales

ACCOUNTABLE TO: Chief Marketing & Sales Officer

WORK SCHEDULE: Monday – Friday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM Eastern Time (U.S.)

The contractor must be actively available during these hours to collaborate with leadership, media buyers, and technical teams.

POSITION OVERVIEW

The Creative Marketing Manager is responsible for owning the creative direction, content strategy, brand consistency, and performance-oriented messaging across all marketing channels — both paid and organic.

As EMS brings advertising operations in-house, this role becomes the central creative authority within the organization. The individual in this position will ensure that all marketing output — including social media content, paid ad creative, landing page messaging, and branded marketing materials — is cohesive, strategically aligned, and performance-driven.

This is not a basic graphic design or social posting role. It is a hybrid strategic and execution-focused position that bridges creative development, performance marketing support, and brand management.

The Creative Marketing Manager works directly with:

  • Google Ads Manager
  • Meta Ads Manager
  • TikTok Ads Specialist
  • CTO / Funnel & Tech Team
  • Chief Marketing & Sales Officer
  • This role ensures that creative execution aligns with funnel structure, advertising strategy, and measurable growth objectives.

ROLE OBJECTIVE

The objective of this role is to:

  • Develop high-performing creative assets for paid campaigns
  • Maintain consistent brand identity across all platforms
  • Strengthen organic social presence and engagement
  • Align ad messaging with landing pages and conversion funnels
  • Continuously improve creative performance based on data
  • Performance in this role will directly impact advertising ROI, conversion rates, and brand perception.

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Creative Strategy & Messaging Development
  • The Creative Marketing Manager will develop and maintain overarching creative direction for the organization’s marketing initiatives. This includes defining messaging frameworks, value propositions, campaign themes, and visual direction.

Responsibilities include:

  • Developing campaign concepts aligned with company goals
  • Creating messaging angles for lead generation and brand authority
  • Identifying emotional triggers and hook strategies
  • Ensuring consistent tone and brand positioning
  • Collaborating with leadership to align content with strategic objectives
  • Paid Advertising Creative Support

This role serves as the primary creative partner to the paid media specialists.

Responsibilities include:

  • Producing static and video ad creative for:
  • Google Display & YouTube
  • Facebook & Instagram
  • TikTok
  • Writing high-converting ad copy
  • Creating visual mockups and structured testing variations
  • Developing creative testing roadmaps
  • Reviewing performance data to refine messaging and visuals
  • Managing creative refresh cycles to prevent fatigue
  • Creative must be developed with performance metrics in mind, not aesthetics alone.

Organic Social Media Management

  • The Creative Marketing Manager will oversee the company’s organic social presence by:
  • Developing and managing a structured content calendar
  • Creating posts that build authority, trust, and engagement
  • Publishing educational, promotional, and brand-building content
  • Monitoring engagement performance
  • Optimizing content direction based on data insights
  • The goal is to build brand credibility while supporting paid acquisition efforts.

Graphic Design & Marketing Materials

  • The role includes development of branded marketing assets such as:
  • Flyers and promotional materials
  • Digital brochures
  • Presentation decks
  • Email graphics
  • Social templates
  • Brand style guides
  • All materials must maintain consistency with company branding and visual standards.
  • Funnel & Creative Alignment
  • The Creative Marketing Manager must ensure that advertising creative aligns with conversion infrastructure.
  • Responsibilities include:
  • Reviewing landing page copy and visual layout for alignment with ads
  • Collaborating with the CTO and funnel team to ensure continuity of messaging
  • Identifying disconnects between ad promise and landing page delivery
  • Recommending improvements to strengthen conversion performance
  • Performance-Based Creative Optimization
  • Creative decisions must be guided by data.

The role includes:

  • Reviewing campaign performance reports
  • Identifying winning messaging angles
  • Improving underperforming creatives
  • Tracking CTR, conversion rate, engagement rate, and other relevant metrics
  • Developing monthly creative iteration plans

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • 3–6 years experience in digital marketing, creative strategy, or content marketing
  • Demonstrated experience creating performance-focused ad creative
  • Proficiency in Canva, Adobe Creative Suite, or equivalent tools
  • Basic video editing capability (CapCut, Premiere, or similar)
  • Understanding of paid advertising fundamentals
  • Strong copywriting ability
  • Ability to interpret performance data and adjust creative direction
  • Strong English communication skills
  • Ability to work aligned with U.S. Eastern Time

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience supporting Google Ads, Meta Ads, or TikTok campaigns
  • Experience creating UGC-style ad concepts
  • Experience working with U.S.-based clients
  • Experience developing brand guidelines

PERFORMANCE METRICS (KPIs)

  • Performance in this role will be evaluated based on:
  • Creative output consistency
  • Improvement in ad CTR and engagement rates
  • Reduction in creative fatigue
  • Alignment between ads and funnel messaging
  • Organic engagement growth
  • Brand consistency and professionalism

CAREER PATH

  • As EMS expands its in-house marketing operations, this role may evolve into:
  • Senior Creative Strategist
  • Paid Social Creative Director
  • Brand & Performance Marketing Director

WHY JOIN EMS

  • Fully remote Philippines-based contractor engagement
  • Stable PHP compensation structure
  • Direct involvement in building an in-house marketing division
  • Exposure to U.S.-based performance marketing
  • Clear growth pathway within a developing digital organization
Salary: $6.00–$7.50 per hour

raw.excerpt: About UpstartAt Upstart, we’re united by a mission that matters: to radically reduce the cost and complexity of borrowing for all Americans.
raw.description:
About Upstart

At Upstart, we’re united by a mission that matters: to radically reduce the cost and complexity of borrowing for all Americans. Every day, we bring creativity, experimentation, and advanced AI to reshape access to credit, helping millions move forward financially with clarity and confidence.

As the leading AI lending marketplace, we partner with banks and credit unions to expand access to affordable credit through technology that’s both radically intelligent and deeply human. Our platform runs over one million predictions per borrower using more than 3,000 signals, powering smarter, fairer decisions for millions of customers. But the numbers only hint at the impact. Every idea, every voice, and every contribution moves us closer to a world where credit never stands between people and their financial progress.

We’re proudly digital-first, giving most Upstarters the flexibility to do their best work from wherever they thrive, alongside teammates across 80+ cities in the US and Canada. Digital-first doesn’t mean distant. We’re intentional about in-person connection through team onsites, planning sessions, and moments that spark creativity and trust. And whether you choose to work primarily from home or collaborate in-person from one of our offices in Columbus, Austin, the Bay Area, or New York City, you’ll have the support to work in the way that works best for you.

If you’re energized by tackling meaningful problems, excited to innovate with purpose, and motivated by work that truly matters, we’d love to hear from you.

The Team:

Upstart’s Complaints team is responsible for investigating and resolving customer complaints across our lending products while helping protect customers and the business from regulatory and operational risk. The team partners closely with Operations, Legal, Compliance, and Risk to deliver timely and accurate resolutions and identify opportunities to improve the customer experience.

As a Senior Complaints Specialist at Upstart, you will investigate and resolve escalated and regulated customer complaints, applying regulatory knowledge and sound judgment to determine appropriate outcomes. You’ll also look beyond individual cases to identify recurring issues, surface trends, and help improve the processes and controls that shape the customer experience.

How you’ll make an impact

  • Manage a queue of customer complaints, completing accurate investigations and resolutions within established productivity, quality, and regulatory timelines.
  • Investigate sensitive, escalated, and regulated complaints, identify root causes and potential customer harm, and determine appropriate remediation.
  • Apply relevant consumer protection requirements, including FCRA, UDAAP, FDCPA, and ECOA, when evaluating complaints and potential regulatory concerns.
  • Produce clear, accurate written complaint responses and maintain documentation that supports complaint decisions and outcomes.
  • Analyze complaint trends and recurring issues to identify root causes and recommend improvements that reduce repeat complaints and customer harm.
  • Partner with Operations, Legal, Compliance, Risk, and other teams to strengthen complaint processes, customer experiences, and risk controls.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 1+ years experience handling regulatory escalated customer complaints within a financial institution, lending organization, or other regulated financial services environment (Consumer Financial Protection Bureau (CFPB), Better Business Bureau (BBB), State Attorney General, etc.)
  • Experience conducting complaint investigations, documenting findings, identifying root causes, and determining or recommending customer resolutions.
  • Experience applying consumer financial regulations or requirements to complaint investigations and customer outcomes.
  • Knowledge of consumer financial regulations such as the Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA), Unfair, Deceptive, or Abusive Acts or Practices (UDAAP), Fair Debt Collection Practices Act (FDCPA), and Equal Credit Opportunity Act (ECOA).

Preferred Qualifications

  • Certified Regulatory Compliance Manager (CRCM) certification.
  • Experience supporting auto lending or Home Equity Line of Credit (HELOC) products.
  • Ability to analyze complaint data and trends to identify recurring issues and recommend operational or customer experience improvements.
  • Ability to partner effectively across Operations, Legal, Compliance, Risk, and Product when resolving complex customer issues.

Position location This role is available in the following locations: Remote

Time zone requirements The team operates on the East/West coast time zones.

Travel requirements As a digital first company, the majority of your work can be accomplished remotely. The majority of our employees can live and work anywhere in the U.S but are encouraged to to still spend high quality time in-person collaborating via regular onsites. The in-person sessions’ cadence varies depending on the team and role; most teams meet once or twice per quarter for 2-4 consecutive days at a time.

This is a Non-Exempt position. Employees in this position are paid an hourly pay rate, on a bi-weekly basis, and are eligible to receive overtime pay for any hours worked over 40 in a work week, or over 8 in a work day if required by state law.

At Upstart, your base pay is one part of your total compensation package. The anticipated annualized base salary for this position is expected to be within the below range. Your actual base pay will depend on your geographic location–with our “digital first” philosophy, Upstart uses compensation regions that vary depending on location. Individual pay is also determined by job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. downtime.

Beyond Detecting. Start Deciding. Start Acting.

We are currently looking for talented and passionate Senior Regional Account Manager for KSA to join our EMEA enterprise sales team and develop and drive growth in the region. o Exceeds assigned sales quotas in designated region.

Organizational Alignment

At Parexel, we all share the same goal - to improve the world's health. From clinical trials to regulatory, consulting, and market access, every clinical development solution we provide is underpinned by something special - a deep conviction in what we do.

Each of us, no matter what we do at Parexel, contributes to the development of a therapy that ultimately will benefit a patient. We take our work personally, we do it with empathy and we're committed to making a difference.

Key Accountabilities:

Study Team Support

  • Participates in cross-functional study team meetings and workstreams to support the delivery of the precision medicine strategy for the assigned studies
  • Supports clinical study teams as subject-matter expert for technical and operational matters related to sample management and testing, including anticipating challenges, managing risk across projects and responding queries from internal and external stakeholders
  • Works with clinical study teams on the development and review of sample-related sections of study-specific documents such as the clinical protocol, Informed Consent Forms (ICFs) and sample management guidelines.
  • Supports project management and study set-up teams in the creation and validation of specialty laboratory databases for data collection and sample kit tracking

Operational Support of Biomarker and Exploratory Analysis

  • Manages all activities related to biosample process planning and execution, including storage, shipping, and data transfer throughout the study lifecycle
  • Oversees the acquisition and testing of clinical trial samples designated for biomarker research (including human tissue, whole blood, plasma, serum, etc.), liaising with relevant stakeholders to assess biosample vendors, review proposals/bids, and define contractual scope.
  • Forecasts operational costs and timelines, and manages budgeting, invoicing and reporting for study-related operations

Data Acquisition and Management

  • Works closely with data management and biostatistics leads to determine how biomarker data will be captured, blinded, transferred and reported for clinical trials
  • Develops and reviews data transfer specifications and related documents

Human Sample Management Flow and Compliance

  • Provides guidance and training to clinical teams and investigative sites regarding collection, storage and shipment of biospecimens to ensure compliance with the clinical protocol.
  • Works closely with relevant stakeholders to ensure all transfers of human samples are documented, tracked, used and destroyed according to standard operating procedures and regulatory requirements

Clinical Trial Supplies and Logistics

  • May have a dedicated role as clinical trial supplies and logistics lead, accountable for samples, kits, data operations and processes/standards related to global logistics and specialty vendor management within precision medicine
  • Manage and oversee kit inventories, clinical sample collection, tracking and data query resolution, regulatory submission documents related to kits and samples, global import/export documentation and proforma invoices, maintenance of laboratory information management systems (LIMS) and tracking of function specific metrics
  • Support the creation, implementation, monitoring and improvement of clinical study logistics strategies focused on precision medicine deliverables, including evaluating emerging technologies and vendors

Samples, Kits and Laboratory Operations Programming

  • May have a dedicated role as programming lead for clinical supplies and laboratory operations, supporting the development of tools and dashboards for tracking biomarker samples, kits, logistics and lab data throughout the study lifecycle.
  • Use technical tools, systems and programming languages to systematically aggregate, extract, process and assess data, including confidential data, according to industry standards and function or study-specific guidelines
  • Assess laboratory databases, resolve queries for biomarker data and support data management leads in database lock activities.

Compliance with Parexel Standards

  • Complies with timely completion of required training curriculum
  • Completes timesheets accurately as required
  • Submits expense reports as required
  • Updates CV as required
  • Maintains effective relationships with other platform lines, Business Units/Research Units, and enabling lines that facilitate effective portfolio delivery

Skills:

  • Strong project management and organization skills in a matrix environment
  • Analytical and problem-solving experience
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Effective communication and interpersonal skills, with proven ability to build relationships internally and externally
  • Fluent in speaking/writing English
  • Travel not expected but may occur periodically
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including strong excel knowledge, as well as relevant role specific systems
  • Proficiency in Python, R, Perl, SQL or other programming languages, as well as familiarity with APIs and Linux/Unix environments, if acting as programming lead for supplies and laboratory operations

Knowledge and Experience:

  • Minimum of 6 years clinical research experience with academic, Contract Research Organization, pharmaceutical or biotech industry
  • Working knowledge of clinical drug development process and clinical databases, as well as ICH, GCP guidelines, and US FDA and/or local country regulations as applicable

Education:

  • Requires bachelor degree in life sciences or equivalent (i.e., science, technology, engineering, or mathematics) or relevant work experience. Biology or equivalent major preferred.
