Job Description:

Senior Software Business Analyst


3M Health Care is now Solventum

At Solventum, we enable better, smarter, safer healthcare to improve lives. As a new company with a long legacy of creating breakthrough solutions for our customers’ toughest challenges, we pioneer game-changing innovations at the intersection of health, material and data science that change patients' lives for the better while enabling healthcare professionals to perform at their best. Because people, and their wellbeing, are at the heart of every scientific advancement we pursue.

We partner closely with the brightest minds in healthcare to ensure that every solution we create melds the latest technology with compassion and empathy. Because at Solventum, we never stop solving for you.

The Impact You’ll Make in this Role

As a Senior Software Business Analyst with Product Owner responsibilities, you will play a pivotal role in bridging the gap between business needs and technical requirements. You will collaborate closely with Product Leadership and stakeholders to understand their business requirements and translate them into clear and actionable specifications for our Delivery Team. You will be a key decision maker for clarifying intended outcomes, shaping work into valuable increments, and helping the team make sound trade-offs without escalating every decision.

Responsibilities:

  • Elicit, document, analyze, and track business requirements from stakeholders.
  • Translate business requirements into user stories ensuring clarity, accuracy, and testability.
  • Own, maintain, and order the team backlog based on product goals, customer value, risk, dependencies, and learning needs.
  • Translate product goals and features into understandable outcomes, increments of value, and team-level work.
  • Clarify customer, user, and stakeholder needs, including acceptance criteria, intended results, and relevant constraints.
  • Prepare work sufficiently to enable productive team conversations while avoiding unnecessary prescription of the technical implementation.
  • Balance features, defects, enablers, technical health, compliance needs, operational concerns, and discovery or learning work.
  • Partner with the delivery team to split work into small, testable, and valuable increments.
  • Accept completed work from a product and value perspective, confirming that it satisfies the agreed need and acceptance criteria.
  • Collaborate continuously with the Delivery Team, Product Manager, and stakeholders to maintain alignment and address emerging information.
  • Communicate priority, scope, decisions, and trade-offs clearly so the team understands what matters now and what comes next.
  • Use feedback and delivery evidence to refine priorities and recommend adjustments to product direction.
  • Participate in continuously evaluating and improving internal processes and methods.
  • Develop a deep understanding of the application components and become a subject matter expert on the features and workflows.


Your Skills and Expertise


To set you up for success in this role from day one, Solventum requires (at a minimum) the following qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, or a related field and seven or more years of experience working in product delivery, business analysis, product ownership, or a closely related role.

OR

  • HS/GED and eleven or more years experience working in product delivery, business analysis, product ownership, or a closely related role.

Additional qualifications that would help you succeed in this role include:

  • Self-starter with a high level of initiative desiring to be a member of a High Performing Team in a complex working environment.
  • Very strong organizational skills with attention to detail.
  • Complex Delivery Experience: Proven ability to deliver in large-scale, complex environments involving multiple stakeholders, multi-scrum teams, and multi-platform features requiring coordinated releases.
  • Front-End Development Expertise: Hands-on experience with customer-facing web solutions, including creating and enhancing customer journeys through workflow definition in collaboration with UX Designers and Researchers.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively engage with stakeholders at all levels.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate business or product goals into clear outcomes, acceptance criteria, and ordered work.
  • Ability to make timely decisions and explain trade-offs using customer value, evidence, risk, and product context.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including facilitation across technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Strong knowledge of iterative or agile product delivery practices and backlog management.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively while maintaining clear accountability for team-level product decisions.

  • Experience in Orthodontics or Dentistry
  • Experience in Healthcare or other regulated industry.
  • Experience with BDD/Gherkin Acceptance Criteria format.
  • Experience in Azure DevOps (Boards).

We put our people and customers above process, avoid company-wide rules as much as possible, and have the courage to take unusual approaches to advance our mission. With this approach, we believe we can create a more flexible, fun, stimulating, creative, collaborative, and innovative organization.

Our commitment to developing, practicing and promoting direct and open communication, responsibility and freedom, and leading with and seeking context is a responsibility for every role at Tidal Vision.

JOB SUMMARY:

The Director, Portfolio Strategy & Product Marketing leads the commercial strategy and market success of Tidal Grow AgriScience’s product portfolio. The role owns segmentation, targeting, positioning, pricing, channel strategy, label and claims strategy, launch planning, and lifecycle commercialization.

This role is a critical member of the Product organization, working alongside Product Management and R&D to shape and commercialize Tidal Grow AgriScience's product portfolio. As the portfolio's commercial leader, the Director drives market strategy, positioning, pricing, channel strategy, launch planning, and lifecycle commercialization to ensure products achieve successful market adoption and long-term growth.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:

  • Lead portfolio commercialization strategy across crop nutrition, biostimulant, and crop protection markets.
  • Own segmentation, targeting, positioning, value propositions, pricing architecture, and channel strategy.
  • Own the commercial direction of each product from development through launch and lifecycle management.
  • Own label and claims strategy, partnering with Regulatory on registrations, substantiation, and compliance.
  • Partner with Product Managers to translate technical capabilities, efficacy data, and customer needs into commercially successful products.
  • Partner with Marketing to establish promotional strategy, message hierarchy, proof points, and sales-enablement priorities; Marketing owns creative development and execution.
  • Build market, customer, competitive, pricing, and channel intelligence into portfolio plans, business cases, forecasts, and commercialization decisions.
  • Work with the Chief Product Officer on product vision, roadmap priorities, portfolio architecture, and investment decisions.
  • Align Product Management, R&D, Commercial Ag Science, Regulatory, Marketing, Sales, and Operations around commercialization plans and market outcomes.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor’s degree in agriculture, agronomy, agricultural economics, marketing, business, crop science, or a related field.
  • At least 15 years of progressive experience in agricultural product marketing, portfolio strategy, product management, market development, or commercial leadership.
  • Commercial leadership experience across both crop nutrition/fertilizer and crop protection.
  • Proven success leading segmentation, positioning, pricing, channel, launch, lifecycle, and portfolio strategies for agricultural products.
  • Strong understanding of grower economics, agricultural distribution, retail channels, product labels, claims, and commercialization requirements.
  • Ability to translate technical and field-performance data into differentiated value propositions and commercially compelling strategies.
  • Strong financial acumen and experience developing value-based pricing, channel economics, and product business cases.
  • Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams and drive decisions without direct authority.
  • Executive-level communication, judgment, and presence.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • MBA or advanced degree in agribusiness, marketing, agricultural economics, agronomy, or a related field.
  • Experience leading a multi-product portfolio within an established agricultural input company.
  • Experience launching and scaling innovative or technically differentiated agricultural products.
  • Experience across distributor, retailer, and direct-to-grower channels.
  • Success operating in an entrepreneurial or rapidly scaling business.

Licensing & Special Requirements

Site Reliability Engineer Engineer

Remote, Contract

About Us

Modus Create is a digital consulting partner that helps ambitious organizations design, build, and modernize digital products, platforms, and AI-powered experiences. We work shoulder-to-shoulder with client teams to move from idea to production quickly and sustainably, with a clear path to scale.

Founded in 2011, Modus is a global, fully remote team of world-class technologists who thrive in a collaborative, innovative environment. We're a digital product engineering partner for forward-thinking businesses. Our global teams work side-by-side with clients to design, build, and scale custom solutions that achieve real results and lasting change, partnering with industry leaders including AWS, GitHub, and Atlassian.

We were fully remote before it was cool! Recognized as one of the Inc. 5000 Fastest Growing Private Companies for nine years and a top remote work company by FlexJobs, we have helped some of the world's largest brands deliver powerful digital experiences.

Opportunity

We are seeking an experienced Site Reliability Engineer to build reliable, observable systems that enable client teams to operate with confidence at scale. You'll work embedded within cross-functional teams—partnering with developers, platform engineers, and operations teams—to reduce toil, improve system reliability, and prevent incidents before they impact users.

As a Senior Site Reliability Engineer, you take ownership of system reliability across our full backend stack—from AWS infrastructure (ALB, ECS/Fargate, Aurora) to Python services. You design and maintain observability systems, define SLAs and error budgets, build incident response processes, and drive improvements in uptime and performance. You'll participate in 24/7 P0 on-call rotations with a 10-minute acknowledgment SLA, lead incident investigations and postmortems, and help teams shift from reactive firefighting to proactive reliability engineering. You'll also mentor and onboard additional SRE engineers as the team scales from 4 to 8-12 over the coming months.

The Site Reliability Engineer will work shoulder-to-shoulder with cross-functional teams to ensure systems remain resilient, scalable, and observable across client environments. You'll also have opportunities to advise leadership on reliability strategy and help shape how organizations approach operational excellence.

Requirements

  • 6+ years hands-on experience in SRE, DevOps, or Platform Engineering at scale
  • Strong proficiency in one cloud platform: Deep AWS expertise (ALB, ECS/Fargate, RDS Aurora, Lambda, IAM)
  • Production Python backend engineering experience; comfortable debugging and optimizing Python services in containers and Lambdas
  • Site Reliability Engineering roles require participation in the on-call rotation, with support duty during and after business hours
  • Experience building or bootstrapping SRE programs from scratch
  • Hands-on experience with incident response, on-call rotations, postmortems, and SLOs
  • Deep experience designing and implementing observability (metrics, logging, tracing, alerting)
  • Solid understanding of containerization (Kubernetes, Docker) and deployment automation
  • Experience writing and maintaining infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, CloudFormation, Pulumi, etc.)
  • Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines and deployment strategies
  • Ability to troubleshoot distributed systems and production issues with debugging complex failures
  • Clear communication skills and the ability to explain reliability trade-offs to stakeholders
  • Scripting proficiency (Python, Bash, Go); Linux/Unix administration fundamentals
  • Version control (Git), collaboration workflows, and infrastructure automation patterns

Key Responsibilities & Deliverables

  • Design observability systems (metrics, logging, tracing) and define SLOs, error budgets, and monitoring strategies aligned with business needs
  • Own 24/7 P0 on-call rotation with 10-minute acknowledgment SLA; validate and escalate AI-generated incident reports to platform teams
  • Establish reliability standards and SLA targets for backend services
  • Mentor and onboard additional SRE engineers as team scales to 8-12
  • Participate in incident response, troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and postmortems
  • Implement reliability improvements, capacity planning, and performance optimization
  • Build self-healing automation and toil-reduction initiatives to minimize manual operational work
  • Collaborate with teams to integrate reliability and observability into delivery
  • Support modern workloads including AI applications and services; understand their operational and reliability requirements
  • Create runbooks, architecture documentation, and troubleshooting guides to enable independence
  • Review infrastructure changes and contribute to reliability standards and consistency
  • Actively tune systems for latency, throughput, and resource efficiency based on observability data

Team Collaboration

  • Availability for regular working sessions and discovery workshops with client teams
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating with client & Modus leaders
  • Overlap with client business hours daily is expected
  • Reliable high-speed internet is a must
  • Documenting solutions, sharing learnings with the team, contributing to internal wikis and runbooks
  • Pair program and collaborate on complex reliability and operational problems
  • Welcome code and architecture reviews; seek input on reliability designs
  • Ability to coordinate with security, platform, and development teams on reliability and operations

Bonus Skills

  • Experience designing or operating internal developer platforms
  • Familiarity with chaos engineering, resilience testing, or failure scenario planning
  • Cloud security and compliance experience (audit readiness, security hardening)
  • Experience with AI infrastructure, LLM serving, or agentic system operations
  • Mentoring junior engineers or leading technical design discussions
  • Cost optimization and cloud FinOps practices
  • Experience with AI-generated incident reports and validation workflows
  • Python performance tuning and backend optimization
  • Building SRE programs in high-growth or fast-scaling environments

You’ll Love

  • Learn from every incident and continuously improve systems
  • Solve challenging reliability, observability, and operational problems
  • Work with modern cloud platforms, Kubernetes, infrastructure-as-code, and observability
  • Make a direct impact on system uptime, performance, and operational efficiency
  • Collaborate with great teams and help shape enterprise reliability and SRE best practices
  • Support teams operating AI applications and services reliably and safely at scale
  • By joining our team, you'll be part of a winning squad that plays to each other's strengths and celebrates every success together

POSITION SUMMARY
The Statutory Accounting Manager manages various accounting functions including ledger maintenance, audits, accounts payable, accounts receivable, revenue and asset accounting, as well as associated analysis and reporting. This role evaluates and makes improvements to accounting processes while ensuring that practices comply with organization accounting policies and applicable laws and regulations. Lastly, this role leads and directs accounting professional and support staff, including subordinate supervisors.

PRINCIPAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES
• Manage timely and efficient month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close processes.
• Manage account analysis to ensure variances are explained accurately.
• Oversee the integrity of accounting records by ensuring that staff complies with organization accounting policies and procedures.
• Manage, track and fulfill requests from auditor requests.
• Manage finance quality assurance audit processes.
• Manage timely delivery of accurate documentation, reconciliations and reports to fulfill audit requests.
• Evaluate and recommend improvements to streamline Accounting processes, including enhancements to general ledger software and billing system.
• Resolve escalated issues arising from operations and coordinate with other departments.
• Liaise with the bank and other parties.
• Manage and develop accounting staff. Provide direction and guidance as needed to accomplish team goals.
• Perform backup duties within the department as required.

SPECIFIC DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES (ACCOUNTING MANAGER) – FINANCIAL ACCOUNTING
• Manage preparation of accurate and timely financial statements in accordance with statutory accounting practices.
• Ensure that department goals are met and adhere to approved budgets.
• Manage development and preparation of complex balance sheets, profit and loss statements and other financial reports.
• Review analysis of current costs, revenues, financial commitments, and obligations incurred to assist in budgeting for future revenues and expenses.
• Manage preparation of draft audited financial reports for external auditors.

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE
• Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Business Administration or equivalent.
• 5 to 7 years of relevant accounting experience.
• 5 to 7 years of statutory accounting experience required for Financial Accounting Manager.
• 3 to 5 years of supervisory experience.
• Intermediate to advanced Microsoft Excel and Word skills.
• Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, ability to prioritize and meet deadlines.
• Excellent oral and written communication skills.
• Strong knowledge of Microsoft Dynamics Great Plains desirable.
• Exposure to insurance systems and knowledge of insurance preferred.

About the Role

We are seeking a motivated and technically skilled AI/ML Engineer to join our engineering team. The ideal candidate will have a strong foundation in Python programming, machine learning concepts, PyTorch, and API development.

In this role, you will help design, develop, evaluate, and deploy machine learning models and AI-powered applications. You will collaborate with software engineers, data scientists, and product teams to turn data and machine learning research into reliable, scalable solutions.

This opportunity is suitable for recent graduates and early-career professionals with 0–3 years of experience who are passionate about artificial intelligence, machine learning, and building real-world AI applications.

Location requirement: Applicants must currently reside in the United States. This position is fully remote, subject to the employer's approved U.S. work locations and employment requirements.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, train, test, and evaluate machine learning models using Python and PyTorch.

  • Implement machine learning algorithms for classification, regression, prediction, and other relevant use cases.

  • Prepare, clean, preprocess, and analyze datasets for model training and evaluation.

  • Build reusable Python modules and maintain clean, well-documented code.

  • Develop and integrate REST APIs to serve machine learning models and AI-powered features.

  • Evaluate model performance using appropriate metrics and validation techniques.

  • Collaborate with software engineers, data scientists, and product teams to deliver AI solutions.

  • Assist with deploying machine learning models into development, testing, and production environments.

  • Troubleshoot model errors, API issues, and data quality problems.

  • Follow software engineering best practices, including Git version control, code reviews, and automated testing.

  • Stay current with emerging AI/ML techniques, frameworks, and development tools.

  • Good written and verbal communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Exposure to natural language processing (NLP), computer vision, or generative AI.

  • Familiarity with FastAPI, Flask, or similar frameworks for deploying model-serving APIs.

  • Exposure to cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.

  • Familiarity with Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing.

Join the team who have created awarded winning experiences, now creating Until Dawn 2!

We are looking for an experienced, driven planner with a background in Cinematic Production for games. You will be overseeing the cinematic pipeline from data ingest through delivery of cinematics.

You are an expert in bringing together multi-disciplinary teams to make memorable, emotional, and cinematic experiences, with a strong understanding of Narrative, Cinematic Production and Post-Production pipelines within video games.

As Principal Cinematic Producer you will work in partnership with the Production Director and other Lead Producers to develop and maintain the Cinematic workflow from concept to final delivery. Working collaboratively cross-discipline with designers, programmers, and audio teams to blur the lines between cinematics and gameplay to develop high-quality narrative gameplay experiences.

This role is suitable for remote workers with occasional travel to the UK office and to UK based shoots when possible.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Accountable for the discipline, consistency, efficiency and quality of output of the Cinematic Teams, including all the work produced for key milestones, alongside close collaboration with the Cinematic and Cinematography directors.
  • Establishes and maintains best practices for cinematic production, leading the charge on refining and maintaining cinematic backlogs and roadmaps.
  • Works with the Principal Producer responsible for shoots to ensure crystal clear communication of shoot deliverables, priorities, last minute changes and updates both to, and from, the shoot team.

Desirable Skills:

  • Certified Scrum Master (CSM).
  • Experience on multiple large scale, 150+ person AAA games through all phases of production from concept to release.

Please note, Sony Interactive Entertainment conducts background checks at the offer stage for all new employees (which may include criminal background checks for some roles) and will need to process personal information to support these checks.

Please refer to our Candidate Privacy Notice for more information about what personal information we collect, how we use it, who we share it with, and your data protection rights.

Firesprite is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, with a commitment to a culture of inclusion and mutual respect for all employees from every walk of life, reflecting the community we make games for. We welcome and encourage applications from all suitable applicants regardless of age, disability, sex, gender reassignment, sexual orientation, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief and marriage and civil partnerships.

raw.description:
At Oritain, we’re solving a problem most people don’t even realize exists until it matters. Where did this product really come from? Is it what it claims to be?

We are global leaders in product origin verification, with locations in Washington D.C, Auckland, Dunedin, London, Paris and Singapore.

We sit at the intersection of forensic science and supply chain technology, harnessing science and data to verify the genuine origin of materials across the world's most critical commodities. Our mission is to protect people and the planet by ensuring transparency and integrity in global supply chains. We empower the world’s leading brands to make positive changes across their supply chain; ensuring product integrity, meeting regulatory demands, and reducing the risk of fraud and unethical sourcing - creating real change in our world.

As demand for supply chain transparency continues to grow across the US market, we are seeking an Account Executive to join our US sales team.

About the role:As an Account Executive, Americas, you'll play a key role in accelerating Oritain's growth across the US, helping leading brands and retailers build more transparent, trusted and resilient supply chains. Reporting to the SVP of sales, you'll own the full sales cycle, from initial engagement through to signed membership agreements, closing mid-market opportunities.

This is an exciting opportunity for an ambitious sales professional who wants to develop their consultative selling expertise in a highly relevant market. You'll engage senior stakeholders, challenge conventional thinking, and position Oritain as a trusted advisor in supply chain traceability, compliance and sustainability. Supported by SDR and Marketing-generated opportunities, you'll also take ownership of building your own pipeline and creating new business opportunities.

What you'll be doing

You'll own and manage the complete sales cycle, taking opportunities from prospecting and qualification through to proposal, negotiation and close. Working with mid-market brands and retailers across the US, you'll build strong business cases, lead commercially focused conversations and create solutions that deliver value for customers while helping Oritain achieve its growth ambitions.
A key part of the role will be developing and executing a territory plan, maintaining a healthy pipeline and generating new business opportunities through targeted outreach, referrals, networking and industry events. You'll work closely with our SDR and Marketing teams to maximise opportunity creation while ensuring your own prospecting efforts complement wider sales activity.
You'll use insight-led selling techniques to engage senior stakeholders across sourcing, compliance and sustainability functions, positioning yourself as a trusted advisor rather than simply a supplier. By understanding each customer's business, regulatory challenges and strategic priorities, you'll help them navigate increasingly complex supply chain risks and make informed decisions.
Working cross-functionally with colleagues across Science, Legal, Marketing and Account Management, you'll help progress opportunities efficiently and ensure customers experience a smooth transition following a successful sale. You'll also maintain accurate Salesforce records, provide reliable forecasts and use sales and AI tools to continuously improve performance, identify deal risks and increase sales effectiveness.
As a representative of Oritain in the market, you'll attend industry events (up to 20% travel), build valuable relationships and stay informed on emerging regulations and trends that influence customer priorities across supply chain transparency, compliance and sustainability.

What we're looking for

We're looking for an early career salesperson with two + years' experience in a quota-carrying B2B closing role, such as Account Executive or Sales Executive. You'll have a track record of achieving or exceeding targets and experience managing full sales cycles, including opportunities you've sourced yourself. Experience selling into mid-market organizations with multiple stakeholders and longer sales cycles will be important for success in this role.
You'll be comfortable building pipeline through proactive prospecting and relationship development, rather than relying solely on inbound leads. Strong communication skills are essential, as you'll need to simplify complex concepts for business buyers and influence senior decision-makers with confidence. Experience using Salesforce as well as modern sales and AI tools will help you hit the ground running. You'll also be willing to travel across North America when required.
Beyond experience, we're looking for someone who is naturally curious, takes ownership of their results and brings energy and resilience to every conversation. You plan effectively, manage your time well and maintain a disciplined approach to pipeline management and forecasting. Most importantly, you're someone who builds trust through strong listening skills, empathy and a genuine desire to understand customer challenges and help solve them.
Experience in risk, compliance, ESG, sustainability or supply chain-related sales would be advantageous, as would an interest in fashion, textiles, science or sustainability. However, these are not essential requirements.

What you'll get

At Oritain, exceptional performance doesn't go unnoticed. We believe in rewarding high performers with meaningful opportunities, whether that's taking on projects, influencing business decisions, or accelerating your career development.
As a member of our global commercial team, you'll work closely with colleagues across Sales, Marketing, Science, Legal and Customer teams, giving you broad exposure across the business and the opportunity to make a visible impact on Oritain's continued growth. You'll have access to senior leaders, collaborate with experts in their fields and contribute to solving some of the most important challenges facing global supply chains today.
In return for your ambition and impact, you'll join a collaborative, purpose driven organization where your growth is taken seriously, your work has real influence, and your success is recognized.
Additional compensation, commission and benefits:
  • Salary $80,000 - $120,000
  • OTE $120,000 - $160,000
  • Life insurance and critical illness cover
  • Medical insurance
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • 401(k)
  • Learning portal with over 100,000 assets for professional development

As a Staff Design Researcher on the Platform Design and Research team within the Platform group, you'll set the research vision and practice across the systems, tools, and infrastructure that power Coinbase. What you’ll do:

  • Partner with senior product, design, and engineering leaders as a cross-functional lead in all stages of strategy planning, influencing roadmaps and investment decisions through evidence-based research and well-crafted design presentations.
  • Drive improvements in design consistency and integrity across your product area, contributing to existing design systems and creating new solutions when needed, while building research repositories and frameworks that scale research impact across the broader Design and Research organization.

raw.description:
About Us

At Prenuvo, we are on a mission to flip the paradigm from reactive “sick-care” to proactive health care. Our award-winning whole body scan is fast (under 1 hour), safe (MRI has no ionizing radiation), and non-invasive (no contrast). Our unique integrated stack of optimized hardware, software, and increasingly AI, coupled with the patient-centric experience across our domestic and global clinics, have allowed us to lead the change against “we caught it too late again".

The Senior Engineer II role is a senior technical leadership position responsible for delivering complex software solutions, driving technical strategy, and elevating engineering quality across teams. In this role, the engineer is expected to independently lead large, ambiguous, or mission-critical initiatives and coordinate work across multiple engineering groups and stakeholders.

This role does not provide visa sponsorship. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of hire and must not require employer sponsorship for a work visa (current or future).

Help reshape the world through proactive healthcare while working with cutting-edge technology and high performing teams with deep expertise - join us to make a difference in people’s lives!

What You’ll Do

  • Develop complex software solutions: Lead end-to-end delivery of large or ambiguous initiatives that span multiple systems or teams, leveraging AI-assisted coding tools and autonomous development workflows where applicable.
  • Own and lead projects: Take full ownership of project execution, from design through rollout, integrating agentic workflows and automated guardrails to ensure technical and business goals are met.
  • Provide technical guidance: Offer deep expertise to team members, supporting them through code reviews, architectural decisions, and best practices for collaborating with AI coding agents.
  • Mentor junior engineers: Coach less-experienced colleagues, helping them grow their technical, design, and problem-solving capabilities while effectively utilizing agentic tools.
  • Contribute to strategic planning: Participate in high-level planning discussions, informing the technical direction of key initiatives including the adoption of agentic SDLC practices.
  • Solve complex engineering problems: Independently diagnose and resolve the hardest technical issues in the domain, utilizing agent-driven debugging and novel solutions.
  • Influence technical direction: Play a meaningful role in shaping project- and team-level technical decisions and long-term architectural evolution toward modern agentic development patterns.
  • Ensure system reliability: Lead improvements in reliability, scalability, observability, and incident response; help define standards and processes that support operational excellence in automated and agent-driven environments.
  • Raise engineering quality: Improve engineering patterns, tooling, documentation, and processes that increase productivity and code quality across multiple teams, incorporating automated code review and refactoring agents.
  • Communicate at a senior level: Clearly articulate complex technical concepts to engineers, product managers, and leadership; serve as a trusted technical voice on modern software practices.
  • Manage ambiguity: Operate effectively in undefined or rapidly evolving situations, bringing clarity, structure, and direction for others, particularly in the transition toward agentic SDLC.

What You’ll Bring

  • 7+ years of experience delivering complex software systems and solving technical challenges.
  • Strong backend experience architecting and building robust services using Python, Flask, and/or FastAPI.
  • Experience writing comprehensive backend tests (e.g., Pytest) and ensuring strong test coverage.
  • Familiarity or decent frontend experience with frameworks like React, Next.js, and Typescript is a plus.
  • Ability to break down complex projects into components or milestones that other engineers can easily pick up.
  • Motivation to influence our engineering organization to level up the quality, reliability, and performance of the services we ship.
  • Demonstrated collaboration with co-workers on cross-functional teams.
  • Experience building consumer-facing applications and internal tools.

Our Values

First: we are Pioneers

  • Transforming healthcare requires divergent thinking, bias for action, disciplined experimentation, and consistent grit and determination to maintain momentum. This journey is as challenging as it is rewarding.

Second: we are Platform-Builders

  • We’re always building foundations that allow us to achieve tomorrow more than we did today. We never lose sight of what’s ahead – in a mindset of ownership and duty to our mission.

Above all: we are Patients

  • We could all be the next person who walks through our very doors, seeking clarity or peace of mind. We are proud of our impact on our patients’ lives, and we won’t stop till everyone can benefit from our work.

What We Offer

  • An avenue to make a positive impact on people's lives and their health
  • We believe in preventative healthcare for everyone, including our team - Prenuvo provides free, whole-body scans to each team member
  • Growth opportunities are at the heart of our people journey, we’re doing big things with bright minds - there is no single path to success, it can be shaped along the way
  • Building strong relationships is at the core of everything we do - our team gets together each week to connect, share, and socialize
  • Recognizing time away to restore is vital to our wellbeing - we have a flexible vacation policy and we will encourage you to use it
  • Prenuvo offers a 401(k) retirement savings plan to eligible employees, allowing team members to make pre-tax contributions toward their retirement. While Prenuvo facilitates access to the plan, the company does not currently offer matching contributions.
  • We offer a comprehensive benefits package including health, dental, vision, including Mental Health coverage, to support you and your family
  • The base salary for this role ranges from $170,000-$185,000 in local currency, depending upon experience and geographic location

We are an equal-opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

As part of the hiring process, successful candidates will undergo a background check in compliance to applicable federal, provincial, and state rules.

If you are contacted by a recruiter, please ensure their email address ends with @prenuvo.com. We do not use third-party recruitment services or any other email domains for hiring purposes. raw.description:
Hypori, Inc. is a high-growth cybersecurity SaaS company transforming how organizations think about secure mobility. Our virtual workspace platform enables users to access enterprise apps and data from any mobile device—with zero data on the endpoint and total personal privacy. Backed by $55M in funding from investors including UBS, AE Industrial Partners, Hale Capital Partners, and GreatPoint Ventures, Hypori is expanding into new commercial and regulated markets. Learn more at hypori.com.

Hypori is looking for a hands-on Channel Sales Engineer to join our growing commercial sales team. You will be the technical engine behind our channel program, enabling engineers at MSSPs, MSPs, RPOs, and C3PAOs to sell, scope, and deploy Hypori on their own. You will work alongside the Channel Account Manager and report to the VP of Commercial Sales.

Most of the 100,000+ companies in the Defense Industrial Base buy security through the partner that runs their IT, and those partners only sell what their own engineers trust. Hypori is proven at scale, with more than 95,000 Department of War users and IL5, FedRAMP High, NIAP Common Criteria, NSA CSfC, CMMC 2.0 Level 2, and SOC 2 Type II. The channel program is new, and the person in this seat builds its technical foundation. Success is measured by partner-sourced pipeline, technical win rate, and partners who can run a deal without you.

Responsibilities

  • Build the partner technical certification path with the Channel Account Manager
  • Enable partner engineers to demo, scope, and deploy Hypori without us in the room, taking every new partner from signature to first deployment
  • Maintain reference architectures, deployment guides, and partner lab environments
  • Equip partner sellers and compliance leads to defend the CMMC scope reduction argument
  • Understand the why first: why the partner’s or client’s current setup isn’t enough, why now, why Hypori, and why not the status quo
  • Lead discovery, demos, and proof-of-value engagements on partner-led deals against agreed success criteria
  • Use MEDDPICC to validate technical decision criteria, build technical champions, and flag unqualified deals early
  • Scope deployments across identity, multi-tenant design, app delivery, licensing, and the assessment boundary
  • Answer security questionnaires, RFIs, and shared responsibility requests
  • Help partners package Hypori into managed service offerings with multi-tenant administration and RMM, PSA, and SIEM integrations
  • Bring partner and field requirements to Product and Engineering
  • Support channel campaigns, webinars, and events, including CMMC CON
  • Over time, help stand up the technical foundation for a broader security reseller and solution provider channel

Qualifications

  • 3–5 years as a sales engineer, solutions engineer, or solutions architect at a SaaS cybersecurity vendor, MSP, or MSSP
  • A track record supporting cybersecurity sales, with measurable technical win rates
  • Hands-on experience enabling MSP or MSSP partners, including building your own certification and enablement content
  • CMMC 2.0 and NIST SP 800-171 depth. Be ready to scope an assessment boundary and defend scope reduction in the interview
  • Endpoint security architecture expertise across mobile, identity, and data protection
  • MEDDPICC fluency and strong Salesforce hygiene
  • Location: Remote, United States, with travel up to 40 percent to partner sites and industry events

Who You Are

  • Speed: You move with urgency and get things done today, not next week
  • Focus: You spend your time on the partners and deals that will actually move
  • Extreme ownership: Partner readiness and technical wins are yours. No excuses
  • Accountability: You do what you say, when you say. You flag slips early
  • Coachability: You ask for feedback, act on it, and get better
  • Humility: You know what you don’t know, and you say so
  • Creativity: You find new ways to make partner engineers self-sufficient

Preferred Attributes

  • Technical credibility: The bar is high. You need credibility with a partner’s lead engineer and compliance lead, on your own
  • CMMC and 800-171: CUI vs. FCI, the 5 asset categories, how an unmanaged device moves from CUI Asset to out of scope, the External Service Provider question, FedRAMP Moderate equivalency under DFARS 7012, and SPRS scoring
  • Microsoft 365 GCC High: Commercial vs. GCC vs. GCC High, enclave vs. full-tenant migration, and where Hypori shrinks the GCC High footprint
  • Endpoint and mobile security: MDM, UEM, MAM, mobile threat defense, EDR, enterprise browser, VDI, and DaaS. You know where the data rests in each
  • Identity and networking: SSO, SAML, SCIM, conditional access, Entra ID, Okta, derived credentials for CAC and PIV, and cloud networking in AWS and Azure
  • Prior time at an MSP, MSSP, RPO, or C3PAO serving defense contractors
  • CMMC CCP or CCA, CISSP, Security+, or Microsoft security certifications
  • Experience in an early-stage channel program
  • Military service or Department of War civilian experience

About Us

Compensation: $200,000 – $225,000 on-target earnings, split 80/20 between base salary and variable compensation ($160,000 – $180,000 base salary, commensurate with experience), plus equity. Targets are based on partner-sourced channel bookings, partner technical certifications, and technical win rate.

About Us

Hypori Inc. provides a generous benefits package for full-time employees that includes medical, dental, and vision insurance, parental leave, and life and disability packages. We also invest in our employees' futures by providing a 401(k) plan with employer-matching contributions that vest starting from your first day of employment. In addition to the base compensation, Hypori also offers a performance bonus, which is primarily contingent upon company-wide performance. We are dedicated to investing in the tools and skills required to be strong, collaborative colleagues and people managers to help build and retain a strong workforce.

Hypori is an Equal Employment and Affirmative Action Employer. At Hypori, we are committed to creating and promoting an inclusive workplace that embraces differences and perspectives – making us a stronger, more successful company. In doing so, we are committed to providing reasonable accommodation to applicants with disabilities where appropriate. Applicants requiring reasonable accommodation for any part of the application or hiring process should contact for assistance.

Join Furnished Quarters and help shape the future of our brand.

raw.description:
Senior Frontend Engineer

About Inco

Inco is building the confidentiality layer for blockchains through encryption technologies. We’re building the next generation of secure, scalable, and privacy-enhancing solutions for Web3, enabling fintech, payments, and blockchain applications to have the same confidentiality and capabilities users expect from Web2.

Who You Are

We’re looking for a senior frontend engineer who has built production-grade Web3 user experiences and understands the unique complexity of blockchain applications.

You have strong frontend fundamentals, but you also understand that Web3 frontend engineering is not just about building interfaces. It requires safely fetching and interpreting onchain data, integrating wallets, handling signatures, managing client-side state, and designing user flows where security and correctness matter.

You should be comfortable building polished, reliable UIs while also thinking deeply about how users interact with wallets, sign messages, grant permissions, manage session keys, and execute intent-based flows. You understand the security risks of asking users to sign transactions or messages, and you care about making those flows clear, safe, and difficult to misuse.

We’re looking for someone senior who can own frontend architecture end-to-end, raise engineering standards, and mentor more junior engineers. You should be the type of person who can turn ambiguous product requirements into secure, elegant, production-ready user experiences.

This role is remote / hybrid / based in Bangalore (preferred).

Responsibilities

Frontend Architecture & Development

  • Design, build, and maintain production-grade frontend applications using modern frontend technologies.
  • Own frontend features end-to-end, from product requirements and UX flows to implementation, testing, and deployment.
  • Build responsive, performant, and reliable user interfaces for Web3 products.
  • Create reusable frontend components, patterns, and architecture that allow the team to move quickly without sacrificing quality.
  • Work closely with product, design, backend, and protocol teams to translate complex Web3 flows into intuitive user experiences.

Web3 Product & Wallet Integration

  • Build frontend experiences that integrate with wallets, smart contracts, indexers, RPC providers, and blockchain data sources.
  • Implement flows involving transaction signing, message signing, intent signing, session keys, delegated permissions, and account abstraction.
  • Design user experiences around balances, transaction history, onchain transactions, permissions, and Web3 payment flows.
  • Understand how to fetch, cache, reconcile, and display onchain and offchain data safely and accurately.
  • Handle edge cases common in Web3 applications, including pending transactions, reorgs, failed RPC calls, wallet disconnects, chain switching, stale balances, and inconsistent indexer data.

Security & Correctness

  • Ensure frontend flows are secure by default, especially when users are asked to sign messages, authorize intents, or store session keys locally.
  • Apply best practices for client-side key management, session key storage, permission scoping, signature domain separation, and phishing-resistant UX.
  • Work with the team to identify and prevent risks around malicious signatures, replay attacks, unsafe approvals, incorrect transaction previews, and confusing wallet prompts.
  • Treat frontend correctness as critical infrastructure, especially when user funds or private information are involved.

Leadership & Mentorship

  • Lead technical design discussions and help define frontend architecture, standards, and best practices.
  • Review code and mentor junior engineers on frontend quality, Web3 security, testing, and production readiness.
  • Improve engineering velocity by building strong abstractions, documentation, and internal tooling.
  • Take ownership of frontend quality across performance, reliability, security, accessibility, and maintainability.

Required Experience

  • 5+ years of frontend engineering experience, with strong production experience building complex applications.
  • Strong expertise in TypeScript, React, and modern frontend development.
  • Experience building Web3, crypto, wallet, DeFi, payments, or blockchain-related frontend products.
  • Strong understanding of wallet integrations, transaction flows, message signing, and onchain data fetching.
  • Experience working with libraries and tools such as viem, wagmi, ethers.js, WalletConnect, RainbowKit, or similar.
  • Strong understanding of frontend state management, API integration, caching, and real-time data updates.
  • Ability to reason carefully about security-sensitive frontend flows involving user funds, permissions, signatures, or keys.
  • Experience owning large frontend features from design to production.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work closely with product, design, backend, and protocol engineers.
  • Experience mentoring junior engineers and raising frontend engineering standards.
  • Startup mindset: comfortable with ambiguity, fast iteration, and taking ownership end-to-end.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building wallets, smart account interfaces, account abstraction flows, or session key systems.
  • Experience with intent-based protocols, delegated permissions, EIP-712 signatures, EIP-1271, EIP-4337, or EIP-7702.
  • Experience building frontend interfaces for privacy-preserving, security-sensitive, or financial applications.
  • Experience with indexers, subgraphs, custom backend APIs, RPC providers, and blockchain event reconciliation.
  • Strong product sense and ability to simplify complex Web3 flows for mainstream users.
  • Experience with frontend testing, including unit tests, integration tests, end-to-end tests, and wallet interaction testing.
  • Experience with Next.js, Tailwind, design systems, component libraries, and frontend performance optimization.
  • Open-source contributions or prior work in crypto, wallets, DeFi, payments, or developer tools.

What Success Looks Like

  • You will help build the frontend experience for Inco’s core products, making advanced privacy and Web3 payment flows feel simple, secure, and intuitive.
  • You will be responsible for creating interfaces that users can trust when signing intents, managing permissions, interacting with wallets, and moving funds privately.
  • You will help establish the frontend foundation for Inco’s products while mentoring the team and setting a high bar for quality, security, and user experience.

About the Company:

SLR is expanding its global footprint. As such, we are continuously looking for talented people to join our team and add value to Our Business. We are particularly interested in adding team members to our Planning and Assessment team in Morocco.

We are recognised as one of the global leaders in environmental and advisory solutions, helping our clients achieve their sustainability goals. SLR has over 100 offices in 13 different countries worldwide, and we actively encourage collaboration and learning among the many disciplines and services we offer globally.

At SLR, you can expect a flexible and supportive 'One Team’ culture that is at the heart of our business and ensures that we offer a rewarding workplace. You will be able to work alongside industry leaders and specialists on interesting projects and be part of a team that makes a difference.

Job Purpose:

We are seeking a Principal Environmental Consultant who will play a pivotal role in driving the strategic development and expansion of international environmental and social impact assessment (ESIA) services in North Africa across the renewables, energy, infrastructure, and mining sectors. This position will focus on identifying and securing new opportunities aligned with international lender requirements, forging strategic partnerships, and positioning the business as a trusted provider of high-quality ESIA and sustainability advisory services in emerging North African markets. The role will also involve supporting the integration of international best practices into project delivery, contributing to thought leadership to deliver lender-compliant, multidisciplinary projects.

The Principal Environmental Consultant will also serve as Project Director on key international assignments, providing high-level oversight to ensure that all deliverables are technically sound, meet client expectations, on projects in alignment with local regulatory frameworks and international lender standards (IFC Performance Standards, EBRD Performance Requirements, Equator Principles, World Bank ESS). The role involves leading multidisciplinary teams through the full ESIA lifecycle, from initial planning and baseline assessments to impact analysis, mitigation development, stakeholder engagement, and final reporting and submission. In this capacity, the Principal Environmental Consultant will be responsible for upholding rigorous quality assurance and risk management standards and ensuring timely, within-budget, and scope-aligned project delivery. A core focus will be on building and maintaining strong client relationships through clear communication, technical excellence, and proactive responsiveness to project needs.

The role requires a proactive, solutions-driven individual with demonstrated experience in managing people and large-scale and complex environmental and social projects and engaging effectively with diverse stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Provide technical leadership on ESIA projects across North Africa.
  • Lead complex ESIAs for renewables, energy, infrastructure and mining sectors.
  • Act as primary technical advisor to clients, regulators, and lenders
  • Interface directly with regulators, regional environmental agencies, and international financing institutions.
  • Align projects with international standards (IFC PS, World Bank ESS, EBRD PRs, Equator Principles).
  • Provide strategic environmental risk advice at the feasibility and concept design stage.
  • Oversee preparation, technical review, and submission of high-quality ESIA and permitting documentation.
  • Lead multidisciplinary teams, ensuring quality, consistency, and timely delivery
  • Drive business development within the ESIA space, including proposal leadership and client development.

What We Are Looking For:

  • 12+ years of experience in environmental consulting, with extensive ESIA leadership experience.
  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in environmental management, Environmental Science, or related discipline.
  • Demonstrated experience delivering ESIAs for renewable, infrastructure, energy and mining projects.
  • Strong North Africa knowledge and local environmental permitting frameworks.
  • Strong working knowledge of international lender standards (IFC, World Bank, EBRD, etc.)
  • Experience leading large, multidisciplinary technical teams
  • Strong understanding of marine modelling, cumulative impacts, and coastal processes
  • Proven ability to manage complex regulatory and stakeholder environments
  • Demonstrated experience in business development and proposal leadership
  • Fluent in English (Arabic and/or French advantageous)
  • Willingness to travel across North Africa
  • Should have a valid driver's license

Why Join SLR?

  • Lead technically complex, regionally significant marine projects
  • Influence sustainable coastal development in rapidly evolving environments
  • Work within a global network of marine and sustainability experts
  • Thrive in a collaborative, flexible One Team culture
  • Attractive relocation support for international candidates
  • Play a defining role in growing SLR’s ESIA capability in Morocco

Technical / Behavioural Requirements:

  • Exceptional technical report writing and critical review capability
  • Strong project and financial management skills (budgets, risk management, delivery oversight)
  • Strategic thinker with strong commercial awareness
  • Advanced stakeholder engagement and regulatory negotiation skills
  • Ability to operate confidently at senior client and regulator level
  • Strong leadership presence and mentoring capability
  • Ability to manage multiple complex workstreams in a fast-paced environment
  • High attention to detail and commitment to technical excellence

Role Description

Dropbox is hiring an Integrated Campaign Strategist to architect and orchestrate marketing campaigns for priority product launches and evergreen marketing motions. This role turns business priorities, audience insight, and product positioning into a clear campaign strategy that defines the audience, narrative, journey, channel roles, activation sequence, and measurement plan.

You will be the steward of how these campaigns show up in market across owned, earned, and paid channels. Working across Product Marketing, Brand and Creative, Comms, Web, Lifecycle, Paid Media, Content, Events, Marketing Operations, Analytics, and Sales, you will align teams around one integrated plan, connect individual activations into a coherent enterprise buyer experience, and guide the campaign from brief through launch, optimization, and learning.

This is a senior individual contributor role for a strategist who can lead through influence, make tradeoffs in ambiguity, and balance strong market storytelling with measurable business impact. You will help Dropbox bring important product stories to enterprise audiences with greater consistency, relevance, and effectiveness.

Responsibilities

  • Campaign strategy architecture: Translate mid-market and enterprise business goals, product positioning, audience insight, and market context into integrated campaign strategies for key launches and evergreen motions, including objectives, audience, narrative, journey, channel roles, phasing, and measurement.
  • Cross channel orchestration: Build and manage the integrated activation plan across owned, earned, and paid channels so that web, lifecycle, content, social, communications, events, partner, and media programs work as one connected campaign rather than separate channel plans.
  • In-market stewardship: Own the campaign through launch and sustainment, protecting the strategic throughline while ensuring creative, messaging, timing, and audience experience remain coherent across touchpoints and regions.
  • Cross-functional leadership: Establish the brief, operating rhythm, decision rights, milestones, dependencies, and readiness criteria that align Product Marketing, Brand and Creative, Communications, channel owners, Marketing Operations, Marketing Data Science, regional partners, and Sales.
  • Audience and journey design: Define target audiences and buying groups, map the role of each touchpoint across the customer journey, and ensure campaign experiences respond to buyer needs, market moments, and stages of consideration.
  • Performance and optimization: Partner with Marketing Data Science and channel owners to define full funnel success measures, synthesize owned, earned, and paid signals, identify what is driving or limiting performance, and recommend changes to audience, narrative, creative, sequencing, or channel mix.
  • Portfolio learning and scale: Capture campaign insights, codify reusable plays, distinguish enduring strategy from launch specific execution, and apply learning across the enterprise campaign portfolio to improve future launches and evergreen motions.

Requirements

  • 8+ years B2B marketing experience in integrated campaigns, enterprise marketing, product marketing activation, brand to demand, or a related discipline, ideally in SaaS or technology.
  • Direct experience building out campaign strategy and accountable to the outcome(pipeline generation, revenue generation).
  • Demonstrated ownership of complex integrated campaigns from strategy and brief through activation, optimization, and post campaign learning.
  • Strong campaign architecture skills, including audience definition, narrative development, buyer journey design, channel planning, phasing, and measurement.
  • Experience orchestrating owned, earned, and paid programs and understanding the distinct role each plays in building awareness, consideration, demand, and customer growth.
  • Ability to translate product positioning and enterprise customer insight into a cohesive market story and connected audience experience across multiple teams and touchpoints.
  • Strong cross functional leadership and program judgment, including the ability to establish decision rights, navigate competing priorities, resolve dependencies, and influence without direct authority.
  • Analytical fluency and experience using campaign, brand, engagement, and revenue signals to evaluate performance, communicate impact, and make optimization decisions.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience leading enterprise product launch campaigns and building evergreen motions for a multi product B2B portfolio.
  • Experience partnering closely with Corporate Communications, analyst relations, customer advocacy, or social teams to connect earned programs with owned and paid activation.
  • Experience marketing to complex enterprise buying groups across industries, company sizes, regions, or stages of maturity.
  • Familiarity with marketing automation, CRM, media, intent, experimentation, and attribution platforms used to activate and measure integrated campaigns.
  • Experience using AI to accelerate research, briefing, content variation, synthesis, or analysis while retaining human ownership of strategy, judgment, and brand decisions.

Durable Skills

AI fluency means using these tools to amplify human judgment, not replace it. We believe people with these skills will thrive as work and technologycontinue to evolve:

  • Awareness:Understand yourself and others.
  • Judgment:Evaluate information and make decisions in complex situations.
  • Adaptability:Learn, adjust, and stay effective through change.
  • Connection:Communicate, collaborate, and build trust.

To learn more about why these skills matter and what the data shows about thriving through change, read this blog postfrom our Chief People Officer, Melanie Rosenwasser.

About Us:
We are an early-stage geothermal company developing next-generation systems for efficient heat extraction and power generation. Our work sits at the intersection of thermodynamics, advanced rotating machinery, and renewable energy. We are focused on advancing turbine and expander technologies that unlock more efficient, scalable geothermal electricity generation.
Role Overview:
We are seeking a highly experienced Turbo Machinery Advisor with deep expertise in steam turbines, expanders, ORC systems, or other rotating equipment used in geothermal or thermal power applications. This is a strategic advisory role for someone with a long track record in turbomachinery design, power systems engineering, and industry leadership.
The Advisor will work closely with the founding team, supporting system architecture, design strategy, technical decision-making, and industry positioning. This person will bring not only technical depth but also a strong understanding of the geothermal ecosystem, industrial partnerships, and what it takes to move breakthrough hardware from concept to commercial deployment.
Key Responsibilities

Strategic Oversight and Technical Direction

  • Guide the turbine/expander development roadmap, ensuring alignment with long-term system architecture, commercial feasibility, and manufacturability.
  • Provide senior-level mentorship to engineers and technical contributors, helping shape design approaches, testing priorities, and integration pathways.
  • Recommend best practices in rotating machinery design, materials, thermodynamic cycle selection, and system optimization.

Thermodynamic & Mechanical Systems Guidance

  • Review and refine thermodynamic cycle models, system assumptions, and performance projections.
  • Advise on blade geometry choices, flow efficiency strategies, and component-to-component integration.
  • Evaluate alternative configurations for durability, maintenance needs, and operational constraints in geothermal environments.

Testing, Validation & Risk Reduction

  • Oversight of prototype testing methodologies, including performance validation under realistic geothermal or steam-cycle conditions.
  • Support the team in defining testing protocols, instrumentation needs, and risk-mitigation plans for rotating equipment.

Regulatory, Safety & Compliance Support

  • Provide guidance on safety standards, mechanical integrity requirements, and relevant codes associated with turbomachinery operation in geothermal and industrial settings.
  • Advise on documentation and compliance expectations for early pilots and field deployments.

Manufacturing & Supply Chain Insight

  • Support evaluation of manufacturing pathways, vendor selection, and component sourcing for small-scale, high-efficiency turbine systems.
  • Recommend quality assurance and reliability frameworks suitable for early production and scaling.

Documentation, Stakeholder Communication & Reporting

  • Review technical documentation, including design analysis, testing summaries, and risk assessments.
  • Help prepare clear technical updates for internal stakeholders, external partners, and potential investors.

Industry Networking & Strategic Partnerships

  • Leverage an established network in turbomachinery, geothermal, steam-cycle power, or related fields to help secure partnerships, pilot opportunities, and early adopter relationships.
  • Provide senior technical presence in discussions with research institutions, industrial partners, utilities, and potential demonstration sites.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Advanced degree (PhD or MS) or equivalent senior-level industry experience in mechanical engineering, turbomachinery, thermal sciences, or related fields.
  • 15+ years working with steam turbines, expanders, ORC systems, or similar rotating equipment.
  • Deep familiarity with geothermal, waste-heat recovery, or thermal-to-power systems.
  • Expert understanding of thermodynamics, fluid mechanics, structural considerations, and rotating equipment design.
  • Proven track record advising or leading engineering teams on complex mechanical systems.
  • Strong industry network within turbomachinery, geothermal energy, or thermal power generation ecosystems.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to translate complex technical issues for mixed audiences.
  • Ability to operate independently and deliver high-impact guidance within limited advisory hours.

raw.title: Program Grants Officer (Latin America)
raw.excerpt: About MiracleFeet MiracleFeet is a global nonprofit working to eliminate one of the leading causes of physical disability worldwide.
raw.description:
About MiracleFeet

MiracleFeet is a global nonprofit working to eliminate one of the leading causes of physical disability worldwide. Over two million children live with the severe consequences of untreated clubfoot, and at least 175,000 more babies are born with this condition every year. Thanks to a non-surgical solution called the Ponseti method, 95 percent of cases can be fully treated for less than $500. Since 2010, MiracleFeet’s proven, scalable model is supported by a suite of custom measurement and evaluation tools developed with our partners. To date, MiracleFeet has delivered quality clubfoot treatment to more than 127,000 children in 555 clinics in 38 countries across Sub-Saharan Africa, Latin America, Asia, and the Middle East and North Africa. We invite you to learn more about our unique model and our impact here. Still, today fewer than one in five children has access to treatment.

Our Team: Culture

Join our movement to work toward a world where all children born with clubfoot realize their rights to quality treatment. We are in it to end it! Our global team is made up of health professionals, social entrepreneurs, project managers, data nerds, innovators, and activists. In accordance with our values, we strive to create a collaborative, collegial, and respectful environment to ensure all staff feel valued, included, and appreciated. In all facets of our work, we celebrate creative thinking and problem-solving.

Summary

The Program Grants Officer (PGO) plays a key role in the effective financial, operational, and compliance management of grants awarded to partner organizations. The role supports the full grant lifecycle—from agreement development and budget review to monitoring, reporting, and audit support—while strengthening partner capacity and promoting transparency, accountability, and efficient grant operations.

Working closely with programs and finance teams, the Program Grants Officer ensures grants are implemented in line with organizational policies, donor requirements, and best practices in international development and global health programming. This position reports to the Program Grants Manager and is a full-time 40/hr. a week position.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage a portfolio of Spanish-speaking partners, assuming responsibility for their budget and expense report reviews and capacity building
  • Support the annual partner grant agreement process
  • Update the project management tool, Monday.com, with the most accurate information surrounding grant renewals, amendments, and subaward policy compliance
  • Ensure partner grants follow the protocols in MiracleFeet’s subaward monitoring policy. Document the dates for financial reviews and catalog documentation requirements for the MiracleFeet annual audit.
  • Review partner expense reports per the subaward policy and flag inconsistencies. Support partners with training as needed.
  • Utilize Salesforce to upload partner budgets and expense reports.
  • Conduct annual risk assessment updates based on the MiracleFeet subrecipient monitoring policy.
  • Develop strategies for bringing efficiency and transparency to this process.
  • Support the finance team with the audit as it relates to partner grants.

Note: The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work to be performed by the individual in this position. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required of the position. Employees may have other duties assigned at any time.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree with at least 5 years of relevant work experience, ideally in finance, accounting, global health, or international development
  • Strong Microsoft Excel skills
  • Ability to read, write, and speak fluent Spanish and English; Portuguese language skills would be an added advantage
  • Ability to travel internationally, including to low- and middle-income countries, at least four times per year.
  • Must be based in Latin America, with a strong preference for candidates based in one of our partner countries in the region. Please note that this is a remote position and must be based in one of the 38 countriesin which MiracleFeet currently operates.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Experience in international subawards/grants management
  • Demonstrated experience in project management, budget development, and financial analysis
  • Excellent analytical, quantitative, and problem-solving skills
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with ability to synthesize information quickly
  • Excels at operating in a fast-paced, collaborative environment
  • Politically-savvy and culturally competent: skilled in diplomacy and relationship-building, sensitive to cultural norms, ability to work in multi-cultural teams
  • Flexibility to adapt to changing requirements and to work with teams in different time zones
  • Proactive and creative with strong initiative
  • Adept at managing a project from inception to completion
  • An eye for creating efficiencies and meticulous attention to accuracy and detail
  • Familiarity in the use of Salesforce or other cloud-based CRM platform strongly preferred

Salary/Benefits

  • Salary commensurate with experience and location.
  • MiracleFeet will offer paid time off (including 10 national holidays based on contractor country of residence) as well as travel insurance to global contractors.
  • The position is on a contract basis. MiracleFeet will not be offering a US-based employment contract.
  • Applicants must already reside in Latin America and have appropriate work permit for their country of residence. Please note that MiracleFeet is unable to sponsor employment visas.

To Apply

Please submit your detailed cover letter and resume (in English) here.

Once you submit your application, you should receive a notification confirming your materials were received. If you do not receive this automatic message, please contact . We also recommend you add to your contact list to ensure delivery of all correspondence from us. Please, no phone calls.

Applications will be accepted until the position is filled. The anticipated start date for this role isSeptember 2026.

Encouraging Applicants of All Backgrounds

MiracleFeet is an equal opportunity employer and encourages applications from candidates of all backgrounds.

MiracleFeet is committed to equity, inclusion, and safeguarding children. All staff are expected to uphold MiracleFeet’s organizational values and actively contribute to a safe, respectful, and inclusive work environment.
