About Lyra

Lyra Clinical Associates partners with Lyra Health, a leading provider of evidence-based mental health care, serving more than 20 million people globally in partnership with employers and more than 100 million through health plan and partner relationships. The company has delivered more than 15 million sessions of mental health care, published more than 35 peer-reviewed studies, and delivered unmatched outcomes in terms of access, clinical effectiveness, and cost efficiency. Lyra members have access to care in one day, and nine out of ten improve with the support of providers like you. Lyra is transforming access to life-changing mental health care through Lyra Empower, the only fully integrated, AI-powered platform combining the highest-quality care and technology solutions. You will be contracted by Lyra Clinical Associates.

About the Role

Lyra is committed to addressing urgent and costly mental health needs with specialized support where it’s needed most. Our Center of Excellence for Neurodiversity offers neuropsychological and psychological assessments, diagnosis, and tailored care for ADHD, and support for autism and learning differences. We are looking for contractTesting Psychologists who are passionate about whole-person, whole-family mental health care.

The Testing Psychologist will perform comprehensive intake interviews and psychological assessments to support diagnostic clarity, treatment planning, and intervention strategies for children, adolescents, and adults. This role focuses on addressing behavioral health complexities, providing actionable insights through psychoeducational and psychological evaluations, and collaborating with interdisciplinary care teams to optimize outcomes.

This role is a great fit for providers who are results driven, detailed, process oriented, and comfortable with data. Candidates with an independent work ethic who are flexible and adaptable, we encourage you to apply.

Key responsibilities:

  • Work with patients of all ages is preferred, as well as their families, by providing intake interviews and psychological evaluations

  • Administer, interpret, and integrate a wide variety of psychological test batteries, focusing on cognitive, emotional, behavioral, and academic functioning

  • Provide clear, evidence-based diagnostic impressions and actionable recommendations tailored to the individual’s needs

  • Collaborate and review work with psychometrists and psychometrist assistants, overseeing test administration, scoring, and ensuring quality control

  • Deliver compassionate feedback through feedback videos and live sessions to communicate findings and recommendations

  • Maintain a detail-oriented, process-focused approach to ensure the accuracy of testing data and comprehensive reporting

  • Utilize telehealth platforms effectively for remote assessments, including adapting testing strategies for virtual delivery

  • Conduct intake interviews, testing sessions, and live feedback sessions, delivered virtually or in person, as indicated

Requirements:

  • Doctorate degree in Psychology (PhD or PsyD) from an American Psychological Association or Canadian Psychological Association accredited program

  • Licensed Clinical Psychologist in at least one state

  • PSYPACT authorized or PSYPACT eligible preferred

  • 3+ years of experience in psychological assessments with children, adolescents, or adults

  • Familiarity with evaluating complex behavioral health needs (e.g., ASD, ADHD, mood disorders, anxiety, trauma)

  • Expertise in psychological and psychoeducational assessment tools (e.g., BASC, Conners, WAIS, WISC)

  • Effective therapeutic communication skills

  • Proficiency with telehealth platforms and remote testing tools

  • Experience conducting testing virtually

  • Ability to deliver care virtually or in person and within your own office space

  • Candidates must successfully pass a background check for this opportunit

Here are some of the advantages of joining the Lyra + Bend network:

  • Connect with highly compatible clients who are a good fit for your clinical expertise
  • Support from caring and highly qualified, vetted psychometrists
  • Set your own schedule, without a minimum hours requirement
  • Focus less on the administrative burden of billing with Lyra’s paperless billing and quick payment turnaround
  • Have peace of mind with Lyra’s 24/7 Care Navigation team for client crisis support
  • Access to a robust offering of live and recorded CE credited courses (approved by APA, ASWB, and NBCC)
  • Access to cutting edge technology and a team of support staff (e.g., psychometrists, psychometrist assistants) to help ease the administrative burden of the evaluation process
  • Testing supplies are provided for you
We believe that our diverse perspectives are our biggest strengths, and that embracing them will create real change in healthcare. As an equal opportunity employer, we are committed to building an inclusive environment where you can be you.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, disability, genetic information or any other category protected by law.

By applying for this contract position, your data will be processed as per Workforce Privacy Notice. If you are a California resident and would like to limit how we use this information, please use the Limit the Use of My Sensitive Personal Information form. This information will only be retained for as long as needed to fulfill the purposes for which it was collected, as described above. Please note that Lyra does not “sell” or “share” personal information as defined by the CPRA. For more information about how we use and retain your information, please see our Workforce Privacy Notice.

raw.description:
Overview

Lead with GRATITUDE. Engage with EMPATHY. CARE with COMPASSION. BE Intellectually Curious. Be part of NADG's Tribe!

NADG is the fastest growing dental services organization of scale in the United States and today consists of a network of over 240+ dental practices in 15 states and 25 regional markets, and recently have become the first Transatlantic Dental Service Group! Our entrepreneurial culture and maniacal focus on patient care serve as a great platform to become an innovative and dynamic industry leader

We are looking for a Revenue Cycle Specialist (remote) to join our Revenue Cycle Team to help us pioneer a new culture of dentistry. Join our Tribe!

Responsibilities

The Revenue Cycle Specialist is well versed and crossed trained in all areas of the revenue cycle and accustomed to working in a high-volume environment. Key Responsibilities include:

  • Processing dental claims for payment by insurance companies to ensure appropriate and timely coding, billing and collections
  • Performs manual and electronic posting functions for all payors/patient accounts, including cash balancing and reconciliation of bank deposits.
  • Post payment corrections, payment transfers and NSF’s.
  • Research and clear unapplied accounts using established identification functions/process.
  • Maintains knowledge of insurance rejections/denial processing and appropriately posts information for collection and follow up activity.
  • Responsible for all aspects of follow up and collections, including making phone calls, accessing payer websites. Identify issues or trending and provide suggestions for resolution.
  • Accurately and thoroughly documents the pertinent collection activity performed. Review the account information and necessary system applications to determine the next appropriate work activity.
  • Reviews investigate and resolves claims that have been rejected or denied by insurance. Verify claims adjudication utilization appropriate resources and applications.
  • Perform appropriate billing functions, including manual re-bills as well as electronic submission to payers. Edit claims to meet and satisfy billing compliance guidelines for electronic claim submission.
  • Initiates appeals and ensures all required documentation is submitted in the appeal process.
  • Answers patient billing questions and act as a resource for patient billing questions.
  • Ledger accuracy and account integrity
  • Analyzes and correct insurance account receivable and payment posting ledger and posting errors
  • Thoroughly research all payor recoupments and identify errors and/or opportunity to dispute and restore loss in revenue. Research and validate patient refunds
  • Verification of insurance benefits utilizing website, fax and phone.
  • Reviewing patient accounts to determine and correct any discrepancies; account audits, aging AR, unapplied adjustments, resolving credit balance, unposted payments
  • Researches and follow up on all correspondence associated with assigned accounts
  • Other duties and responsibilities as assigned by leadership

Qualifications

So How Can You “Fill” This Role?

  • High School Diploma or equivalent
  • Minimum 3-5 years Dental or Medical Experience
  • Prior experience in Dental Office workflows, Revenue Cycle functions to include scheduling, registration, insurance verification, fee schedules, claim submission, charging/coding requirements, insurance AR follow up and payment posting process
  • Experience with practice management software systems, insurance portals, clearing houses, insurance guidelines, banking reconciliation software, proficient in intermediate PC skills (MS Office—strong excel skills).
  • Strong computer literacy, excellent Math and problem-solving skills. Data entry and 10-key by touch.
  • Strong interpersonal and organization skills.
  • Ability to work within a team setting and as an individual contributor.
  • Proven attention to detail with strong analytical skills

Benefits Await!

We take pride in our ability to give our team members all the benefits they deserve. This is why we offer…

  • A comprehensive benefits package including 401k
  • Competitive paid time off for full-time and part-time team members which increases as you grow in your career with us
  • Constant opportunities for career growth and continuing education
  • A professional and flexible atmosphere that allows for freedom and individuality – enabling our team to always strive to do what’s best for the patient

Ready to Join Our Team?

  • Our team isn’t just looking for good members, we’re looking for the best of the best and are ready to welcome the perfect candidate to this position. NADG is constantly growing, and we want you to join us on our mission. Stop searching for jobs – apply today and start your career.
  • If you are professional and organized yet outgoing, flexible, and energetic, you’ll fit right in.
  • Our team is full of individuals with different skills and personalities, but each is willing to go the extra mile for our patients while communicating well with our team. If this sounds relatable, then there’s a spot for you at our practice. We’re excited to hear from you!

Equal Opportunity Employer

We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

This position reports to the Program Grants Manager and is a full-time 40/hr. a week position.

About Lyra

Lyra Clinical Associates partners with Lyra Health, a leading provider of evidence-based mental health care, serving more than 20 million people globally in partnership with employers and more than 100 million through health plan and partner relationships. The company has delivered more than 15 million sessions of mental health care, published more than 35 peer-reviewed studies, and delivered unmatched outcomes in terms of access, clinical effectiveness, and cost efficiency. Lyra members have access to care in one day, and nine out of ten improve with the support of providers like you. Lyra is transforming access to life-changing mental health care through Lyra Empower, the only fully integrated, AI-powered platform combining the highest-quality care and technology solutions. You will be contracted by Lyra Clinical Associates.

About the Role

Lyra is committed to addressing urgent and costly mental health needs with specialized support where it’s needed most. Our Center of Excellence for Neurodiversity offers neuropsychological and psychological assessments, diagnosis, and tailored care for ADHD, and support for autism and learning differences. We are looking for contractTesting Psychologists who are passionate about whole-person, whole-family mental health care.

The Testing Psychologist will perform comprehensive intake interviews and psychological assessments to support diagnostic clarity, treatment planning, and intervention strategies for children, adolescents, and adults. This role focuses on addressing behavioral health complexities, providing actionable insights through psychoeducational and psychological evaluations, and collaborating with interdisciplinary care teams to optimize outcomes.

This role is a great fit for providers who are results driven, detailed, process oriented, and comfortable with data. Candidates with an independent work ethic who are flexible and adaptable, we encourage you to apply.

Key responsibilities:

  • Work with patients of all ages is preferred, as well as their families, by providing intake interviews and psychological evaluations

  • Administer, interpret, and integrate a wide variety of psychological test batteries, focusing on cognitive, emotional, behavioral, and academic functioning

  • Provide clear, evidence-based diagnostic impressions and actionable recommendations tailored to the individual’s needs

  • Collaborate and review work with psychometrists and psychometrist assistants, overseeing test administration, scoring, and ensuring quality control

  • Deliver compassionate feedback through feedback videos and live sessions to communicate findings and recommendations

  • Maintain a detail-oriented, process-focused approach to ensure the accuracy of testing data and comprehensive reporting

  • Utilize telehealth platforms effectively for remote assessments, including adapting testing strategies for virtual delivery

  • Conduct intake interviews, testing sessions, and live feedback sessions, delivered virtually or in person, as indicated

Requirements:

  • Doctorate degree in Psychology (PhD or PsyD) from an American Psychological Association or Canadian Psychological Association accredited program

  • Licensed Clinical Psychologist in at least one state

  • PSYPACT authorized or PSYPACT eligible preferred

  • 3+ years of experience in psychological assessments with children, adolescents, or adults

  • Familiarity with evaluating complex behavioral health needs (e.g., ASD, ADHD, mood disorders, anxiety, trauma)

  • Expertise in psychological and psychoeducational assessment tools (e.g., BASC, Conners, WAIS, WISC)

  • Effective therapeutic communication skills

  • Proficiency with telehealth platforms and remote testing tools

  • Experience conducting testing virtually

  • Ability to deliver care virtually or in person and within your own office space

  • Candidates must successfully pass a background check for this opportunit

Here are some of the advantages of joining the Lyra + Bend network:

  • Connect with highly compatible clients who are a good fit for your clinical expertise
  • Support from caring and highly qualified, vetted psychometrists
  • Set your own schedule, without a minimum hours requirement
  • Focus less on the administrative burden of billing with Lyra’s paperless billing and quick payment turnaround
  • Have peace of mind with Lyra’s 24/7 Care Navigation team for client crisis support
  • Access to a robust offering of live and recorded CE credited courses (approved by APA, ASWB, and NBCC)
  • Access to cutting edge technology and a team of support staff (e.g., psychometrists, psychometrist assistants) to help ease the administrative burden of the evaluation process
  • Testing supplies are provided for you
We believe that our diverse perspectives are our biggest strengths, and that embracing them will create real change in healthcare. As an equal opportunity employer, we are committed to building an inclusive environment where you can be you.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, disability, genetic information or any other category protected by law.

By applying for this contract position, your data will be processed as per Workforce Privacy Notice. If you are a California resident and would like to limit how we use this information, please use the Limit the Use of My Sensitive Personal Information form. This information will only be retained for as long as needed to fulfill the purposes for which it was collected, as described above. Please note that Lyra does not “sell” or “share” personal information as defined by the CPRA. For more information about how we use and retain your information, please see our Workforce Privacy Notice.

TaxTalente ist eine junge Job-Matching Plattform für Jobsuchende und Unternehmen in der Steuerberatung. Unser Anspruch ist es, Bewerbern in der Steuerberatung das Leben zu vereinfachen und ihnen zu ihrem Traumjob zu verhelfen. Auf Basis deiner Wünsche können wir dir deinen passenden Job, aus der Vielzahl von Top-Kanzleien in unserem deutschlandweiten Netzwerk vorschlagen und dir vollumfänglich mit unserer Expertise beratend zur Seite stehen.

Derzeit suchen wir nach einer Steuerfachkraft (Steuerfachangestellter, Steuerfachwirt oder Bilanzbuchhalter) für eine unserer Partner-Kanzleien in Arzfeld. Falls du woanders wohnst, ist dies kein Problem, da 100% Homeoffice ebenfalls möglich ist.

Bei Rückfragen kannst du dich gerne jederzeit (auch nach deinem Feierabend) direkt telefonisch an Herrn Becker-Koch über folgende Nummer wenden: 015901431130

Aufgaben

Dein Aufgabenbereich kannst du dir auf Basis deiner persönlichen Präferenzen selbst aussuchen.

  • Erstellung von Finanzbuchhaltungen für Unternehmen unterschiedlicher Größenklassen (optional Lohnbuchhaltung)
  • Vorbereitung und Erstellung von Jahresabschlüssen
  • Erstellung von betrieblichen und privaten Steuererklärungen
  • Korrespondenz mit Mandanten, Behörden und Ämtern
  • Unterstützung bei Digitalisierungsmaßnahmen
  • Weitere individuell wählbare Tätigkeitsbereiche, die deinen Interessen entsprechen

Qualifikation

Am Ende sollte es für beide Seiten passen. Deshalb wäre es gut, wenn du dich in den nachfolgenden Punkten wiederfindest.

  • Kommunikative Art und Freude am Austausch mit Mandanten
  • Sorgfältige, effiziente und gewissenhafte Arbeitsweise
  • Offen für eine digitale Arbeitsweise
  • Leidenschaft für steuerliche Themen

Benefits

Du hast genug von 0815 Benefits, von denen du nicht wirklich profitierst? Dann solltest du einen Blick auf die nachfolgenden Benefits werfen.

  • Außerordentliche Vergütung zwischen 52.000€ und 85.000€ / Jahr
  • Flexible Gestaltung der Arbeitszeiten sowie die Option auf 100% Homeoffice
  • Nettolohnoptimierung mit monatlichen 50,00€ Sachbezugsgutscheinen
  • Umfangreiche Unterstützung bei Fort- und Weiterbildungsmaßnahmen und ein persönlicher Mentor
  • Modernste Ausstattung mit digitalen Prozessen
  • Starker Teamzusammenhalt und regelmäßige Teamevents

Schnell, unkompliziert und effizient deinen Traumjob finden – ein Versprechen an dich, dass wir aufgrund unseres selektiven, breit gefächerten und deutschlandweiten Kanzleinetzwerks halten werden. Deine Vorteile mit uns auf einen Blick:

  • Du führst keine unsinnigen Bewerbungsgespräche mehr, bei denen du während des Bewerbungsprozesses merkst, dass es (bspw. wegen des Gehalts) sowieso nicht passt - wir klären vor deinem Bewerbungsgespräch all deine mit uns besprochenen Kriterien mit der Kanzlei ab.
  • Wir führen deine Gehaltsverhandlungen und kennen die Gehaltsstrukturen der Branche dabei bestens
  • 100% Anonymität – solange du uns nicht das „Go“ gibst und einem Kennenlernen mit deinem neuen potentiellen Arbeitgeber zustimmst, erfährt niemand von deinem Namen oder deinen bisherigen Arbeitgebern – deine dir wichtigen Kriterien können wir auch zunächst anonym mit unseren Partnerkanzleien klären
  • Attraktive Kanzleien – die Kanzleien in unserem breit gefächerten Kanzleinetzwerk sind selektiv ausgewählt und heben sich klar von “normalen” Kanzleien ab (z.B. hinsichtlich der Vergütung, Benefits, Hierarchien, Digitalisierungsgrad, Ausstattung etc.)
  • Und das Beste: Unser gesamter Service ist unverbindlich und völlig kostenfrei für dich

raw.description:
How You’ll Support Our Mission

We are looking for a Senior Network Engineer who brings deep technical expertise and an even deeper sense of ownership. This is not a role for someone who waits to be told what to do next. You will help architect, configure, and continuously improve the network infrastructure that underpins ESO products, and you will do it alongside a team that values candor, collaboration, and steady progress over headline-grabbing heroics.

What You’ll Be Doing - the day to day

  • Design, deploy, and maintain cloud and hybrid network infrastructure across environments.
  • Configure and manage F5 BIG-IP systems for load balancing, traffic management, and application delivery
  • Administer Web Application Firewalls (WAF) and Barracuda solutions to protect application and network layers
  • Partner with security and engineering teams to evaluate risk, enforce policy, and resolve incidents, asking the right questions early so the right solutions get built
  • Troubleshoot complex network issues methodically, communicate findings clearly, and document resolution paths that the whole team can learn from
  • Identify gaps and improvements proactively, bring forward recommendations with context, and follow through on the work
  • Support a culture of continuous improvement, not through dramatic overhauls, but through consistent, deliberate progress

What we are looking for - the essentials

  • 5 or more years of hands-on network engineering experience, with meaningful time spent in cloud environments
  • Proven experience configuring and managing F5 BIG-IP (LTM, ASM/WAF)
  • Solid working knowledge of load balancing principles and real-world application delivery
  • Experience with Azure networking, VNets, NSGs, ExpressRoute, VPN Gateway, or equivalent
  • Familiarity with Barracuda, SonicWall and other network appliances
  • Comfort working across firewall platforms and translating security requirements into network policy
  • A communication style that is direct, open, and respectful, you surface concerns early, share context generously, and engage in honest dialogue even when it is uncomfortable
  • A growth mindset: you measure yourself not against perfection but against where you were last quarter

How you work

At ESO, the strongest signal of a great engineer is not what they know on day one, it is how they approach learning, collaboration, and accountability over time. We are looking for someone who:

  • Asks the questions that move conversations from stuck to forward
  • Takes ownership without needing to own everything alone
  • Brings teammates along rather than working around them
  • Holds themselves to high standards and is honest when those standards are not met
  • Wants to grow, not just in technical depth, but as a teammate and contributor to something that matters

About ESO

ESO is a fast-paced, growing data, technology, and research company passionate about improving community health and safety through the power of data. We pioneer innovative, user-friendly software to meet the changing needs of today’s EMS agencies, fire departments, and hospitals. We’re small enough to be nimble and fun, but big enough to be a great place to work. We serve thousands of customers out of our offices across the US, Canada, Northern Ireland, Czech Republic, Denmark and Costa Rica.

Are you ready to Make a Difference? At ESO, we believe in bringing your true self to work every single day. If you don’t match all the qualifications on the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway! We are looking for passionate, innovative, and authentic people to help drive our mission.

All offers are contingent upon a successful background check.

ESO is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. We invite you to consider opportunities at ESO regardless of your gender; gender identity; gender reassignment; age; religion; race; national origin; political affiliation; sexual orientation; disability; veteran status; or other non-merit factor.

Applicant Privacy Notice – please click here to review the privacy policy which details how your data is collected, used and protected.

The Sales Territory Manager supports existing customers, and pursuing new sales opportunities in ND, SD, MN, WI, NE, IA, IL, KS, MO, TX, OK, AR, and LA directly or through all distributor organizations. You will identify decision makers in the customer organizations, building relationships and applying the Edwards support organization to deliver the best support and position Edwards as supplier of choice. You will report to the Industrial National Sales Manager. You will be a remote employee, but will travel to the states listed.

You will establish Edwards as the preferred supplier of vacuum components and systems to the Industrial market sectors customers in the ND, SD, MN, WI, NE, IA, IL, KS, MO, TX, OK, AR, and LA area. You will also achieve revenue and contribution growth goals and build relationships with customers and maximize Edwards visibility and increase sales to the sector.

Main Responsibilities

1. Achieve orders, sales and contribution budgets as agreed for each year, while also maintaining and building our long-term relationship as preferred vendor.

2. Manage and hire distributors and sales representatives to meet growth goals.

3. Increase Edwards route to market/customer through management of existing distributor organizations and hiring of new direct or indirect sales channels.

4. Develop expert understanding of product applications in the Industrial sectors and communicates this information to the Edwards organization.

5. Design and implement key account reach plans. Identify important new opportunities in each sector and work with sales/marketing team to break into those opportunities.

6. Work with Product Manager and Business Development Manager to increase Edwards position and visibility in the ND, SD, MN, WI, NE, IA, IL, KS, MO, TX, OK, AR, and LA Territory

7. Provide vacuum systems engineering expertise while within designated accounts working with all Edwards Internal support teams to provide highest quality solutions to our customers.

8. Provide problem resolution support coordinating with Product, Aftermarket and Applications support groups.

9. Develop an understanding of important customer requirements and establish product benefits over the competition, to lead in the development of markets and growth of profitable sales. Lead with the focus on winning solution best suited to important customers unique set of decision criteria.

10. Pursues and participates in monitoring of financial position of customers. Support credit manager and credit specialist to ensure cash collection targets are achieved.

11. Communication with other departments including manufacturing, R&D, credit and aftermarket to resolve problems associated with product line.

12. Provide forecast of both product units and revenue. Provide longer term trends or forecasts (part of account profiles).

13. Maintain awareness of competitive products, pricing, market statistics and trends. Work with Regional Market Sector Manager to ensure strategy from both ends.

14. Together with Industrial Division, promote the formulation and implementation of after-sales support policy and services, including local authorized service centers

15. Other tasks as delegated by the Sales Manager.

Education level

  • Bachelor of Science in Engineering or technical discipline preferred, but not necessary.

Relevant Previous experience

  • Five or more years sales management experience in the Industrial and/or Chemical processing industry or related area.

Knowledge areas/Skills

  • Must have demonstrated ability to hire and manage distributors, representatives and direct sales engineers.
  • Must demonstrate sound technical and commercial skills and be able to work in an empowered team framework.
  • Experience responding to prospect emails, phone calls, and other requests required.
  • Experience establishing communication and engagement with prospects quickly with a clear focus on customer service.

Other requirements

  • Must be willing to travel up to 60% of the time in the territory and potentially work from home.
  • Microsoft Product skills are required.
  • Experience working with and managing a CRM, such as SalesForce, C4C, Microsoft Dynamics/360.

What you expect from us:

  • Excellent working conditions and benefits, such as health, vision and dental for individual or individual plus family coverage, 401k plus match, family leave, disability insurance and life insurance options.
  • Part of the Atlas Copco Group with a wide-reaching internal job market
  • Work in a global diverse and dynamic environment
  • You can grow with us: we always look for internal candidates before checking the market and have training and development programs

Edwards Company considers for employment and hires qualified candidates without regard to race, religion, color, sex, sexual orientation, genetic information, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, protected veteran or disability status or any factor prohibited by law, and as such affirms in policy and practice to support and promote the concept of equal employment opportunity and affirmative action, in accordance with all applicable federal, state, provincial and municipal laws.

Edwards is a global leader of vacuum and abatement systems. We are proud to lead the industry, pushing the boundaries of science to deliver innovative products which are intrinsic to everyday life, working in partnership with our customers and continually setting new standards. With over 150 years of rich heritage, Edwards is the partner of choice for tens of thousands of customers in critical applications around the world. Vacuum is required in diverse sectors, from the generation of power to the production of steel, to the challenging environments of space simulation and high energy physics research.

About Edwards

Edwards is a leading developer and manufacturer of sophisticated vacuum products, exhaust management systems and related value-added services. Edwards solutions are integral to manufacturing processes for semiconductors, flat panel displays, LEDs and solar cells. They are also used within an increasingly diverse range of industrial processes including power, glass and other coating applications; steel and other metallurgy; pharmaceutical and chemical; and for scientific instruments in a wide range of R&D applications.

Edwards has over 4,000 employees worldwide engaged in the design, manufacture and support of high technology vacuum and exhaust management equipment. Edwards has state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities in Europe, Asia and North America.

Description

CapsLock is a company that specializes in providing digital marketing services to businesses that are facing sales growth challenges. Our comprehensive services include sales consulting, data analytics, and recruitment support, all seamlessly integrated to ensure efficient and accelerated growth.

Our company was founded by industry professionals with expertise in IT, design, and data analytics. Our vision is to provide a unique integrated solution for B2C clients that enables profitable customer acquisition, flexible scaling, and optimized internal processes.

At CapsLock, our core values center around our people, client orientation, quality, continuous improvement, integrity, and fostering strong relationships. Our diverse and skilled team speaks 10+ languages and is located worldwide. We are dedicated to pioneering new and efficient marketing strategies to ensure our clients’ success.

﻿Role Description

As a Finance Director at CapsLock, you will be responsible for overseeing all financial aspects of the fast-growing marketing business, ensuring accuracy in financial reporting, and providing strategic guidance to support our business goals. The ideal candidate will possess strong leadership skills and extensive financial expertise.

This role will report to the Chief Finance Officer of the Company.

Requirements

Responsibilities

  • Team leadership: Lead and mentor bookkeeping, FP&A, and taxation/compliance teams, fostering a collaborative and high-performing environment.
  • Accounting: Oversee accounting. Lead implementation and improvement of financial and accounting policies/practices.
  • Budgeting: Oversees budgeting process. Supervise plan/fact analysis and provide explanations and recommendations.
  • Reporting: Ensure timely and accurate financial, and investment reporting for the Group of Companies
  • Internal Controls and Audits. Assist with developing and maintaining robust internal controls. Lead internal audits to ensure compliance with established financial procedures.
  • Tax and Compliance: Oversee tax filings, regulatory reports, and compliance with statutory obligations. Tax planning and optimization for the group
  • M&A transactions: Navigate the complexities of mergers and acquisitions including initial financial assessments, Due Diligence, and post-merger integration.

  • Stakeholder Communication: Provide insights and recommendations on financial performance and key financial metrics to the executive team
  • Third-party Communication: Manage relationships with banks, tax advisories, and external consultants

Desired Skills and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field; MBA, CPA, ACCA preferred.
  • Minimum of 10 years of experience in finance, with at least 3 years in a leadership role.
  • Experience with financial reporting, month-end / year-end processes, and IFRS/GAAP compliance.
  • Proven track record in financial planning, analysis, and management within a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively interact with executive management and external stakeholders.

  • Fluent English.

Why do we deserve your attention?

Remote Work

We offer a truly and fully remote environment. You choose where you are the most productive and comfortable to have an impact.

Ongoing Learning

People at CapsLock are deeply inquisitive and eager to learn new knowledge and skills, that's why we support and create learning opportunities like the Free Books program, workshops, conferences, and more.

Home Office

We will cover the equipment and furniture expenses to make sure you have the best work-from-home experience.

Physical Well–Being

Fitness is more than a gym membership. We all have different tastes and preferences. That’s why we offer an allowance for a flexible fitness program that fits all.

Unlimited Sick Days

We understand that being only human means getting sick or feeling under the weather from time to time, so we guarantee you time off as long as you need to recover and get back on your feet.

Fun Stuff

There is never a shortage of fun stuff when you work with amazing people. But we like to spice things up and take them to the next level, you will soon learn how.

Be a Part of our Team!
Join a working team that is dedicated to the mission of the work we do!
Teaching Strategies is an innovative edtech organization focused on connecting teachers, children, and families. As front runners in the early childhood education market, we build dynamic, top-quality digital products that integrate all of the essential elements of a high-quality solution: curriculum, assessment, professional development, and family engagement. We are building a team of results-oriented individuals who will thrive in a collaborative, work-hard/play-hard culture. We pride ourselves on the impact we have on the early childhood field through supporting teachers who are doing the most important work there is, teaching children to become creative, confident thinkers.
Position Overview
Teaching Strategies is looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer to help build and evolve the systems that child care centers rely on to run their businesses. This engineer will work primarily across our Python backend and web application surfaces, with a focus on family billing, payments, invoices, account administration, billing solution management, reporting, and other back-office capabilities that help centers operate efficiently and support families.
In this role, you will take ownership of meaningful product and service work from discovery through delivery. You will translate product ideas and operational needs into clear technical plans, make pragmatic engineering decisions around architecture and technical debt, and collaborate closely with product managers, designers, QA, support, and other engineers.
The ideal candidate is a senior engineer with strong Python backend experience, practical frontend/web experience, and the judgment to work effectively in a mature production system. You should be comfortable improving existing systems, building new capabilities within established patterns, and balancing short-term delivery with long-term product and platform health.
This role is expected to use AI-assisted development practices where they improve quality, speed, and clarity, including CLI-based prompt and guided AI workflows as well as fully agentic development flows where appropriate. You will also help the team evolve practical, responsible patterns for AI use in partnership with other engineers.

Specific Roles & Responsibilities:

  • Design, build, test, and maintain full stack product capabilities for family billing and related back-office workflows, including invoices, payments, billing accounts, center administration, billing solution management, reporting, and operational support tooling.
  • Develop backend services, APIs, task processing, and business logic primarily in Python, following existing application patterns for authorization, data access, transactions, deferred work, and service boundaries.
  • Build and improve web application experiences using the existing frontend stack, with attention to usability, performance, accessibility, and maintainable client-side code.
  • Make pragmatic, informed decisions about technical debt, refactoring, sequencing, and tradeoffs, especially in areas where billing accuracy, data integrity, and customer trust matter.

About Us:

Our firm represents a broad array of clients in class and mass actions, individual arbitrations, and multidistrict litigation matters at the trial and appellate levels in federal and state courts. Serving hundreds of thousands of clients in litigation and arbitration, we have prosecuted high-profile mass tort, antitrust, privacy, product liability, employment, and consumer-rights cases. Our firm also acts as plaintiffs’ counsel in high-stakes public-enforcement actions. Our mission is to achieve exceptional results for our clients, drive innovation in the practice of law, and pursue unparalleled excellence in everything we do.

Purpose:

Keller Postman seeks a Docket Specialist to be responsible for using and maintaining the firm's docketing system to ensure all critical deadlines, court dates, and filing requirements are accurately tracked and met. This role serves as a key safeguard for the firm's litigation matters by providing reliable, timely, and precise docket management across all active cases.

This is a full-time, remote role. Compensation for the role includes an hourly rate of $28.00 to $40.00 per hour, commensurate with experience, plus the role is eligible for a year-end discretionary performance bonus and benefits.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Support attorneys and paralegals in the tracking of deadlines in various litigation matters.
  • Perform date calculations while applying jurisdictional rules.
  • Maintain calendaring database and update court rule sets.
  • Research and interpret laws and regulations, as well as state and federal court rules, especially in jurisdictions in which we practice.
  • Provide guidance on filing procedures across various courts and agencies.
  • Review finalized court filings for consistency with local, state, and/or federal court rules prior to filing.
  • Prepare and electronically file time-sensitive legal documents with various state and federal trial and appellate courts.
  • Investigate and report on submission procedures for attorney admissions and appearances.
  • Investigate and report on potential witnesses, such as running skip trace or other public record searches.
  • Obtain attorney Certificates of Good Standing and maintain a calendar of related expiration dates.
  • Organize and maintain attorney admissions and renewals, if necessary. This includes state bar admissions, federal court admissions, and all pro hac vice admissions.
  • Organize and maintain attorney account and login credentials for CM/ECF, and other electronic filing service providers (e.g., Odyssey).
  • Assist with necessary case docket audits.
  • Interact with docketing software technical support staff, as well as court personnel, to resolve any issues.
  • Provide quality control for all docket entries and oversee the distribution of regular docket and status reports.
  • Coordinate messenger services to deliver legal documents and evidence, as necessary.
  • Coordinate with other departments within the firm to develop efficient procedures and communications to streamline processes.
  • Work collaboratively with attorneys and Legal Support team members on miscellaneous projects.
  • Attend case-related and Legal Support department meetings and training seminars.
  • Attention to other ad hoc assignments delegated by the Docket Supervisor or Chief of Litigation Services.

Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

  • Knowledge of state and federal procedures and court processes, including but not limited to Illinois, Pennsylvania, Delaware, Texas, Florida, and/or California.
  • Knowledge of the federal courts’ CM/ECF system.
  • Knowledge of assorted state court filing systems (e.g., Odyssey).
  • Ability and willingness to work overtime on nights and weekends as needed.
  • Excellent organizational skills, with the ability to multi-task and adapt to changes quickly.
  • Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Excellent time management skills with a proven ability to meet time-sensitive deadlines and adapt to changing priorities.
  • Ability to function well under pressure and in a fast-paced, demanding environment.
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality and exercise discretion and good judgment.
  • Ability to exercise sound independent judgment and proactive problem-solving.
  • Ability to communicate with others effectively, listen closely, and convey points clearly.
  • Ability to work independently or as part of a team.
  • A creative mind with the ability to suggest improvements, and conduct cost-benefit analyses when identifying and solving problems.

Preferred Technical Skills:

  • Proficiency in Microsoft 365 (such as Outlook, Word, PowerPoint, Excel, OneDrive, and SharePoint), with the ability to learn new or updated software.
  • Proficiency in Adobe Acrobat.
  • Proficiency in Court Alert or other docketing and deadline calendaring platforms.

Education/Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college preferred
  • 2+ years of litigation docketing experience at law firm

Tekmetric is the all-in-one, cloud-based software helping auto repair shops run smarter, grow faster, and serve customers better.

Officially founded in Houston in 2017, Tekmetric has grown from a single shop’s vision to the industry’s leading solution - all by staying true to our values of transparency, integrity, innovation, and a service-first mindset.

But we’re not just building shop management software. We’re building a movement. We’re empowering repair shops to rise above the daily grind, create meaningful connections with their customers, and lead the industry forward - one interaction at a time.

Come build with us. Join the journey. Shape the future of auto repair.

Success here takes focus, follow-through, and a willingness to roll up your sleeves — but if you’re driven by meaningful work and real results, it’s deeply rewarding. You’ll join a team that cares about the work, supports one another, and takes smart risks to achieve bold goals. Be yourself, stay mission-focused, and you’ll thrive. Because we value in-person collaboration, travel is an expected part of every role. In this role, you will be responsible for leading and tracking strategic and operational programs to improve our Sales, Sales Development and Channel Partnership team’s ability to deliver on revenue & Customer health goals.

Your main objective will be to optimize Sales, Sales Development, and Channel Partnership processes, leveraging sales analytics to provide actionable insights, drive data-informed decision-making, and measure the impact of initiatives.   • Collaborate with stakeholders to identify bottlenecks and opportunities for process improvements.
  • Lead key initiatives to implement new processes and refine existing ones, ensuring they are streamlined and integrated across all revenue functions.
  • Develop and maintain dashboards and reporting tools to provide insights into key performance indicators and operational metrics.
  • Utilize data analytics to gain insights into customer behavior and success metrics, providing actionable recommendations for continuous improvement.
  • Work with leadership to develop and execute the overall customer success strategy, aligning it with the company's vision and goals to drive customer retention, expansion, and advocacy.
  • Understand customer journeys and pain points to identify areas for process improvement and customer engagement optimization.
  • Leverage data outputs to create early signs of at-risk accounts and create workflows enabling teams to action proactively.
  • Analyze sales pipeline trends, conversion metrics, and forecast accuracy to strengthen pipeline health and revenue predictability.
  • Use sales analytics to uncover productivity drivers and deal cycle bottlenecks, providing actionable insights to improve sales execution.
  • Partner with Sales leadership to turn data into strategic recommendations that improve territory planning, quota setting, and overall sales performance.

What You’ll Bring

  • 5+ years of professional experience in an advanced analytics or Customer operations role; prior experience with SaaS a plus
  • Experience developing strategies to scale revenue teams to meet the needs of our customers.
  • Strong analytical skills with proficiency in data analysis and reporting tools (e.g. Google Sheets, Excel, Tableau, Looker) preferred
  • Experience with CRM systems (e.g., HubSpot, Salesforce) and customer success platforms (e.g., ChurnZero, Zendesk, Gainsight) preferred
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across teams and influence stakeholders at all levels
  • Hands-on experience analyzing sales funnel metrics and identifying opportunities to improve conversion and pipeline efficiency.
  • Detail-oriented with a strong focus on accuracy and quality
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and manage multiple priorities effectively
  • Demonstrate a passion for designing scalable, repeatable processes and programs.
  • Proven experience in sales analytics, with the ability to extract insights from data to drive sales performance and strategy.

Why You'll Love Working With Us

About Bolt Data

A connected workplace focused on innovation Bolt Data is a connected group of technology enthusiasts that believe collaboration and genuine care for each other are at the core of everything we do. As a long-standing partner of some of the world’s most successful platforms, we offer endless opportunities to expand your technology expertise. We're deeply committed to our team members' career advancement and helping them achieve their professional goals.

Description

The Solution Architect is responsible for partnering with our clients and delivery teams to define, develop, and implement business solutions. The architect may operate as a project resource to a client delivery team, as a project resource on Bolt Data delivery team, or as a primary delivery resource accountable for end-to-end solution delivery. Once development begins, the Solution Architect’s involvement will include a combination of hands-on configuration and oversight of work assigned to other team members and will continue throughout the build and testing phases to ensure the solution comes together as designed. The Solution Architect is self-directed, can work with limited management direction and will exercise considerable judgment in determining technical objectives of an assignment.

Role Responsibilities:

Functional project support:

  • Facilitate/lead workshops to define functional requirements and solution design, providing industry best practice guidance and ensuring the proposed solution is scalable, maintainable, and meets business requirements
  • Document requirements for system configurations and technology development
  • Articulate the benefits and risks to a solution’s feasibility and functionality
  • Provide detailed level of effort estimates for proposed solutions
  • Manage scope change by recognizing when requests are outside established scope/requirements and work with the Project Manager to handle the requests properly
  • Transition requirements for system configurations and technology development with delivery teams, ensuring a complete and clear understanding of the requirements
  • Lead solution deployment activities and confirm business acceptance of delivered solution
  • Support delivery activities including system configuration, testing, end-user training, and data mapping
  • Document final solution and lead knowledge transfer to client support team
  • Know and understand the customer industry; learn the customer people processes, use cases, business goals, and technology profile of the company
  • Establish effective working relationships with key client and project team stakeholders
  • Communicate and manage expectations regarding delivery updates, risks, issues, and opportunities with key stakeholders
  • Liaise between clients, delivery teams (including vendors) to drive delivery performance, manage risks, and remove barriers
  • Hold internal demos on configuration from other delivery teams to confirm that requirements are met, and the user experience is acceptable
  • Follow and understand new ServiceNow product and technical capabilities resulting from product releases and acquisitions
  • Work with a Technical Architect to refine the design and assist with coding and integration requirements and delivery
  • Project management skills with the ability to manage issues and client engagement when Project Manager is not available

Bolt Data consulting practice support:

  • Work within the Bolt Data Methodology for consistent and reliable delivery
  • Participate in internal teams for design document reviews
  • Support Bolt Data practice maturation and internal initiatives as required
  • Develop the organization by achieving and maintaining personal development goals including ServiceNow certifications and vendor certifications
  • Support Bolt Data Sales activities by reviewing Statement of Work scope and level of effort estimates

Professional Capabilities:

  • Field Service acumen
  • Project planning and control
  • Field Service technology acumen
  • Requirements gathering and management
  • Business change management
  • Process design
  • Client relationship management
  • Functional solution design and documentation
  • Communications and influencing
  • Information architecture
  • Facilitation and consensus-building
  • Solution testing and acceptance
  • Distributed team collaboration
  • Solution deployment
  • Procedures, documentation, and methodology
  • Knowledge creation and transition of knowledge
  • Experience working independently and within a cross-functional and cross-vendor team environment
  • Desire for continuous learning and improvement
  • Assist with the candidate interview process

Leadership Capabilities:

  • Passion for customers
  • Works collaboratively
  • Drives performance and quality
  • Acts decisively with confidence and integrity
  • Thinks strategically
  • Develops people and the organization

Required Skills/Experience:

  • ServiceNow Certified Administrator certification
  • Supporting certifications including FSM, CSM, SOM, among others.
  • Solution implementation experience with Customer Relationship Management solutions
  • Demonstrated ServiceNow configuration skills.
  • Familiarity with the following technologies/code languages: Apex, HTML, CSS, Javascript
  • 7 years experience with software delivery lifecycle methodologies (e.g., Agile) and project management methodologies (e.g., PMBOK) with the ability to manage multiple projects to aggressive timelines
  • 5 years of hands-on design and deployment experience in ServiceNow with assistance in coding and integration requirements and delivery.
  • 3 years Field Service experience, including customer service management and call center support
  • Bachelor’s degree in business, technology, or equivalent experience
  • Willingness to ravel domestically and internationally with client and project team as needed. Passport with up to 25% travel.

Bonus Skills/Experience:

Master’s degree in business, technology, or 8 years equivalent experience
Familiarity with the following integration technologies: Boomi, Jitterbit, Mulesoft

We comply with all Federal, State, and Local laws and no person at Bolt Data shall be discriminated against on the basis of race, color, sex, religion, age, lifestyle, disability, marital/family status, sexual orientation, ancestry, national origin, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

raw.excerpt: OverviewThe Payroll & HR Ops Specialist is responsible for the accurate and timely administration of payroll and the execution and continuous improvement of HR operational processes across the employee lifecycle.
raw.description:
Overview

The Payroll & HR Ops Specialist is responsible for the accurate and timely administration of payroll and the execution and continuous improvement of HR operational processes across the employee lifecycle. This role manages payroll processing for a diverse workforce, including unionized hourly and salaried employees and non-union salaried exempt employees, ensuring compliance with collective bargaining agreements (CBAs), company policies, and applicable laws and regulations. In addition, the role executes key HR transactions, maintains accurate employee records and HRIS data, supports HR programs and compliance initiatives, and provides responsive, high-quality service to employees and leaders. Working closely with Payroll, Total Rewards, Finance, and CTS (IT), the Payroll & HR Ops Specialist leverages HRIS capabilities, reporting, and data analysis to strengthen data integrity, streamline workflows, improve system efficiencies, and support consistent, compliant, and effective payroll and HR operations that enhance the employee experience.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Payroll Processing & Compliance· Process weekly payroll for union and non union hourly and salaried employees, ensuring accurate application of wage rates, overtime, shift differentials, premiums, retro pay, and other earnings in alignment with CBAs and company policies.· Manage payroll changes for hires, terminations, promotions, transfers, and union status updates, while ensuring correct calculation and withholding of union dues, benefit deductions, garnishments, and related items.· Interpret and apply collective bargaining agreements and federal, state, and local wage and hour laws (including FLSA) to payroll processing and employee pay inquiries.· Partner with Total Rewards, Finance, and Pension teams on year-end processing, compensation cycles, audits, retirement transitions, and other cross functional initiatives.· Respond to employee payroll inquiries with professionalism and confidentiality and serve as a payroll subject matter resource for HR and business leaders.· Complete year-end payroll responsibilities in both Workday and UKGPayroll Auditing & Controls· Perform regular payroll audits to validate accuracy of pay, deductions, and system configurations· Review payroll registers, variance reports, and exception reports prior to payroll submission· Identify discrepancies, research root causes, and implement corrective actions to prevent reoccurrence · Support internal audits by providing payroll documentation, reports, and reconciliationsProcess Improvement, HRIS Optimization & Reporting· Evaluate workflows and procedures to identify opportunities for process improvements and efficiency gains· Partner with the HR Payroll Manager to optimize HRIS (Workday) configurations, pay rules, and automation, and support system testing, transition and implementation activities from UKG to new HRIS (Workday), integrations, configuration changes, and updates· Develop and maintain payroll procedures, job aids, and documentation to support consistent processing· Use HRIS payroll reporting tools to support payroll operations, audits, and compliance requirements, and analyze data to proactively identify risks, inefficiencies, and recurring payroll issuesEmployee Experience, Support & Projects· Serve as primary contact for HR-related inquiries, providing timely and accurate responses to procedures and programs· Partner with Total Rewards and Talent team to ensure seamless coordination of employee changes and issue resolution· Participate in or lead HR operational projects such as process standardization and documentation, system implementations, etc.· Assist with HR metrics, data analysis, and continuous improvement initiatives

Qualifications

Qualifications

  • Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in HR, Accounting, Finance, Business, or related field preferred (or equivalent experience).
  • 3+ years of progressive payroll experience supporting union and non union populations, with demonstrated ability to resolve complex pay discrepancies.· Strong knowledge of payroll regulations, wage and hour laws, and collective bargaining agreements.· Hands on experience with HRIS platforms (Workday, UKG), including involvement in system implementations or payroll process redesign.· Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and payroll reporting tools, with strong analytical and problem-solving skills.· Strong proficiency in Microsoft Word, Outlook, PowerPoint and other productivity tools· High attention to detail and ability to manage sensitive and confidential information.· Excellent communication and collaboration skills.· CPP or FPC certification preferred; multi state payroll experience preferred

Compensation

Annual Salary Range: $65K-$85K(The posted range of pay represents the anticipated pay scale for this position. Final pay will be determined based on a variety of job-related factors, including, but not limited to, skills, experience, education, certifications, internal equity, and organizational needs.)

POSITION:

As a Consultant, you will:

  • Own meaningful pieces of the work: lead defined analyses and project workstreams across research, data analysis, financial modeling, and pricing and market access topics.
  • Translate evidence into recommendations: turn data, research, and market insights into clear client-ready deliverables that support strategic decision-making.
  • Help drive project delivery: coordinate with colleagues, track progress, support day-to-day execution, and contribute to smooth communication with client counterparts.
  • Grow as a consultant and market access expert: deepen your expertise in pricing, reimbursement, access, and life sciences while contributing to proposals, knowledge assets, and a collaborative team culture.

WHY US

  • Join a team at the heart of global market access. Become part of NAVLIN's Global Pricing & Market Access (GMAP) team, a dynamic, international group that pairs deep in-house expertise with real-time intelligence on pricing, HTA, and regulatory developments through our industry-benchmark platform.
  • Work with tools that set the standard. Put advanced price-management software, launch-sequence simulation, and a fast-growing set of AI-enabled capabilities to work, turning complex data into strategic, well-grounded recommendations for our clients.
  • Lead work that shapes how therapies reach patients. Own high-stakes initiatives across Europe, APAC, and LATAM: launch sequencing and pricing for ATMPs and orphan drugs, indication-expansion planning, LOE strategy, forecasting, and asset due diligence.
  • Grow with a multicultural team that's expanding fast. Work alongside top talent from across Europe, blending local market nuance with real collaboration, in a team that grows year on year.
  • Enjoy flexible working, done properly. Do your best work remotely or from our satellite offices in London, Berlin, and Milan, all open to everyone and fully backed by robust IT.

KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS REQUIRED:

  • 2–3 years of relevant professional experience in Market Access & Pricing, management consulting, or a highly analytical pharma role.
  • Strong analytical and quantitative foundation, with the ability to structure complex problems and turn evidence into clear business implications.
  • Genuine ambition to grow into a Global Market Access & Pricing expert, building on either local market expertise or broader global exposure.
  • Clear career trajectory, with experiences showing increasing responsibility, learning agility, and potential to create value for clients.
  • Mandatory Fluency in French, fluency in English.
  • Global and local MA&P experience (e.g. France), US market exposure, or a PhD/equivalent degree would be a plus
  • Curiosity about AI-enabled and proprietary analytical tool and confidence with Excel and PowerPoint

OUR CULTURAL BELIEFS:

Patient Minded I act with the patient’s best interest in mind.

Client Delight I own every client experience and its impact on results.

Take Action I am empowered and empower others to act now.

Grow Talent I own my development and invest in the development of others. 

Win Together I passionately connect with anyone, anywhere, anytime to achieve results.

Communication Matters I speak up to create transparent, thoughtful and timely dialogue.

Embrace Diversity I create an environment of awareness and respect.

Always Innovate I am bold and creative in everything I do.

Our team is aware of recent fraudulent job offers in the market, misrepresenting EVERSANA. Recruitment fraud is a sophisticated scam commonly perpetrated through online services using fake websites, unsolicited e-mails, or even text messages claiming to be a legitimate company. Some of these scams request personal information and even payment for training or job application fees. Please know EVERSANA would never require personal information nor payment of any kind during the employment process. We respect the personal rights of all candidates looking to explore careers at EVERSANA.

From EVERSANA’s inception, Diversity, Equity & Inclusion have always been key to our success. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer, and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, and backgrounds who share a passion for improving the lives of patients and leading innovation within the healthcare industry. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion, and many other parts of one’s identity. All of our employees’ points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility.

Follow us on LinkedIn | Twitter

At EVERSANA, we are proud to be certified as a Great Place to Work across the globe. We’re fueled by our vision to create a healthier world. How? Our global team of more than 7,000 employees is committed to creating and delivering next-generation commercialization services to the life sciences industry. We are grounded in our cultural beliefs and serve more than 650 clients ranging from innovative biotech start-ups to established pharmaceutical companies. Our products, services and solutions help bring innovative therapies to market and support the patients who depend on them. Our jobs, skills and talents are unique, but together we make an impact every day. Join us!

Across our growing organization, we embrace diversity in backgrounds and experiences. Improving patient lives around the world is a priority, and we need people from all backgrounds and swaths of life to help build the future of the healthcare and the life sciences industry. We believe our people make all the difference in cultivating an inclusive culture that embraces our cultural beliefs. We are deliberate and self-reflective about the kind of team and culture we are building. We look for team members that are not only strong in their own aptitudes but also who care deeply about EVERSANA, our people, clients and most importantly, the patients we serve. We are EVERSANA.

raw.title: Co-Op & Compliance Specialist
raw.excerpt: Who is PureCars PureCars is on a mission to become automotive's reigning authority in AI-enabled data management and audience activation.
raw.description:
Who is PureCars

PureCars is on a mission to become automotive's reigning authority in AI-enabled data management and audience activation. As the industry leader in automotive marketing, we're trusted by the best dealers in North America — pairing a proprietary data platform and DMS connectivity with a team of high-touch digital strategy experts to turn data into growth.

We're a certified digital provider for 20+ OEM programs, compliant with over 40 brands, and serve 65 of the top 100 dealer groups in North America. We partner with leading platforms — Google, Meta, Amazon, Spotify, Disney+, Microsoft, Oracle, and more — to give our dealers the widest range of advertising channels available.

We're investing in world-class talent and AI-driven technology to get there, and we want people who want to build the future of automotive marketing with us.

The Role:

The Co-Op and Compliance Specialist is a member of the Finance team who provides cross-functional support to multiple departments throughout the organization. This role is responsible for managing co-op reimbursement and advertising compliance processes, ensuring submissions meet original equipment manufacturer (OEM) requirements, and identifying opportunities to improve operational efficiency and scalability.

The specialist will collaborate closely with the OEM team and other internal stakeholders to implement compliance updates, support new initiatives, maintain accurate documentation, and ensure advertising campaigns meet applicable OEM guidelines. This position also serves as a subject matter resource for co-op reimbursement and advertising compliance inquiries.

What You'll Do:

Co-Op and Advertising Compliance

  • Manage co-op reimbursement and advertising compliance processes across multiple advertising platforms and channels, including Google Ads, Microsoft Advertising (Bing), Meta, Amazon, YouTube, Spotify, traditional media, and third-party listings.

  • Review advertising campaigns and materials to ensure compliance with applicable OEM guidelines and co-op reimbursement requirements.

Paid Search

  • Maintain a working knowledge of search engine marketing (SEM) compliance standards, including approved ad copy, keywords, campaigns, and co-op eligibility requirements.

  • Collaborate with the Product Development team to identify reporting needs and support the development of co-op-related reporting solutions.

  • Maintain an understanding of Google Performance Max campaigns, including their structure, functionality, and advertising practices.

Display Advertising

  • Collaborate with the Design team to ensure advertising creative meets OEM compliance standards and approval requirements.

  • Review, revise, and optimize advertising creative as needed to satisfy OEM guidelines.

Social Media Advertising

  • Maintain knowledge of OEM-specific social media advertising requirements and compliance guidelines.

  • Develop an understanding of HUP programs and their application to Meta advertising campaigns.

Video and Over-the-Top (OTT) Advertising

  • Review video and OTT advertising assets for compliance with OEM guidelines and co-op eligibility requirements.

  • Coordinate necessary revisions to advertising content to meet OEM standards and approval requirements.

Claims Processing and OEM Coordination

  • Submit advertising materials to OEMs for compliance review and approval.

  • Prepare and submit monthly co-op reimbursement claims through OEM portals or via email, ensuring all required supporting documentation is accurate and complete.

  • Maintain strong professional relationships with dealership clients and OEM compliance representatives.

  • Research, interpret, and maintain current documentation of OEM compliance guidelines, reimbursement policies, and advertising requirements within the designated database.

  • Partner with the Billing team to obtain invoices, communicate necessary adjustments, and resolve discrepancies affecting co-op claim submissions.

  • Serve as a primary resource for internal teams and dealership clients regarding advertising compliance, co-op eligibility, reimbursement requirements, and claim-related inquiries.

Process Improvement and Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Develop a thorough understanding of PureCars’ proprietary technology, including its functionality, processes, and reporting capabilities.

  • Identify recurring process or technology issues and recommend improvements that enhance accuracy, efficiency, and scalability.

  • Collaborate with internal teams to establish consistent workflows, improve communication, and facilitate seamless transitions of responsibilities between departments.

  • Partner with the OEM team to communicate compliance updates, support new initiatives, and implement changes to existing processes.

  • Stay informed of developments in the automotive industry, digital advertising, OEM compliance requirements, and emerging advertising technologies.

  • Perform additional duties as needed in a fast-paced, evolving, technology-driven environment.

Organizational Relationships

The Co-Op and Compliance Specialist will work closely with the following teams and departments:

  • OEM Team

  • Onboarding Team

  • Design Team

  • Client Experience Team

  • Performance Managers

  • Billing Department

  • Product Development Team

Skills and Qualifications

  • Experience with automotive dealership advertising, OEM co-op programs, digital marketing platforms, and compliance processes

  • A minimum of two years of professional work experience.

  • Experience organizing, maintaining, and archiving financial records and supporting documentation.

  • Experience with billing, invoicing, and financial documentation.

  • Ability to interpret complex technical, legal, and policy-related documentation and communicate requirements in clear, practical terms.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across multiple departments and with external stakeholders.

  • Excellent organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to prioritize competing responsibilities and meet strict OEM claim submission deadlines.

  • Strong attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy when reviewing advertising materials, financial records, and reimbursement documentation.

  • Willingness and ability to learn and apply co-op reimbursement processes, OEM compliance requirements, and digital advertising standards.

  • Ability to work independently, take initiative, and manage responsibilities with minimal supervision.

  • Flexibility and adaptability in a rapidly changing, deadline-driven environment.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to identify opportunities for process improvement.

  • A positive, proactive attitude and an entrepreneurial mindset.

  • Bachelor’s degree preferred.

PureCars is committed to building diverse teams and upholding an equal employment workplace that is free from discrimination. We hire amazing individuals regardless of their race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, gender identity, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, pregnancy, medical conditions, genetic information, disability, or Veteran status. Just be passionate, genuine, collaborative, data-driven, and entrepreneurial at heart!
