raw.excerpt: ABOUT 321 THE AGENCY321 is a full-funnel creative agency built for brands that operate in complex, regulated industries — healthcare, insurance, legal services, home services, entertainment, and travel and tourism.
raw.description:
ABOUT 321 THE AGENCY

321 is a full-funnel creative agency built for brands that operate in complex, regulated industries — healthcare, insurance, legal services, home services, entertainment, and travel and tourism. We're a remote, AI-first team that combines strategic creative with CRM infrastructure, performance marketing, and paid media to drive real, measurable business outcomes for our clients.

We don't separate strategy from execution. Our digital marketing practice is built on the belief that paid media and CRM aren't parallel tracks — they're two sides of the same funnel. The Director of Digital Marketing is the leader who makes that integration happen across every client we serve.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As Director of Digital Marketing at 321, you will lead the agency's paid media and CRM/MarTech practices as a unified digital performance department. This is a senior leadership role with real strategic authority — you'll own the department's operating model, develop the team's capabilities across both disciplines, and serve as the senior digital voice in client strategy, new business, and agency planning conversations.

The right person for this role thinks in funnels, not channels. You understand that a paid search click is only as valuable as the automation sequence that follows it, that CRM segmentation should inform audience targeting, and that attribution only makes sense when you can see the full journey from impression to closed deal. You're as comfortable reviewing a High Level workflow build as you are auditing a Google Ads account structure — and you lead a team that covers both.

You'll also work in close coordination with 321 AIM, the agency's proprietary performance marketing platform, on overlapping clients, ensuring paid media strategy and lead generation infrastructure are tightly aligned rather than operating in silos.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Department Leadership & Team Development

  • Lead, manage, and grow the Digital Marketing department, which spans paid media specialists and CRM/MarTech strategists as a unified practice
  • Set the department's operating model: campaign workflows, QA standards, platform governance, reporting cadences, and cross-discipline collaboration frameworks between paid and CRM functions
  • Conduct regular 1:1s and performance reviews; provide strategic coaching and actively develop team capabilities across both paid media and marketing automation disciplines
  • Define role scopes, skill development paths, and staffing recommendations as the department grows to warrant additional headcount
  • Partner with the Director of Client Strategy to align digital performance plans with overall client strategy and business objectives
  • Serve as the escalation point for media performance issues, CRM technical challenges, and cross-channel strategy questions across the client portfolio

Paid Media Strategy & Execution

  • Own the agency's paid media strategy framework across all digital channels: Google Ads (Search, Display, YouTube, Performance Max, Demand Gen), Meta Ads, LinkedIn, TikTok, and programmatic platforms
  • Lead media planning, budget allocation, audience strategy, and campaign architecture for new and existing client accounts across 321's primary verticals — healthcare, insurance, legal services, home services, and entertainment
  • Oversee campaign setup, launch, and optimization standards — including bidding strategies, audience segmentation, creative testing frameworks, and attribution modeling
  • Develop and enforce first-party data strategies, including CRM-to-platform audience integration, customer match lists, and retargeting architecture
  • Apply working knowledge of regulated industry advertising requirements — including healthcare, insurance, and legal — to ensure campaigns meet compliance standards while still performing
  • Stay current on platform updates, privacy regulation impacts (iOS, cookie deprecation, consent mode), and measurement alternatives — and translate those into updated agency practices

CRM, Funnel & Marketing Automation

  • Lead the agency's CRM and marketing automation practice, overseeing strategy and execution for client programs built primarily on High Level, with additional experience in HubSpot and Salesforce Marketing Cloud
  • Develop full-funnel automation strategies including lead capture and qualification workflows, nurture sequences, re-engagement programs, pipeline stage triggers, and retention campaigns
  • Ensure CRM architecture decisions support paid media goals — including lead source tracking, cost-per-lead reporting by channel, and audience syndication back to ad platforms
  • Oversee funnel builds from intake form through appointment booking, sales handoff, and post-conversion retention — with particular depth in home services, legal, and healthcare client programs
  • Set quality standards for CRM deliverables: segmentation logic, workflow documentation, tagging conventions, and data hygiene practices
  • Stay current on evolving MarTech capabilities — including AI-powered personalization, conversational marketing, and automation enhancements — and proactively introduce relevant innovations to client programs

Integrated Performance & Full-Funnel Thinking

  • Champion the integration of paid media and CRM as a unified performance engine — ensuring that audience data, lead behavior, and conversion signals flow between platforms to continuously improve campaign efficiency
  • Develop cross-channel attribution frameworks that give clients a clear, accurate picture of marketing ROI from first touch through closed revenue
  • Lead the agency's performance reporting approach for digital: establishing dashboards, KPI frameworks, and narrative reporting standards that connect channel performance to business outcomes
  • Partner with 321 AIM on shared clients to ensure paid media strategy, lead qualification criteria, and CRM nurture sequences are coordinated and mutually reinforcing
  • Identify opportunities to introduce performance-based pricing models (price-per-qualified-lead) to applicable client accounts, and develop the supporting measurement infrastructure

Client Engagement & Agency Growth

  • Serve as the senior digital authority in client-facing strategy sessions, QBRs, and new business pitches — communicating complex paid and CRM strategies in clear, business-outcome terms
  • Collaborate with Client Strategy on account planning, identifying opportunities to expand digital scope, introduce new channels, or deepen automation investments
  • Contribute paid media and CRM strategy, projection modeling, and recommended tech stack recommendations to agency proposals and RFP responses
  • Champion the integration of AI tools across the digital practice — from bid management and creative performance analysis to CRM personalization and workflow automation

WHAT YOU HAVE

  • 10+ years of experience in digital marketing with demonstrated depth in both paid media and CRM/marketing automation — agency experience strongly preferred
  • At least 2–3 years in a department leadership, team lead, or senior manager role with direct reports across digital disciplines
  • Expert-level command of paid search and paid social platforms: Google Ads (Search, Display, YouTube, PMax), Meta Ads Manager, and at least one additional platform (LinkedIn, TikTok, or programmatic DSP)
  • Hands-on experience building and managing CRM programs in High Level is strongly preferred; HubSpot and/or Salesforce Marketing Cloud experience also valued
  • Proven ability to architect full-funnel automation: lead capture, qualification workflows, multi-step nurture sequences, pipeline triggers, and retention programs
  • Deep understanding of audience strategy, first-party data integration, and the mechanics of syncing CRM data with ad platforms for targeting, suppression, and lookalike modeling
  • Experience managing paid media and CRM programs in regulated industries — healthcare, insurance, legal services, or home services — including working knowledge of applicable advertising compliance requirements
  • Strong command of attribution modeling, conversion tracking implementation (Google Tag Manager, GA4), and cross-channel reporting
  • Proficiency with reporting and data visualization tools (Looker Studio, Power BI, or similar) and the ability to build client-facing dashboards that tell a clear performance story
  • Excellent communication skills — able to translate complex digital strategy into clear recommendations for clients at the CMO or ownership level
  • Comfort with AI-powered optimization tools across both paid media and CRM, and a proactive mindset toward identifying new applications
  • Strong organizational and prioritization skills with the ability to manage department operations across a remote, multi-client environment
  • Platform certifications (Google Ads, Meta Blueprint, High Level, HubSpot) are a plus
  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Advertising, Business, or a related field — or equivalent demonstrated experience

REPORTING STRUCTURE

The Director of Digital Marketing reports directly to the SVP of Strategy and is a member of the agency's leadership team. This role directly manages the Digital Marketing department, encompassing paid media specialists and CRM/MarTech strategists. The Director of Digital Marketing maintains a working relationship with 321 AIM leadership to align strategy and performance outcomes for shared clients, and collaborates closely with the Director of Client Strategy and Creative Director on integrated account delivery.

COMPENSATION

Salary Range: $120K+ annually, based on experience

321 uses a structured compensation framework aligned to role scope, department impact, and agency revenue contribution. Salary placement within range is based on demonstrated experience, leadership depth, and dual-discipline expertise across paid media and CRM. Performance bonus eligibility applies at the director level.

321 BENEFITS

  • 100% remote work environment
  • Flexible scheduling with core collaboration hours
  • Paid time off + agency-observed holidays
  • Professional development and platform/tool access budget
  • Collaborative, AI-forward team culture that values innovation and continuous learning
  • Opportunity to build and lead a unified digital practice at a high-growth agency operating at the intersection of performance marketing and marketing technology

321 the Agency is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all team members.

Salary: $125K+ negotiable

raw.excerpt: Position Summary To advance Teach For All’s 25-year vision, we are seeking a Global Lead Recruitment, Selection, & Matriculation (RSM) to advance recruitment and selection practices globally.
raw.description:
Position Summary

To advance Teach For All’s 25-year vision, we are seeking a Global Lead Recruitment, Selection, & Matriculation (RSM) to advance recruitment and selection practices globally. While this role contributes to network partners worldwide, it includes a particular emphasis on supporting and strengthening RSM practices across Asia Pacific. Success in this role means that Teach For All network partner staff have the necessary learning experiences, tools, connections, and resources to build strong recruitment, selection, and outreach strategies in order to build strong brands and to attract diverse cohorts of leaders to the program. The ideal candidate is someone who is passionate about growth, scale, leadership development, systems change, and diversity, inclusion, and equity.

This role is part of Teach For All's Global RSM team and will collaborate closely with colleagues in Teach For All’s Asia Pacific regional team and with other regional and global teams.

Global RSM Team

The Global Recruitment, Selection, and Matriculation (RSM) team is a diverse group of seven staff members with an array of expertise, ranging from teacher recruitment and professional development, to governance and placements, to leadership development and diversity, equity, and inclusion. In collaboration with others, the Global RSM team aims to develop more collective leadership by growing our network and supporting network partners to grow their impact by:

  • Supporting partners and prospective partners to live into our Unifying Principles through taking a holistic, cross-functional approach
  • Enabling partner growth through unlocking progress in planning for scaling impact, recruitment, retention, and placement
  • Fostering understanding about the next generation and experimentation in how to recruit and retain them
  • Distilling and sharing recruitment and selection insights
  • Designing and facilitating meaningful learning opportunities and communities in virtual, in-person, and blended spaces
  • Providing tailored coaching and consulting to early-stage entrepreneurs and current network partners
  • Contributing insights on recruitment, selection and matriculation to the broader global ecosystem

About the Asia Pacific Region

Teach For All’s Asia Pacific region spans one of the most vast and diverse regions in the world, from Central and North Asia to South and Southeast Asia, East Asia, and the Pacific. The region is home to 20 network organizations with 2,800 participants currently in their two-year commitments and 12,800 alumni. While contexts are different, the region shares a commitment to developing collective leadership that expands educational opportunity for all children.

This is a pivotal moment for the Asia Pacific network in Teach For All. As partners navigate growth, evolving funding landscapes, and increasingly complex systemic challenges, there is a significant opportunity to come alongside partners to help them bring in the most committed, courageous people from the next generation into our work and collectively build a better future for all children.

Responsibilities

Serve as an RSM Content Area Expert to Provide Effective 1:1 Coaching & Consulting Support

  • Ensure that Teach For All network partner organizations globally, and with a particular focus in the APAC region, are investing in their core Theory of Change by recruiting diverse and promising future leaders into their cohorts at scale.
  • Advance global RSM priorities by being a trusted thought-partner to Heads of RSM, CEOs, and senior leadership team members in the network on a range of topics such as building conviction around the need to focus on university recruitment, cultivating top talent through the selection funnel, messaging to GenZ and Gen Alpha, and more.
  • Analyze and diagnose global needs based on quantitative and qualitative evidence and co-develop global priorities and strategies for content, learning experiences, resources, and tools in topics such as: recruitment, scaling impact, messaging, social media strategy, leadership development, strategic clarity, etc.

Seek to identify and learn from bright spots and amplify partner voice and connection.

  • Provide direct coaching and consulting to network partner staff in APAC and globally, in both 1:1 and group settings, that advance RSM practices aligned with network insights and best practices, and are culturally-rooted and responsive.
  • Provide high-quality support to our network partner organizations using a multi-disciplinary lens that requires root-cause diagnosis, designing high-quality and targeted support solutions, delivering the support, and reflecting on the progress.
  • Operate with high intercultural awareness, cross-cultural competency, and a commitment to and understanding of equity, and continue learning and growing in these areas.
  • Navigate and provide direct support through highly complex layers of power, cultural, and interpersonal dynamics.

Design and Lead Learning Experiences to Strengthen RSM Practices in the Network

  • Design and lead virtual workshops, in-person conferences, and peer-to-peer learning trips for Heads of RSM and other key staff at partner organizations to build connections, explore insights, exchange best practices, and share solutions to the most pressing challenges.
  • Build and strengthen core recruiter skills on foundational topics such as delivering strong facilitation of virtual spaces and presentations and motivating candidates through storytelling.
  • Design and build e-courses that can build the knowledge base and skills of RSM leaders in the network on key functional insights.

Build a Strong Community to Foster Collaboration and Learning

  • Set the vision and design, execute, and manage the regional APAC RSM community of 20 network Heads of RSM and recruiters.
  • Facilitate regional learning calls for Heads of RSM to share best practices and problem-solve around shared challenges.
  • Contribute to fostering a strong global RSM community by facilitating meaningful peer to peer connections in smaller clusters and one-on-one.

Create Knowledge Resources & Insights to Support Learning and Growth

  • Learn alongside network partners to understand what is working in local contexts in order to share broadly.
  • Keep up with the latest RSM insights and practice in the field, including use of AI in talent sourcing and cultivation and messaging to this generation.
  • Create and curate resources, tools, and best practices to provide partner organizations with actionable knowledge development and insights by leveraging 1:1 coaching conversations, community engagements, and learning experiences to identify trends and distill global RSM and messaging insights.
  • Lead the development and execution of high-impact RSM projects and initiatives across the global network, including elevating examples of best practices and analyzing global trends.

Contribute to Teach For All's Broader Organizational Progress

  • Ensure that global progress in RSM is seamlessly integrated across Teach For All's global knowledge and operations by actively sharing insights, collaborating with internal teams, and lending expertise to key organizational priorities.
  • Drive cross-functional collaboration and alignment by acting as a liaison to other internal teams, including training and support, alumni, and organization strengths teams.
  • Actively participate in and lead flexible organizational projects that leverage your unique expertise and strengths to advance Teach For All's broader priorities.

Qualifications

  • Experience leading a RSM team and/or experience as a senior member of a RSM team in the Teach For All network is highly preferred
  • Sufficient English-language proficiency to lead group calls in English, provide 1-1 coaching and consulting in RSM, and to develop written knowledge products in English. Fluency in other languages predominantly used in APAC is valued but not required
  • Experience in designing and leading in-person and virtual adult learning spaces
  • Strong coaching and consulting skills
  • A deep grounding in the APAC context and skills to work effectively across cultures in this region
  • Experience working in close partnership with GenZ

The ideal candidate will bring the following knowledge, skills, and abilities:

  • Deep personal commitment to and nuanced understanding of Teach For All's purpose, theory of change, Unifying Principles, and Core Values, with the ability to foster understanding and investment of these among diverse stakeholders
  • Exceptional strategic thinking and problem-solving skills, with a demonstrated ability to identify organization-wide opportunities within ambiguous, complex, and high-stakes situations, and to implement innovative solutions in response while remaining culturally responsive and adaptable
  • Strong interpersonal skills and a proven ability to build and maintain collaborative relationships with multiple stakeholders across cultures, spaces, and lines of difference, and to drive results through informal authority
  • Strong organizational and flexible project management skills, with the ability to independently manage multiple shifting priorities and deliver results in a fast-paced, globally-distributed environment
  • Experience and/or comfort with leveraging social media for successful recruitment efforts

What Teach For All Offers:

  • Commitment to cultivating a culture in which all staff members feel they belong, are valued for their contributions, and have an impact on our organization’s progress
  • Professional and personal development experiences and ample opportunities to make a positive impact on the work of Teach For All and beyond
  • Comprehensive benefits package designed for your well-being and work-life needs
  • Generous time off and flexible work arrangements
  • And much more!

Application Instructions

If this opportunity sounds like the next best step in your career, please submit your resume or curriculum vitae (CV) and a one-page letter of motivation (in English) directly online. Your letter should summarize motivations for your application and how your skills and experience align with the terms of this opportunity. Description

CapsLock is a global IT marketing company that pioneers unique, scalable customer acquisition solutions for B2C clients. We solve complex sales challenges across a wide range of industries, primarily for large North American partners. By integrating our expertise in Digital Marketing, IT, Design, AI-driven analytics, proprietary MarTech, and sales consulting, we deliver powerful, data-informed customer acquisition solutions.

At CapsLock, people, technology, and forward-thinking innovation lie at the heart of everything we do. Our diverse, global team, fluent in over 10 languages, thrives on open collaboration and the exchange of new ideas, pushing boundaries to ensure our clients' success.

Role overview

We're looking for a Marketing Design Team Lead who is equal parts creative leader, marketer, and AI geek, someone who knows how to achieve business goals through visuals that actually sell.

You will take a team of 3 AI-driven Creative Designers and scale it to 6. The team produces static ad creatives, photorealistic AI visuals for performance campaigns across paid media channels, and source assets for our video production pipeline.

Your job is to build the company's visual creative engine. Whatever the starting point- a brief, a hypothesis, a raw idea - it leaves the team as a creative that performs.

You'll work closely with Creative Producers, Marketers, Copywriters, Media Buyers, and the Video Editing team, and partner with our Generative AI Pipeline Engineer on tooling and workflows.

What you will work on

  • Lead, mentor, and scale a team of 3 to 6 AI-driven Creative Designers - grow people, not just output;
  • Own the production flow: task distribution, capacity planning, and strict QC - production-grade, not demo-grade;
  • Drive creative direction: concepts, hooks, and visual angles that stop the scroll and convert;
  • Generate ideas yourself and push the team beyond safe iterations - informed by visual trends and competitor creatives;
  • Own the creative testing loop: build a database of winners, analyze failures, turn performance data into next iterations;
  • Track new AI models and tools; be the company's go-to expert on what's creatively possible with AI, staying hands-on in the tools;
  • Run regular R&D and build prompt and style libraries that keep quality consistent as the team grows;
  • Stay hands-on: jump into the tools (Figma, Adobe Suite, AI platforms) when needed to unblock the team, take on the most complex creatives, or test new approaches;
  • Partner with the Generative AI Pipeline Engineer to turn the team's creative needs into pipelines, presets, and automation;
  • Work tightly with Creative Producers, Marketers, Media Buyers, and Video Editors: align on strategy, negotiate deadlines, solve bottlenecks.

Requirements

Your must-haves

You don't need to meet every single requirement. If you're excellent in most of these areas and can show shipped work, we'd love to hear from you.

  • 5+ years of Leadership Experience: You have successfully managed creative/design teams in digital marketing. (This is not a role for a senior designer looking for their first management gig);
  • Mature Leader & Problem Solver: You build clear processes, guide your team, gracefully resolve conflicts, remain highly proactive, and stay completely open to new ideas and approaches;
  • Strong Project Manager: You drive every project cleanly to the finish line. You guarantee top-tier quality, maintain absolute order, and hit strict deadlines without excuses;
  • Strong Visual Craft: composition, lighting, color, typography, anatomy. You can articulate exactly why a creative works or doesn't;
  • Design Toolstack: proficiency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite; comfortable connecting AI outputs with traditional design pipelines;
  • AI Geek: far beyond basic prompting. You track every new model release and can't wait to test how it could level up ad creatives. Hands-on with modern AI image platforms (Figma Weave, Higgsfield, Magnific, Runway, or similar), using them for creating photorealistic visuals. Able to choose the right tool for each task, as well as to catch and fix artifacts.
  • Performance Marketing DNA: solid understanding of static ad creatives (Google, Meta, and other paid channels). You know what stops the scroll, what makes a visual sell, and how creative decisions move CTR, CPA, and conversion rate;
  • Fluency in English - both spoken and written.

Nice to have

  • A strong portfolio showcasing performance marketing creatives and AI-generated photorealistic work - ideally with examples shipped under your leadership and the results they drove;
  • Experience with creatives for high-CPA verticals (home improvement, insurance, health, legal, finance, or similar);
  • Experience creating visuals for North American audiences - you know what looks native to a US consumer;
  • Understanding of how static visuals feed video production pipelines.

What we offer

  • Remote Work - we offer a truly and fully remote environment. You choose where you are the most productive and comfortable to have an impact.
  • Paid vacations - generous paid vacation policy to ensure you have time to recharge.
  • Unlimited Sick Days - we understand that being only human means getting sick or feeling under the weather from time to time, so we guarantee you time off as long as you need to recover and get back on your feet.
  • Ongoing Learning - people at CapsLock are deeply inquisitive and eager to learn new knowledge and skills, that's why we support and create learning opportunities like the Free Books program, workshops, conferences, and more.
  • Home Office - we will cover the equipment and furniture expenses to make sure you have the best work-from-home experience.
  • Physical Well-Being - we will cover costs of your medical insurance. Additionally we offer an allowance for a flexible fitness program.
  • Fun Stuff - there is never a shortage of fun stuff.

With a commitment to trust, safety, and service excellence, we deliver tailored charter solutions and seamless travel experiences supported by a modernized fleet and nationwide reach.

The Role

The Flight Operations Coordinator is responsible for the day-of execution and operational oversight of scheduled charter flights. This role serves as the primary coordination point between Fleet Scheduling, Crew Scheduling, Flight Crews, Maintenance Control, and Client Services to ensure every trip operates safely, efficiently, and in accordance with company standards.

The Coordinator monitors assigned trips and aircraft, manages operational details, facilitates communication across departments, and proactively resolves issues that may impact trip execution — maintaining operational continuity, supporting recovery efforts, and ensuring a seamless experience for both flight crews and clients.

Areas of Responsibility

Flight Operations & Trip Execution
• Monitor assigned aircraft and trips for Day-Of and Next-Day operations.
• Ensure all trip details are accurate, complete, and operationally feasible.
• Maintain awareness of aircraft routing, schedule changes, delays, and operational impacts.
• Monitor ongoing flight activity and provide support throughout the mission lifecycle.
• Identify operational risks and escalate concerns as appropriate.
• Support irregular operations and recovery planning efforts.

Operational Coordination

• Serve as the primary operational liaison between Fleet Scheduling, Crew Scheduling, Maintenance Control, Flight Crews, and Client Services.
• Coordinate operational changes resulting from weather, maintenance events, crew limitations, airport restrictions, or client requests.
• Ensure all stakeholders have the information necessary to successfully execute assigned trips.
• Maintain continuity and communication throughout all phases of trip execution.

Mission Execution Support
• Review and validate trip details including:

– Airport operating considerations

– NOTAMs

– International requirements
– Ground transportation arrangements
– Crew accommodations
– Passenger information
– Luggage and payload considerations
• Assist in identifying and resolving operational conflicts prior to departure.

Documentation & Compliance
• Maintain accurate trip records and operational notes within company systems.
• Ensure operational documentation is complete and current.
• Support compliance with FAA Part 135 regulations, company procedures, and safety standards.
• Assist with operational reporting and tracking as required.

Communication & Client Support
• Provide timely and accurate operational updates to internal stakeholders.
• Support Client Services and Charter Sales teams with trip-related operational information.
• Communicate professionally and effectively during both routine and irregular operations.
• Assist with post-flight follow-up and operational issue resolution.

Qualifications

• Minimum of 2 years of experience in aviation operations, dispatch, scheduling, charter coordination, or a related field.
• Working knowledge of FAA Part 135 operations preferred.
• Strong organizational, prioritization, and multitasking skills.

• Ability to effectively manage multiple time-sensitive priorities in a fast-paced operational environment.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• Experience with flight scheduling, dispatch, or operational software preferred.

Key Competencies

  • Operational Awareness - Ability to understand and manage the interconnected elements of aircraft, crew, maintenance, airport, and client requirements.
  • Communication - Clear, concise, and professional communication across departments and stakeholders.
  • Problem Solving - Ability to identify operational challenges and develop practical solutions in real time.
  • Attention to Detail - Consistently maintains accuracy across trip details, documentation, and operational updates.
  • Team Collaboration - Works effectively with Fleet Scheduling, Crew Scheduling, Maintenance Control, and Flight Operations to achieve operational objectives

raw.description:
A senior revenue leader is being added to RDEL Group to accelerate growth across a growing portfolio of digital services and brands. End-to-end ownership of revenue is expected across new business, marketing, partnerships, existing client cross-selling, and commercial operations, with direct collaboration alongside the CEO, President, and the broader leadership team.

This role is built for a proven sales and marketing leader with demonstrable experience operating in a digital consulting or digital agency model who can step in as a player-coach immediately, then scale a high-performing sales and marketing function with strong process, clear metrics, and disciplined execution.

Why this role now

Strong delivery capability and a growing client base have been built, including expansion through acquisitions and new service lines. The next stage requires a dedicated leader to unify go-to-market efforts, rebuild and strengthen pipeline generation, and drive consistent account development through cross-selling and up-selling. Revenue leadership is expected to become a core operating system, not an ad hoc effort.

What will be owned

Revenue growth across the full portfolio, including (but not limited to):

  • Website strategy, design, and production
  • Support and maintenance retainers
  • Performance marketing and demand generation (paid media, CRO, email)
  • SEO and content programs
  • Creative and video production
  • Emerging services as the agency expands (including consulting and AI-enabled offerings)

A cohesive revenue strategy is expected, with sales and marketing operating as one system and sharing targets, reporting, and feedback loops.

Key responsibilities

Revenue strategy and leadership

  • A revenue plan that connects targets to pipeline coverage, conversion rates, and execution capacity is established and managed.
  • Quarterly and monthly forecasts are maintained with accuracy and defended with data (pipeline health, stage conversion, close timelines, service mix).
  • Go-to-market positioning is refined (ICP, vertical focus, offer packaging, pricing posture, proof points).
  • Cross-functional alignment is driven so that what is sold can be delivered predictably and profitably, with healthy margins protected.

New business sales (hands-on)

  • Net-new opportunities are generated, qualified, and advanced through a disciplined process (inbound and outbound).
  • Discovery, proposals, and closing conversations are led with confidence, including complex service bundles and multi-stakeholder deals.
  • A repeatable consultative sales motion is implemented for professional services (diagnose, scope, value, close).
  • Win-loss analysis is captured and translated into improvements across messaging, qualification, and offers.

Account development, cross-sell, and expansion

  • A practical account development motion is implemented across the existing client base (account planning, relationship mapping, renewal strategy, and quarterly opportunity reviews).
  • Cross-sell and up-sell strategies are built and operationalized across service lines so that clients experience one cohesive partner, not disconnected offerings.
  • Client and service “penetration” is improved through packaging, clearer pathways between services, and proactive commercial leadership.

Marketing ownership and demand generation

  • A demand generation engine is built that reliably produces qualified pipeline, not vanity metrics.
  • Channel strategy is owned across content, paid media, events, partnerships, email, and website conversion performance.
  • Brand and messaging are governed so the market hears one clear story and the sales motion is supported with strong assets.
  • Marketing ROI is measured against pipeline and revenue contribution, with clear accountability.

Partnerships and channel development

  • A partner strategy is rebuilt and scaled, with clear standards for identification, enablement, co-selling, and ongoing relationship management.
  • Referral partnerships and channel performance are measured and optimized, with consistent follow-through and cadence.

Revenue operations and process maturity

  • CRM discipline is enforced (stages, definitions, activity standards, reporting hygiene).
  • A weekly operating rhythm is implemented (pipeline reviews, deal strategy, marketing-to-sales alignment, forecasting cadence).
  • Key systems and workflows are improved so revenue becomes predictable and scalable.

What success looks like

In the first 30 to 60 days

  • Current pipeline, win rates, service mix, and process gaps are assessed.
  • ICP, positioning, and priority offers are tightened where needed.
  • A forecasting and pipeline review cadence is running with leadership, with clear definitions and expectations.

By 90 days

  • A consistent outbound and inbound operating model is active.
  • Proposal quality and close process are standardized.
  • Sales and marketing operate as an integrated system with shared metrics.
  • A practical hiring plan exists for an eventual revenue team build-out (roles, sequencing, and performance expectations).

Within 6 to 12 months

  • Pipeline becomes more predictable, with clear coverage targets and improved conversion.
  • Existing accounts show measurable growth through structured account development.
  • Partnerships contribute consistent, trackable opportunities.
  • Reporting, forecasting, and commercial operations run with repeatable discipline.

Experience and qualifications

  • 8 to 12+ years of progressive revenue leadership, with significant time in a digital agency or professional services firm.
  • Proven track record personally closing deals for services like website builds, retainers, performance marketing, SEO, and related offerings.
  • Demonstrated ability to build pipelines, lead a quota-carrying team, and run forecasting with discipline.
  • Strong discovery and executive presence, able to sell value and outcomes, not hours and tasks.
  • Comfort operating in a smaller company environment where action, accountability, and pace matter.
  • Experience building sales and marketing functions (process, people, tooling, enablement).

Traits that fit this role

  • High drive and competitive standards, with a strong bias toward measurable outcomes.
  • Direct communicator who can coach, challenge, and support a team.
  • Structured operator who builds repeatable systems, not one-off heroics.
  • Client-first mindset paired with commercial discipline.

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience selling into the public sector, higher education, nonprofits, or regulated industries.
  • Familiarity with common agency revenue tools and workflows (including CRMs like Pipedrive, proposal tooling, attribution, and enablement systems).
  • Experience integrating go-to-market motions across multiple brands or acquired entities.

RDEL is a remote-first company, but we require all staff to attend certain annual events and meetings in person. Candidates must be located in Canada, ideally in Ottawa or Toronto (GTA).

raw.description:
Verianis an independent research, evidence, evaluation, and communications agency that helps governments solve public policy challenges by working with citizens and the public realm.

We provide services to government and public sector organizations, drawing on expertise in social research, policy development, and communication.

The agency operates globally, with offices across Europe, Asia Pacific, and the US.

About the role

Senior data processing analyst

· Remote (EU) · 12-month service contract, with intention to extend

Why this role is different

Verian runs some of the largest and most complex survey programmes in Europe - for EU institutions, national governments of the UK and EU Member States, national statistical offices, and a wide range of other national and regional public bodies. The data you process and quality-assure directly informs public policy decisions across the continent.

We are looking for a senior data processing specialist for whom two things will be true at once:

  • Your craft is at the centre. The core of the role is expert delivery: processing, weighting, quality-assuring and delivering accurate survey data to demanding deadlines, in a fast-paced environment where project teams - and ultimately clients across Europe - rely on your depth and judgement every day.
  • You will help co-create the automation. Verian is investing heavily in automated, code-based and AI-assisted data processing, and this work is happening now, in live production. As you deliver, you will work directly with our AI and automation engineers - shaping and helping build cutting-edge solutions for your own discipline, and learning hands-on how modern tooling is applied to real, large-scale programmes.

What you will do

  • Own the data processing side of projects end to end: specifications, data management, quality assurance, documentation and final deliverables
  • Carry out weighting, significance testing and other statistical procedures, working with methods specialists on complex survey designs
  • Produce high-quality data tables, datasets and analytical outputs
  • Help develop automated processing workflows in Python and/or R, including modernising existing SPSS-based processes
  • Apply AI-assisted tools to coding, QA, validation and documentation
  • Act as the technical contact for project directors, project managers and, where needed, clients
  • Mentor and develop less experienced analysts as the team grows

What you need from day one

  • Proven senior-level experience in survey data processing within market, social or policy research
  • Strong coding in Python and/or R applied to data processing, validation or automation
  • Solid survey statistics: weighting, significance testing, confidence intervals
  • Deep understanding of survey data structures and downstream delivery requirements
  • Professional working proficiency in English. Knowledge of German and/or French would be an advantage

What will strengthen your application (not required — much of this you will learn here)

  • Interest in, or experience with, AI-assisted development tools - highly useful in this role
  • SPSS and experience modernising SPSS workflows into code
  • SQL, Databricks, Azure or other cloud data platforms
  • Data visualisation (Power BI, R Shiny, Dash or similar)

What we offer

  • Indicative rate of €2,900–4,300 per month — the final offer will be agreed based on your specific skills and experience
  • Full-time engagement on an initial 12-month service contract (independent contractor or affiliate arrangement), with the intention to extend
  • Fully remote, based anywhere in the EU
  • A place in Verian's global Data Solutions team, reporting to a global manager in London, working on one or several large assignments alongside project directors and managers across Europe
  • A rare chance to apply and learn state-of-the-art AI and automation approaches on real, large-scale programmes

The process — quick and simple

One introductory call, which will also cover the technical side; potentially a small practical task; then a fast decision. The work is available now and waiting — we will come back to you immediately, so if this sounds interesting, please get in touch as soon as you can.

Salary: 2,900–4,300

Overview

Our mission is Better Health. Our passion is helping others.

What’s Your Why?

  • Are you looking for a career opportunity that will help you grow personally and professionally?
  • Do you have a passion for helping others achieve Better Health?
  • Are you ready to join a growing team that shares your mission?

Why Join Our Team: At Better Health Group, it’s our commitment, our passion, and our culture that sets us apart. Our Team Members make a difference each and every day! They support our providers and payors, ensuring they have the necessary tools and resources to always deliver best-in-class healthcare experiences for our patients. We don’t just talk the talk - we believe in it and live by it. Be part of a team that shares your passion and drive, and start living your purpose at Better Health Group.

Responsibilities

Reports To: Manager, Operations

Position Objective

The Health Coach supports patient health outcomes through proactive outreach, education, and care coordination. The incumbent engages patients primarily by telephone to facilitate transitions of care following hospitalizations or other healthcare events, coordinate preventive care appointments, support medication adherence, and identify potential barriers to accessing care.

Working collaboratively with patients, healthcare providers, and internal teams, the Health Coach helps patients navigate healthcare services, promotes engagement in recommended care, and supports efforts to reduce avoidable hospital readmissions and improve overall patient well-being.

Responsibilities:

  • Conduct proactive telephonic outreach to patients to support engagement in recommended healthcare services, preventive care, and follow-up activities.

  • Facilitate Transitional Care Management (TCM) outreach following hospital discharges or other qualifying healthcare events, coordinating timely follow-up appointments and communication between patients and their healthcare providers.

  • Support efforts to reduce avoidable hospital readmissions by reinforcing discharge instructions, identifying potential barriers to follow-up care, and connecting patients with appropriate clinical or operational resources.

  • Contact patients to schedule Annual Wellness Visits and other recommended preventive care appointments in accordance with established outreach protocols.

  • Conduct Social Determinants of Health (SDOH) surveys to identify potential barriers to care, including transportation, food insecurity, housing instability, and other nonmedical needs, and refer identified concerns to appropriate resources or internal teams.

  • Support medication adherence by contacting patients to confirm prescription fills, identifying potential access barriers, and coordinating with pharmacies, providers, or internal teams as appropriate.

  • Educate patients on available healthcare benefits, resources, and services to encourage appropriate utilization and ongoing engagement in their care.

  • Document patient outreach, appointment coordination, identified barriers, and follow-up activities accurately and timely within designated systems.

  • Collaborate with clinical and operational teams to escalate patient concerns, coordinate outstanding follow-up needs, and support continuity of care.

  • Maintain patient confidentiality and comply with HIPAA, organizational policies, and established care coordination protocols.

  • Perform additional duties as assigned.

Position Requirements / Skills:

  • High school diploma or equivalent required; associate's or bachelor's degree in healthcare, health promotion, public health, psychology, or a related field preferred.

  • 1+ year of experience in healthcare, patient outreach, care coordination, health coaching, customer service, or a related field preferred.

  • Familiarity with healthcare operations, preventive care, Transitional Care Management (TCM), medication adherence, and Social Determinants of Health (SDOH) preferred.

  • Strong interpersonal and patient engagement skills, with the ability to establish rapport, demonstrate empathy, and communicate effectively with diverse patient populations.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, particularly in conducting telephonic outreach, explaining healthcare information, and coordinating with patients and providers.

  • Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple patient outreach activities, prioritize follow-up needs, and maintain accurate documentation.

  • Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify barriers to care, determine appropriate next steps, and escalate concerns in accordance with established protocols.

  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with clinical, operational, and other cross-functional teams.

  • Proficiency with Google Workspace (Drive, Docs, Sheets, Slides) and the ability to navigate electronic medical records, patient management systems, and other healthcare technology.

  • Strong attention to detail, accountability, and commitment to completing assigned outreach and follow-up activities accurately and timely.

  • Demonstrated ability to maintain confidentiality and handle protected health information in accordance with HIPAA and organizational policies.

  • Appreciation of cultural diversity and sensitivity toward the patient populations served.

Physical Requirements:

  • Ability to remain in a stationary position, primarily sitting, for extended periods while performing telephonic outreach and computer-based administrative work.

  • Ability to regularly operate a computer, keyboard, mouse, telephone, headset, and other standard office equipment.

  • Ability to communicate and exchange information with patients, healthcare providers, and team members by telephone and through electronic communication platforms.

  • Ability to review electronic medical records, patient information, and other detailed documentation for accuracy and completeness.

  • Ability to occasionally stand, walk, bend, and reach while performing routine office activities.

Key Attributes/ Skills:

  • Has a contagious and positive work ethic, inspires others, and models the behaviors of core values and guiding principles.

  • An effective team player who contributes valuable ideas and feedback and can be counted on to meet commitments.

  • Is able to work within our Better Health environment by facing tasks and challenges with energy and passion.

  • Pursues activities with focus and drive, defines work in terms of success, and can be counted on to complete goals.

Cedars-Sinai netted high scores across multiple verticals and particularly excelled in areas of infrastructure, interoperability, and population health innovation.

Why work here?

The Senior Health Equity Analyst/ Data Intelligence Analyst partners with clinical, operational, and technical stakeholders to translate business and clinical needs into data-driven insights that advance health equity. This role gathers and translates complex business requirements, data definitions, business rules, and data quality standards into actionable analytical solutions, reports, dashboards, and data sets that support health equity measures.

In addition to strong technical and analytical capabilities, this position requires an understanding of how healthcare data can be used to identify, measure, and address disparities in care delivery, access, utilization, quality, and patient outcomes across diverse patient populations. The analyst evaluates data through a health equity lens, helping stakeholders understand not only what the data reveals, but also what those findings may mean for equitable care delivery, organizational performance, and patient outcomes.

The successful candidate will combine advanced analytical thinking, healthcare data expertise, and an understanding of health equity principles to develop meaningful insights, support evidence-based decision-making, and contribute to initiatives that improve healthcare quality and reduce disparities.

  • Translates end-user requests into complex business and technical requirements, including data definitions, business rules, and data quality specifications, supporting health equity initiatives.
  • Develops specifications for reports, dashboards, and analytical solutions based on business and clinical needs, available data elements, and defined health equity measures and objectives.
  • Writes Structured Query Language (SQL) code and queries to extract, transform, validate, and analyze data from internal and external sources, identifying trends, variations, and potential disparities in healthcare delivery and outcomes.
  • Analyzes complex business and clinical questions using quantitative and qualitative data, applying critical thinking and healthcare knowledge to identify patterns, gaps, and opportunities for improvement across patient populations.
  • Demonstrates a strong understanding of report analysis and development, including the ability to triage data requests, clarify stakeholder needs, and translate business questions into meaningful analytical approaches that support health equity priorities.
  • Produces sophisticated reports, data sets, dashboards, and analytical deliverables in collaboration with team members, vendors, and Enterprise Information Systems (EIS) stakeholders, communicating findings and actionable insights to clinical, operational, and organizational decision-makers.
  • Supports the identification, measurement, and monitoring of health disparities by analyzing relevant patient population data, including appropriate demographic and other available data elements, to evaluate differences in access, utilization, quality, and outcomes.
  • Evaluates data quality, completeness, consistency, and appropriate use of patient population data, recognizing how limitations in data collection, classification, and reporting may affect the identification and interpretation of health disparities.
  • Partners with clinical and operational stakeholders to understand the implications of analytical findings and support the development of data-informed strategies, performance measures, and improvement opportunities that advance health equity.
  • Participates in the re-engineering of operational workflows, as needed, working with end users and business owners to evaluate existing processes, identify opportunities for improvement, and assess the potential impact on patient care and equitable service delivery.
  • Contributes to strategic discussions by proactively identifying analytical and technical options, evaluating associated advantages and limitations, and recommending approaches that align with organizational priorities, data intelligence objectives, and health equity goals.
  • Communicates analytical findings in a clear, accessible, and actionable manner, helping stakeholders understand the relationship between data insights, identified disparities, and opportunities to improve care delivery and health equity outcomes.

*Approved Remote States: Arizona, California, Colorado, Florida, Georgia, Minnesota, Nevada, Oregon, Texas*

raw.description:
About the Role
Astrana is growing through acquisition and partnership. The Integration Lead owns that problem. You will run post-close integration for acquired entities and lead implementation for new partnerships and market launches, from signing through steady state. You will stand up the integration management office for each transaction, define the workstreams, hold the functional owners accountable to a plan, surface risks to the executive team early, and personally close the gaps nobody else owns.
This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports. Your leverage comes from influence over functional owners, not from headcount. This is not a coordination role either. You will build the Day 1 and Day 100 plans, reconcile the provider roster, pressure-test the synergy model, draft the physician communication, sit in the health plan delegation audit, and present the status readout to the CEO and CFO. The right candidate moves comfortably between those altitudes in the same week and is curious enough to go learn whatever the next workstream requires.
You will report to the Vice President of Strategy & Partnerships and work daily with Finance, Provider Contracting, Network Management, Claims, Health Plan Operations, Clinical and Quality, Risk Adjustment, Technology, Legal, Compliance, and People, as well as the leadership teams of the organizations we acquire and partner with.
Our Values
  • Put Patients First
  • Empower Entrepreneurial Provider and Care Teams
  • Operate with Integrity & Excellence
  • Be Innovative
  • Work As One Team

What You'll Do

Lead end-to-end integration of acquired entities
  • Build and run the integration management office (IMO) for each transaction: integration charter, governance cadence, workstream structure, decision rights, and escalation paths
  • Develop Day 1, Day 100, and 12-month integration plans with clear milestones, owners, dependencies, and critical path; manage transition services agreements (TSAs) through exit
  • Own the integration budget and synergy tracker; partner with FP&A to validate synergy assumptions, track realization against targets, and flag variances to leadership
  • Run weekly workstream reviews and biweekly executive steering committee meetings; prepare board-level and executive readouts on status, risks, and decisions required
  • Participate in pre-close diligence so that the integration thesis, risks, and resource needs are understood before signing, not discovered after
Drive the functional workstreams that make a managed care integration work
  • Provider network and contracting: migration of PCP and specialist agreements, division of financial responsibility (DOFR) alignment, capitation and fee schedule transitions, provider roster reconciliation and credentialing continuity
  • Health plan and delegation: transition of delegated functions (UM, credentialing, claims, care management), delegation agreement amendments, health plan notifications, and readiness for delegation oversight audits; regulatory filings with DMHC, CMS, and other state regulators as required
  • Finance and claims: claims run-out and system cutover, IBNR and capitation payment handoffs, bank and vendor transitions, entity and intercompany structure changes with Accounting and Legal
  • Clinical, quality, and risk adjustment: continuity of HEDIS and Stars reporting, care gap programs, supplemental data submission, risk adjustment documentation workflows, and care management caseloads through the transition
  • Technology and data: provider, member, and eligibility data migration; EHR, claims platform, and analytics integration; onboarding to Astrana's provider-facing tools
  • People and change management: provider and staff communications, town halls, key-person retention, role mapping, and culture integration with the People team
Lead implementation for new partnerships and market launches
  • Translate signed partnership and management services agreements into implementation plans: service scope, staffing, systems, reporting, and performance targets
  • Onboard new IPAs and provider groups onto the Astrana platform, including MSO service standup, data connectivity, quality and risk adjustment program launch, and provider engagement
  • Support the build of repeatable market-entry and affiliation playbooks so that each new partnership launches faster and cleaner than the last
Build the capability, not just the project
  • Develop and maintain Astrana's integration and implementation playbook: standard workplans, checklists, templates, KPIs, and lessons-learned reviews
  • Identify where integration repeatedly stalls and fix the underlying process, tooling, or ownership gap
Operate at every altitude
  • Present to and take direction from C-level executives; translate executive intent into workstream-level action
  • Produce your own work product: financial models, data reconciliations, process maps, communication drafts, and status materials
  • Other duties as assigned

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in business, healthcare administration, public health, finance, or a related field, or equivalent experience
  • At least 6 years of progressive experience in healthcare operations, strategy, management consulting, corporate development, or a transformation / PMO function or similar functions
  • Direct experience leading at least one end-to-end M&A integration, large-scale implementation, or enterprise transformation with multiple concurrent workstreams and cross-functional owners
  • Demonstrated ability to work with executive leadership: structuring decisions, delivering difficult status updates, and gaining alignment across functions and people you do not manage
  • Strong analytical and financial fluency: comfortable building and auditing models in Excel, reading a P&L, and interrogating a synergy case
  • Excellent written and verbal communication; able to produce executive-ready materials without heavy editing
  • Proven ability to operate in ambiguity, manage competing priorities, and deliver on deadlines in a fast-paced environment
  • Ability to travel up to 25%, including to acquired and partner organizations in and outside California
Preferred
  • Experience in managed care, delegated risk, IPA / MSO, or value-based care environments; familiarity with capitation, DOFRs, health plan delegation, HEDIS / Stars, and Medicare Advantage risk adjustment
  • Experience with corporate practice of medicine structures, Knox-Keene or other state health plan licensure, and physician organization governance
  • Background in management consulting, corporate development, or an internal strategy / chief of staff function
  • Experience with claims and care management platforms (e.g., EZCAP) and provider data systems
  • MBA, MHA, MPH, or similar advanced degree
  • PMP, Lean / Six Sigma, or Prosci change management certification

Environmental Job Requirements and Working Conditions

  • Periodic travel to acquired and partner organizations, including multi-day site visits during integration milestones.
  • The total compensation target pay range for this role is between $140,000 - $160,000. This salary expectation represents our national target range for this role

This is a remote role. The ideal incumbent will reside within the territory, in Arkansas, Louisiana, Mississippi, Tennessee, or Alabama.

About Vive

Vive is a high-growth trajectory, sustainable agtech firm founded in 2006 and headquartered in Mississauga, ON. Our Made in Canada, patented Allosperse® delivery technology helps farmers do more with less. By bringing the power of Precision Chemistry™ to agriculture, Vive is connecting the lab to the field, enabling growers to cut costs and reduce their environmental footprint. We are fully commercial with established distribution across the US, and our products were used in USA and Canada on over 2.3 million acres in 2025, with total treated acreage growing at 149% per year on average.

We were recently selected as part of the inaugural cohort of the Government of Canada’s Global Hypergrowth Project, and we are well on our way to becoming Canada’s leading anchor agtech firm. We’ve received several awards for culture and innovation, been named the SDTC Changemaker of the Year, and ranked #196 on the list of the fastest-growing companies in the Americas. With over 100+ patents, and a vision of having a Vive solution on every acre, we’re looking for passionate, growth-minded individuals to join us on our journey!

At Vive, our core values are the foundation of everything we do and are a guiding force for all the exciting and unique experiences you will have when working with us. 

  • We are grower-focused
  • We succeed through collective genius
  • We are building something real
  • We are confident and adaptiveowners 
  • We are data-driven

If you’re looking to build something real with a team of smart, confident and adaptive owners (and like to have LOTS of fun along the way), keep reading to learn more about the Territory Sales Manager, Delta role and the role you will play in helping us reach our goals!

Mission

Your core mission is to ensure that Vive’s portfolio sales objectives across the Delta territory are met. As a core member of the Sales and Marketing team, you will play an integral part in the Company’s success. You have an excellent understanding of the US agricultural marketplace and have past experience in agricultural sales. You understand the agricultural distribution model and will work to expand Vive’s market position, sales, and relationships with existing and new retail accounts across the Delta territory. You are a self-driven individual who is passionate about winning and representing a unique and novel product line in a highly competitive agricultural marketplace.

You will deliver on this mission by: 

  1. Business Planning - Developing and executing retail business plans including sales forecasts and new market opportunities. Meeting the needs of our retail customers, enabling them to exceed revenue expectations with our product portfolio
  2. Retail Sales Management - Developing the necessary relationships and business influence with distributor retail and wholesale accounts, COI partners, and key growers to achieve Vive’s sales & business objectives for the territory.
  3. Market Expansion - Co-developing and executing new crop protection programs and ideas within key crops of corn, potatoes, alfalfa, and others, which enable Vive’s product portfolio to grow and be differentiated versus competitors.

Interacts with:

  • Internally – US Sales Team, Marketing (Product Management & Communications), Product Development
  • Externally – Agricultural retailers and personnel, Key Growers, and agricultural distributors and personnel throughout sales territory

Specific Duties & Responsibilities

  • Ensures that Vive’s portfolio sales objectives are achieved in the US Delta territory of AR, LA, MS, TN and AL.
  • Works to expand Vive’s market position, sales, and relationship with existing and new retail and grower accounts within the region.
  • Ensures key information is routinely updated in CRM, enabling a conduit of market intelligence for the organization.
  • Develops and executes sales strategies and business plans which support the joint business needs of our customers and Vive Crop Protection.
  • Establishes productive and professional relationships with key personnel in assigned customer accounts.
  • Uses creativity, market knowledge, and business knowledge to provide innovative ideas for business growth.
  • Works closely with the Sales and Marketing team to support the “voice of the customer."
  • Works closely with all departments in Vive in supporting our overall culture and business growth.

Skills & Experiences

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher.
  • 5 or more years of experience in field sales in agriculture.
  • Sound agronomic understanding of crop protection products and their use.
  • Experience in the liquid fertilizer or biological market a plus.
  • Experience with managing and calling on ag retailers, key growers, and ag distributors.
  • Experience launching new products and/or technologies into the ag marketplace.
  • Excellent understanding of the agricultural marketplace within the Delta states, excellent understanding of respective crops grown within the region, and experienced in agricultural sales.
  • Excellent agronomic knowledge and ability to apply it in supporting differentiated product selling.
  • Proven ability, to influence and build relationships with customers (growers, retailers, and distributors) to generate purchases of innovative agricultural crop protection products.
  • Experience in establishing deep and meaningful relationships with customer base.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills.
  • Effective in small team settings driving collaborative approach.
  • Self-driven individual who is passionate about winning and representing a unique and novel product line in a highly competitive agricultural marketplace.

Requirements

  • Valid passport with ability to travel as needed across the US and Canada
  • Valid driver’s license and good driving record

The IT Client Delivery Leader is the primary IT advocate and strategic relationship leader for assigned divisions/markets within Surgery Partners. This role serves as the connective point between divisional leadership, facility operators, clinical and business stakeholders, local IT resources, corporate IT teams, vendors, and enterprise shared services. The position is accountable for ensuring that IT services, projects, support models, cybersecurity expectations, and technology roadmaps are aligned with divisional priorities and enterprise standards. The IT Client Delivery Leader translates business needs into actionable IT demands, advocates for the division within enterprise IT planning and prioritization processes, and ensures technology delivery supports safe, efficient, compliant, and scalable healthcare operations across hospitals, ambulatory surgery centers, physician practices, and related care settings.

Key Responsibilities

IT Client Delivery Services is responsible for ensuring that each division and market receives consistent, responsive, and business-aligned IT partnership. While maintaining alignment with enterprise IT standards, policies, architecture, and service delivery processes, the following duties are core expectations of this role:

Divisional IT Advocacy
Serve as the primary IT advocate for assigned divisional leadership, ensuring divisional priorities, operational/clinical needs, risks, and service concerns are represented in enterprise IT planning, governance, prioritization, and execution.

Executive Relationship Management
Build trusted working relationships with division presidents, market leaders, facility executives, clinical operators, physician practice leaders, and shared-service stakeholders to understand business objectives and translate them into IT needs.

Demand Intake and Prioritization
Assist with and guide divisional IT demand, including operational requests, project needs, technology gaps, service issues, regulatory concerns, and growth-related requirements; partner with corporate IT leaders to prioritize work against enterprise capacity and risk.

Budgets and IT Costs
Assist with the development of IT budgets and guide IT spending decisions. Recommend and explain technology as needed to enable standardized, cost effective and functionally suitable solutions.

Service Delivery Oversight
Monitor IT service performance for the assigned division, identify recurring issues or service gaps, escalate barriers, and coordinate with infrastructure, applications, cybersecurity, service desk, field services, data, and vendor teams to drive resolution.

Project and Initiative Alignment
Partner with project managers, solution owners, technical teams, and divisional stakeholders to ensure IT initiatives are appropriately scoped, communicated, sequenced, adopted, and delivered in support of divisional and enterprise objectives.

Risk, Compliance, and Cybersecurity Alignment
Promote adherence to corporate IT standards, cybersecurity controls, HIPAA requirements, audit expectations, and healthcare regulatory obligations while helping divisional leaders understand technology risk and required remediation actions. Help drive coordination and response from site tasks for the assigned division.

Communication and Change Enablement
Provide clear, timely communication to divisional stakeholders regarding IT changes, outages, projects, standards, support processes, and technology decisions; support adoption of new solutions through stakeholder engagement, readiness planning, and feedback loops.

Issue Escalation and Resolution
Act as a senior point of coordination for complex or high-impact IT issues affecting divisional operations, ensuring appropriate ownership, follow-through, executive visibility, and closure.

Continuous Improvement
Identify opportunities to improve IT service consistency, responsiveness, standardization, transparency, and business value across the division and across the broader three-division operating model.

Overall, the goal of the IT Client Delivery Leader is to ensure each division has a clear, accountable IT partner who understands its operational priorities, advocates for its needs, connects it effectively to enterprise IT capabilities and processes, and helps deliver secure, reliable, and value-driven technology services.

Education and Experience Requirement of the IT CDL

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in information technology, healthcare administration, business administration, or related field, or comparable work experience.

IT & Healthcare Experience

  • Proven experience, typically 5+ years, in IT leadership, client delivery, relationship management, healthcare technology operations, or related roles.
  • In-depth understanding of IT service delivery, demand management, incident escalation, project delivery, change management, governance, and continuous improvement practices.
  • Prior healthcare operations or healthcare IT experience related to hospitals, ambulatory surgery centers, physician practices, or other care delivery environments is strongly preferred.
  • Working knowledge of healthcare regulatory, privacy, security, audit, and compliance expectations, including HIPAA and applicable corporate governance standards.

Travel

  • Ability to travel as needed to support divisional leadership, facility engagement, critical initiatives, escalations, projects and operational reviews; estimated travel up to 50%.

General Experience and Skills

  • Ability to work in a self-directed manner with minimal supervision to accomplish the task
  • Ability to think strategically and take decisive action tactically
  • Strong verbal, written and presentation skills
  • Strong negotiation and conflict resolution skills
  • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail
  • Ability to work independently or in collaboration with multi-disciplinary teams
  • Ability to manage frequent interruptions that result in having to re-evaluate priorities
  • Ability to adapt to changing client needs and evolving technology landscapes
  • Exceptional problem-solving and critical-thinking abilities
  • Possesses strong business acumen and the ability to communicate effectively with executives, operators, clinicians, technical teams, and vendors.
  • Ability to function efficiently in stressful work environments
  • Maintains regular attendance habits, follows directions, takes initiative

Benefits:

  • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance
  • Health Savings Account with an employer contribution
  • Life Insurance
  • PTO
  • 401(k) retirement plan with a company match
  • And more!

ENVIRONMENTAL/WORKING CONDITIONS: Normal busy office environment with much telephone work. Possible long hours as needed. *No Recruiters Please

Equal Employment Opportunity & Work Force Diversity

Our organization is an equal opportunity employer and will not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment based on race, color, creed, sex, religion, marital status, age, national origin or ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, parental status, sexual orientation, veteran status, genetic testing results or any other consideration made unlawful by federal, state or local laws. Third Wave Business Systems, a portfolio company of Pine, is currently seeking a strategic and experienced VP of Finance to join their leadership team.

What We Do

    Third Wave Business Systems is an ERP and technology services firm that helps mid-market manufacturing and distribution businesses select, implement, and support the systems they run on, including Acumatica, SAP Business One, and SYSPRO. Its consultants, sales, and support teams partner with clients for the long term.

Who We Are

    Third Wave is part of Pine Services Group, a long-term, buy-and-hold company within Evergreen Services Group. Pine partners with B2B ERP and technology services firms for the long run, giving each company the resources of a larger organization while preserving the culture and client relationships that made it successful.

Who We Need

    Third Wave is seeking a VP of Finance to lead its finance and accounting function and serve as a key member of the leadership team. This person will own consolidation and reporting for a growing, multi-entity business, then spend most of the month turning the numbers into insight for leaders. They will lead a team of two Accounting Managers and work closely with the Pine finance team. The ideal candidate pairs a strong accounting foundation with sharp FP&A skills and is energized by building structure.

What You'll Do

    • Lead and develop a finance and accounting team, including two Accounting Managers who each own the close for a business unit

    • Own consolidation and below-the-line accounting for a multi-entity, private equity-backed business

    • Review each business unit's close to ensure the numbers are accurate and make sense

    • Lead FP&A, including budgeting, forecasting, and analysis that informs strategic decisions

    • Build dashboards and reporting for three GM-level P&L owners and across two historical business units

    • Architect reporting structures in Acumatica, partnering with the internal Acumatica team

    • Present monthly results for Third Wave leadership and Pine, with clear commentary on what is driving performance

    • Partner with the Pine finance team on KPIs, reporting, and analysis

    • Bring an informed point of view on where the business model is strong, where it can improve, and how

    • Shape the future state of the finance organization as the business grows

What We're Looking For

    • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field

    • 10+ years of progressive finance and accounting experience, including people leadership

    • Strong accounting foundation, such as audit, controllership, or a CPA

    • Hands-on FP&A or full P&L visibility in an operating business

    • Experience with multi-entity consolidation and month-end close oversight

    • Advanced Excel and financial modeling skills

    • Comfort building structure and processes in a growing, evolving business

    • Humble, curious, and able to translate between big-company rigor and small-business realities

    • Confident, clear communicator with leadership teams and investors

Nice-to-Have

    • CPA

    • Experience in a private equity-backed or holding company environment

    • Background in professional services, software resale, or ERP/technology services

    • Acumatica or other mid-market ERP experience

    • Experience with post-acquisition integration

What we Offer

    • Competitive base salary plus an annual bonus tied to company performance

    • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage, plus a 401(k) match

    • Paid time off and company holidays

    • Fully remote work with the tools and support to do your job well

    • Real ownership of the books for a growing business unit, with direct access to finance leadership

    • Hands-on exposure to Acumatica, working alongside the consultants who implement it

    • The stability of a long-term, buy-and-hold owner, with room to grow your career as Third Wave and Pine expand
