Qualifikation

Am Ende sollte es für beide Seiten passen. Deshalb wäre es gut, wenn du dich in den nachfolgenden Punkten wiederfindest.

  • Kommunikative Art und Freude am Austausch mit Mandanten
  • Sorgfältige, effiziente und gewissenhafte Arbeitsweise
  • Offen für eine digitale Arbeitsweise
  • Leidenschaft für steuerliche Themen

Benefits

Du hast genug von 0815 Benefits, von denen du nicht wirklich profitierst? Dann solltest du einen Blick auf die nachfolgenden Benefits werfen.

  • Außerordentliche Vergütung zwischen 52.000€ und 85.000€ / Jahr
  • Flexible Gestaltung der Arbeitszeiten sowie die Option auf 100% Homeoffice
  • Nettolohnoptimierung mit monatlichen 50,00€ Sachbezugsgutscheinen
  • Umfangreiche Unterstützung bei Fort- und Weiterbildungsmaßnahmen und ein persönlicher Mentor
  • Modernste Ausstattung mit digitalen Prozessen
  • Starker Teamzusammenhalt und regelmäßige Teamevents

Schnell, unkompliziert und effizient deinen Traumjob finden – ein Versprechen an dich, dass wir aufgrund unseres selektiven, breit gefächerten und deutschlandweiten Kanzleinetzwerks halten werden. Deine Vorteile mit uns auf einen Blick:

  • Du führst keine unsinnigen Bewerbungsgespräche mehr, bei denen du während des Bewerbungsprozesses merkst, dass es (bspw. wegen des Gehalts) sowieso nicht passt - wir klären vor deinem Bewerbungsgespräch all deine mit uns besprochenen Kriterien mit der Kanzlei ab.
  • Wir führen deine Gehaltsverhandlungen und kennen die Gehaltsstrukturen der Branche dabei bestens
  • 100% Anonymität – solange du uns nicht das „Go“ gibst und einem Kennenlernen mit deinem neuen potentiellen Arbeitgeber zustimmst, erfährt niemand von deinem Namen oder deinen bisherigen Arbeitgebern – deine dir wichtigen Kriterien können wir auch zunächst anonym mit unseren Partnerkanzleien klären
  • Attraktive Kanzleien – die Kanzleien in unserem breit gefächerten Kanzleinetzwerk sind selektiv ausgewählt und heben sich klar von “normalen” Kanzleien ab (z.B. hinsichtlich der Vergütung, Benefits, Hierarchien, Digitalisierungsgrad, Ausstattung etc.)
  • Und das Beste: Unser gesamter Service ist unverbindlich und völlig kostenfrei für dich

At Swyfft, we're reshaping the way home insurance and commercial package products are priced and bound. We've created an insurance experience that's smart, instant, and designed to deliver unparalleled customer service.

Our focus on lightning-fast quotes and seamless claims servicing is powered by cutting-edge technology and an Agent and Customer-centric approach that sets us apart in the industry.

Joining Swyfft means becoming part of a dynamic team of forward-thinkers who thrive on moving fast and delivering exceptional products. We pride ourselves on fostering an environment where creativity and positive energy thrive.

As we continue to grow and expand, we're on the lookout for experienced professionals like you to join us in transforming the insurance landscape. If you're passionate about leveraging technology to provide the best customer service experience and are ready to be a part of our journey, we welcome you to explore opportunities at Swyfft!

About the Position:

We are looking for a strategic, tech-minded Project Manager to lead the planning and execution of key initiatives across the company. You'll work across multiple systems, vendors, and teams, and will be relied on to prioritize, organize, and wrangle competing processes, workflows, and technical requirements. All of which will need to be documented along the way (but you're a PM so you already know that).

Swyfft's business runs across three core lifecycle phases — Pre-Bind, Post-Bind, and Claims — each with its own teams, systems, and cadence. This role will work with stakeholders in one or more of these phases, and initiatives will often require coordinating dependencies across phase boundaries. You don't need deep expertise in all three on day one, but comfort learning how a policy moves from quote to bind to servicing to claim, and who owns what along the way, will help you hit the ground running.

Overview

raw.excerpt: About Hugel Aesthetics Hugel Aesthetics is a fast-growing leader in the medical aesthetics industry, bringing innovative injectable and skin-care solutions to the Aesthetics market across the United States.
raw.description:
About Hugel Aesthetics

Hugel Aesthetics is a fast-growing leader in the medical aesthetics industry, bringing innovative injectable and skin-care solutions to the Aesthetics market across the United States. We are building our U.S. organization from the ground up, creating a culture that is intentionally different from traditional, highly layered organizations.

Founded in 2001, Hugel is a South Korea–based global leader in medical aesthetics, specializing in the development and commercialization of botulinum toxin, hyaluronic acid fillers, skin boosters, threads, and biocosmetics. Over the past two decades, Hugel has built a strong global footprint, with commercial presence in approximately 70 countries and operations across nine international subsidiaries.

Leveraging strong global momentum, Hugel Aesthetics was formed as the Company’s dedicated North American business unit, established to lead commercialization in the United States, Canada and Australia. Backed by Hugel’s global scale and expertise, Hugel Aesthetics is a well-resourced, growth-oriented organization focused on expanding access to Letybo and establishing a strong, long-term presence in medical aesthetics.

Our culture is rooted in high ownership, collaboration, and the belief that every voice matters. We value people who bring ideas, take initiative, and want a true seat at the table. In this environment, individuals are empowered to make an impact, move with agility, and help build what comes next.

This is a rare opportunity to join at an early stage and help shape not only the business, but the way we work, lead, and grow together. As we scale our commercial footprint, we're building a sales organization defined by hunger, excellence, and relentless customer focus.

The Opportunity

The Area Sales Director owns commercial performance across half of the U.S., leading a team of regional sales managers responsible for revenue growth, market share, and customer relationships within the assigned area. This leader builds, coaches, and develops a high-performing sales organization capable of scaling with the business, while driving execution against aggressive revenue targets to drive revenue growth for Hugel Aesthetics across the U.S.

Reporting to the VP, US Sales, the Area Sales Director serves as a key partner in shaping national sales strategy, talent development, and go-to-market execution. This is a highly visible, high-impact role for a strategic leader who thrives in a build environment and wants to shape the future of a growing global aesthetics business.

This position has direct leadership responsibility for Regional Sales Managers and indirect responsibility for all Aesthetic Account Managers, working with their teams and providing operational oversight, strategic direction, and sales coaching in order to deliver sustainable growth in a dynamic aesthetics market.

This role requires a high-level of executive presence, relationship building, and leadership experience in the Aesthetics industry. The Area Sales Director plays a critical role in helping us expand in the aesthetics market, build stellar customer engagements, and collaborate cross-functionally to expand Hugel Aesthetic’s portfolio of products to our customers.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead, manage, and hold accountable a sales organization spanning approximately half of the U.S., driving revenue growth and quota attainment across the Area.
  • Build and scale the sales organization, attracting, recruiting, and onboarding strong leadership and field talent as the business grows.
  • Develop Regional Sales Managers into strong leaders through consistent coaching, feedback, field time, and individualized development. Build their ability to coach their teams, manage performance, make sound decisions, and develop future talent.
  • Own the Area’s sales strategy and execution, translating national goals into clear regional priorities and action plans. Use sales performance, market dynamics, competitive insights, and customer feedback to identify opportunities and drive action.
  • Lead monthly Area operating reviews, creating clear visibility into performance, opportunities, risks, and priorities while fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and customer focus.
  • Manage performance rigorously, including goal setting, forecasting accuracy, and addressing underperformance quickly and directly.
  • Partner with Inside Sales to support Area goals and ensure strong coordination across the sales organization.
  • Work closely across Sales, Strategic Accounts, Marketing, Medical Affairs, HR, Commercial Operations, and Finance to support launches, customer programs, and commercial priorities.
  • Model and uphold the highest standards of integrity, compliance, and professionalism in all internal and external business interactions.
  • Represent Hugel Aesthetics with customers and at key industry events, conferences, and trade shows throughout the Area and nationally.
  • Provide the VP of U.S. Sales with a clear view of Area performance, market dynamics, competitive activity, customer insights, and the talent pipeline, including opportunities, risks, and recommended actions.
  • Champion Hugel’s culture and values, leading by example and reinforcing the high standards, collaboration, accountability, and customer focus expected across the sales organization.

What We Are Looking For

  • A dynamic, experienced sales leader who can inspire and motivate teams, set high standards, and create a culture of accountability, collaboration, and performance.
  • 10+ years of sales experience with significant leadership responsibility, including leading across multiple markets or regions.
  • Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree preferred.
  • Proven experience leading and developing sales managers, with a track record of building strong management teams, coaching leaders, and developing people for greater responsibility.
  • Medical aesthetics leadership experience is strongly preferred, particularly in injectables and across the dermatology, plastic surgery, and medical spa channels.
  • Strong knowledge of the aesthetics market and talent landscape, with a demonstrated ability to attract, recruit, and retain high-performing sales management and field talent.
  • Strong commercial and business acumen, with the ability to understand sales performance, customer needs, market dynamics, and competitive activity and turn those insights into clear priorities and action.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to clearly tell the story of the business, articulate opportunities and challenges, and make thoughtful recommendations to both field teams and senior leadership.
  • A strong coach and people developer who can motivate different personalities, provide clear and constructive feedback, and help managers become stronger leaders.
  • Customer-focused and highly collaborative, with the ability to build trusted relationships with customers and work effectively across Sales, Strategic Accounts, Marketing, Medical Affairs, Commercial Operations, Finance, HR, and other partners.
  • A leader who leads by example, with integrity, accountability, sound judgment, and professionalism in how they represent Hugel with employees, customers, and the broader aesthetics community.
  • Comfortable leading in a growing organization, with the ability to move quickly, solve problems, adapt as the business evolves, and help shape and scale Hugel’s U.S. commercial organization.
  • Experience with Salesforce or a similar CRM platform.
  • Ability to travel 50%+, including travel throughout the assigned Area, to Hugel’s corporate headquarters, and to national and regional industry conferences and meetings.
  • Valid driver’s license and ability to operate a motor vehicle.

Compensation

The most likely base pay range for this position is $185,000 - $215,000 per year. Several factors, such as experience, tenure, skills, and particular business needs, will determine an individual’s exact level of compensation. Base salary is only one element of employee compensation at Hugel Aesthetics. The total compensation could include base salary, bonuses, and equity awards

Benefits

At Hugel Aesthetics, we invest in our colleagues by offering a comprehensive benefits package built to support your health, financial future, and peace of mind.

Employees enjoy robust medical, dental, and vision coverage, alongside a 401(k) program with a company match to help build long-term financial security. Our trackless PTO program and competitive corporate holiday schedule give you the flexibility to rest and recharge while out of the office.

We also offer optional benefits like wellness programs, legal services, and identity monitoring, so you can choose the coverage that fits your life.

Salary: $185,000 - $215,000

raw.description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

What does software planning look like when people and artificial intelligence agents work together? As a Staff Product Manager for Planning at GitLab, you'll help answer that question and lead the team toward a clear product direction. This isn't just about improving traditional agile planning. You'll rethink how intent becomes actionable work, how that work moves through software development, and where human involvement is needed.

You'll develop a point of view on planning's future and turn it into product decisions with engineering, design, and product leadership. That includes exploring how planning could connect work to business priorities and budgets, rather than assuming the answer is already decided. Alongside that strategic work, you'll share ownership of existing planning capabilities with another product manager.

We're opening this role at Staff level, with flexibility to consider Principal level based on your experience and scope of impact.

What you'll do

  • Define a clear direction for planning as software development shifts toward collaboration between people and artificial intelligence agents, and help the team move from open questions to concrete priorities.
  • Shape how users capture intent, break it into actionable work, and determine which work can proceed autonomously and which needs human involvement.
  • Evaluate whether and how planning should connect software delivery to company priorities, business objectives, and budgets.
  • Share ownership of planning capabilities, including work items, boards, specifications, and portfolio planning, with a fellow product manager. Help define how that scope is divided.
  • Work with engineering and design to translate product direction into a roadmap and improvements to planning workflows across GitLab.
  • Communicate your recommendations clearly to senior leaders, challenge assumptions constructively, and lead the team through changes in direction.

What you'll bring

  • Experience leading product strategy and execution for software development, developer tools, or planning products, with the depth to make decisions in a specialized product area.
  • A strong understanding of software development and development and operations (DevOps) workflows, including how planning decisions affect downstream delivery.
  • The ability to form and defend a product point of view in an uncertain, changing market, while staying open to different ideas.
  • Clear communication with technical teams and senior executives, including experience challenging leadership decisions constructively and building support for a direction.
  • The ability to connect a forward-looking strategy to practical product decisions and work collaboratively across product, engineering, and design.

About the team

The Planning team builds the capabilities at the start of GitLab's software development workflow, including work items, boards, specifications, and portfolio planning. Decisions here affect how work moves through the rest of the platform, so the team's scope extends beyond standalone project management tools.

You'll work alongside another product manager and partner with engineering and design across this product area. The division of product ownership is still being shaped, and you'll help define it. The hiring manager wants you to bring a different perspective, question established approaches, and challenge senior leaders constructively, with room to influence decisions beyond your immediate product scope.

GitLab's mission is to enable everyone to contribute to and co-create the software that powers our world. Our platform brings software development, security, and operations together.

Grade level and salary ranges are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, equity with other team members, alignment with market data, and geographic location. The base salary range does not include any bonuses, equity, or benefits. See more information on our benefits and equity. Sales roles are also eligible for incentive pay targeted at up to 100% of the offered base salary.

raw.title: Creative Design Team Lead (AI & Performance Marketing)
raw.excerpt: DescriptionCapsLock is a global IT marketing company that pioneers unique, scalable customer acquisition solutions for B2C clients.
raw.description:
Description

CapsLock is a global IT marketing company that pioneers unique, scalable customer acquisition solutions for B2C clients. We solve complex sales challenges across a wide range of industries, primarily for large North American partners. By integrating our expertise in Digital Marketing, IT, Design, AI-driven analytics, proprietary MarTech, and sales consulting, we deliver powerful, data-informed customer acquisition solutions.

At CapsLock, people, technology, and forward-thinking innovation lie at the heart of everything we do. Our diverse, global team, fluent in over 10 languages, thrives on open collaboration and the exchange of new ideas, pushing boundaries to ensure our clients' success.

Role overview

We're looking for a Marketing Design Team Lead who is equal parts creative leader, marketer, and AI geek, someone who knows how to achieve business goals through visuals that actually sell.

You will take a team of 3 AI-driven Creative Designers and scale it to 6. The team produces static ad creatives, photorealistic AI visuals for performance campaigns across paid media channels, and source assets for our video production pipeline.

Your job is to build the company's visual creative engine. Whatever the starting point- a brief, a hypothesis, a raw idea - it leaves the team as a creative that performs.

You'll work closely with Creative Producers, Marketers, Copywriters, Media Buyers, and the Video Editing team, and partner with our Generative AI Pipeline Engineer on tooling and workflows.

What you will work on

  • Lead, mentor, and scale a team of 3 to 6 AI-driven Creative Designers - grow people, not just output;
  • Own the production flow: task distribution, capacity planning, and strict QC - production-grade, not demo-grade;
  • Drive creative direction: concepts, hooks, and visual angles that stop the scroll and convert;
  • Generate ideas yourself and push the team beyond safe iterations - informed by visual trends and competitor creatives;
  • Own the creative testing loop: build a database of winners, analyze failures, turn performance data into next iterations;
  • Track new AI models and tools; be the company's go-to expert on what's creatively possible with AI, staying hands-on in the tools;
  • Run regular R&D and build prompt and style libraries that keep quality consistent as the team grows;
  • Stay hands-on: jump into the tools (Figma, Adobe Suite, AI platforms) when needed to unblock the team, take on the most complex creatives, or test new approaches;
  • Partner with the Generative AI Pipeline Engineer to turn the team's creative needs into pipelines, presets, and automation;
  • Work tightly with Creative Producers, Marketers, Media Buyers, and Video Editors: align on strategy, negotiate deadlines, solve bottlenecks.

Requirements

Your must-haves

You don't need to meet every single requirement. If you're excellent in most of these areas and can show shipped work, we'd love to hear from you.

  • 5+ years of Leadership Experience: You have successfully managed creative/design teams in digital marketing. (This is not a role for a senior designer looking for their first management gig);
  • Mature Leader & Problem Solver: You build clear processes, guide your team, gracefully resolve conflicts, remain highly proactive, and stay completely open to new ideas and approaches;
  • Strong Project Manager: You drive every project cleanly to the finish line. You guarantee top-tier quality, maintain absolute order, and hit strict deadlines without excuses;
  • Strong Visual Craft: composition, lighting, color, typography, anatomy. You can articulate exactly why a creative works or doesn't;
  • Design Toolstack: proficiency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite; comfortable connecting AI outputs with traditional design pipelines;
  • AI Geek: far beyond basic prompting. You track every new model release and can't wait to test how it could level up ad creatives. Hands-on with modern AI image platforms (Figma Weave, Higgsfield, Magnific, Runway, or similar), using them for creating photorealistic visuals. Able to choose the right tool for each task, as well as to catch and fix artifacts.
  • Performance Marketing DNA: solid understanding of static ad creatives (Google, Meta, and other paid channels). You know what stops the scroll, what makes a visual sell, and how creative decisions move CTR, CPA, and conversion rate;
  • Fluency in English - both spoken and written.

Nice to have

  • A strong portfolio showcasing performance marketing creatives and AI-generated photorealistic work - ideally with examples shipped under your leadership and the results they drove;
  • Experience with creatives for high-CPA verticals (home improvement, insurance, health, legal, finance, or similar);
  • Experience creating visuals for North American audiences - you know what looks native to a US consumer;
  • Understanding of how static visuals feed video production pipelines.

What we offer

  • Remote Work - we offer a truly and fully remote environment. You choose where you are the most productive and comfortable to have an impact.
  • Paid vacations - generous paid vacation policy to ensure you have time to recharge.
  • Unlimited Sick Days - we understand that being only human means getting sick or feeling under the weather from time to time, so we guarantee you time off as long as you need to recover and get back on your feet.
  • Ongoing Learning - people at CapsLock are deeply inquisitive and eager to learn new knowledge and skills, that's why we support and create learning opportunities like the Free Books program, workshops, conferences, and more.
  • Home Office - we will cover the equipment and furniture expenses to make sure you have the best work-from-home experience.
  • Physical Well-Being - we will cover costs of your medical insurance. Additionally we offer an allowance for a flexible fitness program.
  • Fun Stuff - there is never a shortage of fun stuff.

raw.description:
COMPANY PROFILE

CodeAI is an education innovation nonprofit dedicated to the vision that every student in every school has the opportunity to learn about artificial intelligence (AI) and computer science (CS) as part of their core K-12 education. We increase participation in AI+CS education by reaching students of all backgrounds where they are — at their skill level, in their schools, and in ways that inspire them to keep learning, with a focus on increasing participation by young women and students from other underrepresented groups. The leading provider of K-12 AI+CS education curriculum across the globe, CodeAI also organizes the annual Hour of AI campaign, building on the legacy of the Hour of Code, which has engaged more than 15% of all students in the world!

A unifying approach in a divided world

CodeAI's global role in the K-12 computer science movement is only possible because we use a unifying approach across diverse and often divided stakeholders. At a time of increasing polarization, the idea of increasing opportunity for students unites people from across the political spectrum. CodeAI's team members, students, teachers, and supporters have diverse and diverging view points, and they are all welcome in our mission. Read more.

JOB SUMMARY

As our Sr. Designer & Art Director, you’ll bring the CodeAI brand to life through design, visual direction, and creative ideas across every channel we use. Reporting to the Executive Producer of Creative and Delivery, you’ll lead the visual side of how our brand shows up everywhere and partner with our copywriter on integrated campaigns of every size.

This role leans toward design. You’ll concept alongside your copywriter, direct the look of the work, and design much of it yourself, from video and social to out of home, experiential, and everyday channel assets. We have an established brand and campaigns already in market, and finding fresh ways to express them is at the heart of this job.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

In this role, you will own the visual direction of the CodeAI brand and design much of the work that carries it.

Visual Direction & Design

  • Set the visual direction for campaigns and channel work, and design key pieces yourself, from key visuals to social, email, web, and paid assets.
  • Bring strong typography, layout, composition, and color to every deliverable, and carry the work through to final, production-ready files.
  • Design for motion and platform-native formats, including vertical video and social-first content.
  • Build accessible work that meets WCAG standards across digital channels.
  • Use AI tools in your design workflow and help the team keep pushing how we use them.

Concepting & Art Direction

  • Concept integrated campaigns with your copywriter partner from first brief to final delivery, and translate each idea into a visual system that works across channels.
  • Bring forward new ideas that engage our audiences and solve brand challenges, often before a brief asks for them.
  • Art direct photo and video shoots from shot list through post, while production partners handle logistics and vendors.
  • Direct contract designers and creatives when they’re brought on, with clear feedback that raises the quality of the work.

Brand Stewardship

  • Own the visual elements of the CodeAI brand guidelines and evolve them over time, with final approval resting with the Executive Producer.
  • Be the go-to resource for visual brand questions, helping teams across CodeAI and external partners apply the guidelines well.
  • Present your work to leadership and stakeholders with clear strategic reasoning, using audience insights and performance data to sharpen it.

EXPERIENCE & QUALIFICATIONS

We seek candidates who have:

  • 8 to 10 years in graphic design and art direction, including time at a senior level.
  • A portfolio showing both hands-on design craft and integrated campaign work, with your specific role noted on each project.
  • Expert typography, layout, and composition skills, with the ability to flex across visual styles.
  • Experience concepting with copywriters, with produced campaign work to show for it.
  • Experience art directing photo or video shoots through post.
  • Experience building or evolving brand guidelines and helping other teams apply them.
  • Experience directing the work of other creatives.
  • Experience using AI tools in a creative workflow.
  • Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite and Figma.

We prefer candidates who also have:

  • Agency or design studio experience.
  • Experience with education, nonprofit, or mission-driven brands.
  • Motion design or video editing skills.

In addition, candidates must:

  • Be a U.S. Citizen or Permanent Resident
  • Work within the continental United States
  • Pass a pre-employment background check
  • Be willing to travel a minimum of two times per year for team events

OUR CULTURAL PRINCIPLES

The way we work matters as much as the work itself. Before you apply, we invite you to take a look at our cultural principles. They reflect who we are, how we show up for each other, and what we look for in the people who join us.

OUR APPROACH TO AI IN HIRING

At CodeAI, we use AI thoughtfully and responsibly to support human-centered hiring. AI may help with administrative tasks, but every hiring decision is made by real people on our team. We welcome candidates to use AI appropriately in their job search while upholding our values of honesty and integrity throughout the process.

Read our full AI Use Policy in Hiring here.

WHAT IS THE INTERVIEW PROCESS LIKE?

Step 1: Informational Interview - learn more about the role and share your experience (30 minutes)
Step 2: Interviews with several members of the Code.org team (~3 hours)
Step 3: Final Interview (1 hour)

Step 4: Reference Checks

All interviews are currently being conducted virtually via Google Meet

TO APPLY

Our team will review all applications on an ongoing basis and if we believe your qualifications would make a great fit, we'll contact you to schedule an informational interview.

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS PACKAGE

The expected salary range for this position is $100,800 - $112,000. Most offers are on the lower end of the salary range and are at the company’s sole discretion based on the final candidate’s experience. This allows us to provide a fair and equitable approach to compensation when setting pay and maintaining internal pay equity.

We also offer a comprehensive benefits package for full-time employees that includes:

  • Technology subsidy consistent with our Bring Your Own Device environment
  • Flexible, engaging, and remote working environment
  • Paid time off: 5 weeks total, comprised of 3 weeks vacation annually, plus a 2-week winter break office closure (including Christmas and New Year's), and sick leave
  • Medical, dental and vision premiums paid at 100% for FT positions and their dependents
  • Option to participate in 403b retirement plan
  • The opportunity to help students learn better and change the face of computer science

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring accurate recording and classification of financial transactions. You’ll reconcile bank and credit card accounts, review client records for accuracy, and correct any discrepancies.Proficiency in QuickBooks Online is crucial to success in this role.

You will manage a portfolio of 10-20 clients, requiring excellent organizational skills to handle their deadlines and tasks. Additional responsibilities may include monitoring loans, assisting with budgeting, and payroll duties to support financial solvency.

  • Oregon (OR)
  • Pennsylvania (PA)
  • New Jersey (NJ)
  • New York (NY)
  • California (CA)
  • Washington (WA)

Essential Duties:

  • Conduct bank account and credit card reconciliations.
  • Perform comprehensive bookkeeping reviews.
  • Manage bill payments and track loans.
  • Collect and process client invoices.
  • File 1099 forms and calculate sales tax.
  • Handle payroll filing and reporting.
  • Maintain detailed financial transaction spreadsheets.
  • Submit daily reports to your supervisor.
  • Track time accurately for each client.
  • Utilize internal software for documenting client work.
  • Perform other related tasks as required.

  • High school diploma or equivalent.

  • 1-3 years of bookkeeping experience managing multiple clients.
  • (Bonus) Experience as an Accountant or Staff Accountant is a plus but not required.
  • In-house training as required.

Job Skill Requirements:

  • Strong communication and organizational abilities.
  • Capacity to manage stress associated with deadlines.
  • Proficiency in QuickBooks Online is a must.
  • Timeliness in job performance.
  • Abstinence from mood or mood-altering substances.
  • Flexibility to work varied hours as necessary.

  • Successful candidates will have an initial Zoom interview.

  • A final interview with Maya, the CEO, will follow for those who pass the assessment.

Working Conditions:This position may require occasional evening and weekend work, along with the ability to work with challenging clients.

Physical Requirements:As this is a remote position, you must own a working computer that meets industry standards, high-speed internet, dual monitors, and proof of antivirus software. A webcam and audio setup are required for effective communication during Zoom meetings.
You must be able to sit and work at a computer for 8 hours a day and sometimes longer, including data entry tasks.

raw.description:
Opportunity is not evenly distributed. Shopify puts independence within reach for anyone with a dream to start a business. We propel entrepreneurs and enterprises to scale the heights of their potential. Since 2006, we’ve grown to 10,000 employees and generated over $496 billion in sales for millions of merchants in 175 countries.
This is life-defining work that directly impacts people’s lives as much as it transforms your own. This is putting the power of the few in the hands of the many, is a future with more voices rather than fewer, and is creating more choices instead of an elite option.

About You

Moving at our pace brings a lot of change, complexity, and ambiguity—and a little bit of chaos. Shopifolk thrive on that and are comfortable being uncomfortable. That means Shopify is not the right place for everyone.
Before you apply, consider if you can:
  • Care deeply about what you do and about making commerce better for everyone
  • Excel by seeking professional and personal hypergrowth
  • Keep up with an unrelenting pace (the week, not the quarter)
  • Be resilient and resourceful in face of ambiguity and thrive on (rather than endure) change
  • Bring critical thought and opinion
  • Embrace differences and disagreement to get shit done and move forward
  • Work digital-first for your daily work

About the role

Data is a crucial part of Shopify’s mission to make commerce better for everyone. We organize and interpret petabytes of data to provide solutions for our merchants and stakeholders across the organization.
As a Data Engineer at Shopify, your primary responsibility will be to contribute to Shopify’s Data Warehouse. Your work will unlock powerful insights to guide the development and improvement of Shopify’s products.
As an embedded Data Engineer, you will work directly building foundations for products that transform merchants' lives. You'll collaborate with a multidisciplinary team of professionals that can include Product Data Scientists, Machine Learning Engineers, Business Analysts, and Product Management. The data you shape will be used to power product analysis, dashboards, and reports. You will also contribute by performing product analysis and creating dashboards and reports yourself from time to time. Get excited about flexing these analysis and reporting muscles, while also evangelizing the values and excellence in the Data Engineering craft to your multidisciplinary peers in a fast moving environment with competing priorities.
Our product is designed to empower entrepreneurs. Consequently, the work you do will not only create value for our users but also contribute to global entrepreneurship. To thrive here, you need to be dedicated to your craft and committed to constant development. You should be an independent thinker who can solve complex problems and handle a bit of chaos without breaking a sweat.
Example day to day responsibilities include:
  • Working with business partners to understand business and product objectives and identify the data needed to support them
  • Designing, building, implementing, and documenting data models
  • Writing data transformations using dbt or Spark
  • Shipping data pipelines including real-time streaming and batch processing
  • Optimizing data transformation pipelines to increase freshness or reduce computational time/cost
  • Working with engineers to understand and influence how data is produced
  • Collaborating with other data engineers on tooling for automated tasks around consuming, validating raw/modeled data, updating modeled data
  • Subscribing to and implementing architecture and standards following the Data Engineer craft at Shopify
  • Collaborating with sister disciplines (Engineering, Data Science) to establish best practices and evangelize the values and priorities of the Data Engineering craft
  • Partnering closely with product, engineering and other business leaders to influence product and program decisions with data
  • Building production-quality dashboards and scalable data products

Qualifications

  • Commercial experience in Data Engineering, and/or Analytics Engineering, ​​​​​​building scalable data warehouses
  • Dimensional Modeling (Star Schema, Kimball, Inmon)
  • Advanced SQL skills (ease with window functions, defining UDFs)
  • Exposure to Data Engineering tooling: ingesting, testing transformations, lineage, orchestration, publishing data, metric layers
  • Hands-on experience implementing real-time and batch data pipelines with tight SLOs and complex transformation requirements
  • Fantastic collaboration and communication skills, demonstrated by successful large-scale projects spanning multiple teams
  • Technical thought leader, comfortable navigating ambiguity and mentoring various level of team members
  • Aptitude for product analysis, dashboarding, and reporting

raw.description:
At BioAgilytix, we are passionate about premier science and the impact it has on our world. Our team of highly experienced scientists and professionals deliver tailored services for supporting new medicine breakthroughs with best-in-class bioanalytical services. We are tirelessly committed to our customers by being solution-oriented and deadline-driven. . . and we are growing. Our culture is fast-paced, fun and never boring. Because we work across numerous clients and drug modalities, your career can develop rapidly. You’ll gain experience with a variety of challenges all while you enable life-changing, life-saving therapeutics to the patients who need them.
The Project Setup Lead is responsible for the accurate and timely setup of customer projects, contracts, and related system records to support project execution, revenue forecasting, and billing readiness. This role serves as the primary owner of the project setup process, ensuring customer contracts, proposals, purchase orders, and supporting documentation are reviewed, interpreted, and translated into accurate project records within enterprise systems. The Project Setup Lead partners closely with Revenue, Accounts Receivable, Project Management, Business Development, Operations, and other cross-functional stakeholders to resolve exceptions, improve processes, maintain documentation, and drive operational excellence. This position is highly detail-oriented and requires strong organizational skills, contract review capabilities, process improvement experience, and the ability to manage competing priorities in a dynamic environment.
Essential Responsibilities
  • Serve as primary owner of project setup activities, ensuring projects are established accurately and timely within NetSuite and other applicable systems.
  • Review contracts, statements of work, proposals, purchase orders, and other commercial documents to establish project and billing requirements.
  • Review contractual terms to identify project setup and billing requirements and identify missing, incomplete, conflicting, or unsupported information requiring follow-up or escalation.
  • Configure project and sales order records according to established business rules and quality standards.
  • Partner with Revenue, Accounts Receivable, PMO, Business Development, Proposals, Operations, and systems teams to resolve setup-related issues.
  • Manage project setup queues and prioritize work based on business needs, readiness, urgency, and service-level expectations.
  • Maintain standard operating procedures, work instructions, training materials, and reference documentation.
  • Monitor key performance indicators related to setup quality, turnaround time, backlog management, and process effectiveness.
  • Identify recurring issues, perform root-cause analysis, and recommend process improvements to increase efficiency and accuracy.
  • Support system enhancements and process optimization initiatives related to project setup and contract administration.
  • Provide training and knowledge transfer to backup resources and stakeholders as needed.

Additional Responsibilities
  • Monitor project setup performance metrics and recommend operational improvements.
  • Participate in cross-functional projects impacting project setup, revenue operations, and system enhancements.
  • Assist with audits, compliance reviews, and documentation requests.
  • Support implementation of quality control measures and first-time-right processes.
  • Contribute to business continuity planning and cross-training initiatives.
  • Recommend automation opportunities and workflow improvements that increase efficiency and reduce risk.

Minimum Preferred Qualifications

Education/Experience:
  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, Project Management, Contract Management, or related field; equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered.
  • Minimum 3 years of experience in contract administration, project setup, project coordination, revenue operations, order management, financial operations, project management office (PMO), or related business operations functions.
  • Experience reviewing contracts, purchase orders, proposals, statements of work, or other commercial documents.
  • Experience working in a regulated, professional services, life sciences, biotechnology, or similar operational environment preferred.

Skills:

  • Strong contract review and interpretation skills.
  • Exceptional organizational and project coordination abilities.
  • Advanced attention to detail and data accuracy.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Ability to identify risks, discrepancies, and compliance concerns.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in an exception-driven environment.
  • Process documentation, SOP creation, and workflow design experience.
  • Process improvement and continuous improvement mindset.
  • Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, and enterprise business systems.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

Preferred Credentials

  • Experience supporting revenue operations, accounts receivable, project accounting, or contract lifecycle management.

  • Infrequent supervision and instructions for day to day work assignments.
  • Frequently exercises discretionary authority with established procedures.

Working Environment

  • Frequent interaction with cross-functional teams across multiple locations.
  • May require periodic travel to company offices for training, meetings, or team collaboration.

Physical Demands

  • Repetitive hand movement of both hands with the ability to make fast, simple, repeated movements of the fingers, hands, and wrists to operate office equipment.

Position Type and Expected Hours of Work

  • This is a full-time remote position.

  • Occasional weekend, holiday, and evening work needed.
BENEFITS AND OTHER PERKS

raw.description:
Your work will change lives. Including your own.

The Impact You’ll Make:

Human biology stems from four billion years of evolution, which creates a proliferation of complexity and heterogeneity. The combinatorial explosion of biological hypotheses easily surpasses the number of atoms in the universe. Meanwhile, medical discovery advances at the snail pace of clinical trials, each taking years and costing over $100 million. As we enter the era of precision health and try to tailor treatments for each individual, continuing on today's discovery processes is clearly unsustainable.

With the confluence of digital transformation and intelligence revolution, we have an unprecedented opportunity to develop a unifying biomedical world model by bridging virtual patient and virtual cell, and turning real-world data into a discovery engine to close the loop of clinical care and drug discovery. As a Principal AI Researcher, you will join our cross-functional team of top-notch scientists, engineers, and drug hunters in the quest of scalable biomedical discovery. You will work at the forefront of AI-powered drug discovery, advancing frontier research and end-to-end applications across discovery, design, and translation.

The Team You’ll Join:

Recursion is a pioneer in AI-native drug discovery. In the past decade, we have built an unparalleled array of infrastructures across drug discovery and clinical development, operating one of the largest AI compute clusters in biopharma, and spearheading industrial-scale phenomics for perturbation data generation at cellular resolution, long before "virtual cell" entered the mainstream. United under the mission of “decoding biology to radically improve lives”, we offer a unique vibrant environment that features frontier research, industrialized wet and dry labs, and real-world delivery, with close feedback loops and rapid iterations, much like a lean startup. You will join fellow experts across research and engineering, biology and medicine, business and operation, who are similarly committed to accelerating biomedical discovery and democratizing precision health for everyone in the globe.

The Experience You Will Need:

  • PhD in ML, NLP, computer vision, or the equivalent practical experience
  • Passionate about real-world applications and impact
  • Strong verbal and writing communication skills
  • 10+ years of frontier AI research experience
  • Experience with large datasets and cross-functional AI projects
  • Experience in biomedicine and drug discovery a plus; willingness to learn a must!

The Values We Hope You Share:

  • We act boldly with integrity. We are unconstrained in our thinking, take calculated risks, and push boundaries, but never at the expense of ethics, science, or trust.
  • We care deeply and engage directly. Caring means holding a deep sense of responsibility and respect - showing up, speaking honestly, and taking action.
  • We learn actively and adapt rapidly. Progress comes from doing. We experiment, test, and refine, embracing iteration over perfection.
  • We move with urgency because patients are waiting. Speed isn’t about rushing but about moving the needle every day.
  • We take ownership and accountability. Through ownership and accountability, we enable trust and autonomy—leaders take accountability for decisive action, and teams own outcomes together.
  • We are One Recursion. True cross-functional collaboration is about trust, clarity, humility, and impact. Through sharing, we can be greater than the sum of our individual capabilities.

Our values underpin the employee experience at Recursion. They are the character and personality of the company demonstrated through how we communicate, support one another, spend our time, make decisions, and celebrate collectively.

More About Recursion

Recursion (NASDAQ: RXRX) is a clinical-stage TechBio company decoding biology to radically improve lives. Recursion is advancing a portfolio of differentiated investigational medicines across its wholly owned and partnered pipeline in oncology, rare disease, neuroscience, immunology, and other therapeutic areas with significant unmet need. Enabling its mission is the Recursion OS, an AI-native, end-to-end drug discovery and development platform integrating biology, chemistry, and clinical development into a unified intelligence system. Powered by proprietary multimodal data, purpose-built AI models, and bilingual teams fluent in both science and AI, the Recursion OS is designed to translate complex science into medicines that matter — faster, better, and at scale — for patients who are waiting.

Recursion’s platform infrastructure is anchored in Salt Lake City, Utah and Milton Park, Oxfordshire, where its automated biology and chemistry laboratories generate proprietary data at industrial scale. Recursion also maintains offices in New York, Montréal, and London, three global hubs for talent and leadership at the intersection of AI and scientific innovation. Learn more at www.recursion.com, or connect on X and LinkedIn.

Recursion is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under applicable federal, state, local, or provincial human rights legislation.

Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

Recursion leverages AI in our hiring process. We use Greenhouse's Talent Matching AI technology feature to help review applications against the skills and experience we've identified as important for this role. It analyzes your resume and application responses to assess how closely your qualifications match our criteria - but all decisions are made by our human recruiters and hiring managers, including whether to move to the next phase of review. Talent Matching does not automatically advance or reject any candidate. By submitting your application, you acknowledge that you have been informed about and consent to this use of the Talent Matching tool in our review process. Please refer to our Recursion Privacy Policy at for more information about our processing of personal data and your rights.
Recruitment & Staffing Agencies: Recursion Pharmaceuticals and its affiliate companies do not accept resumes from any source other than candidates. The submission of resumes by recruitment or staffing agencies to Recursion or its employees is strictly prohibited unless contacted directly by Recursion’s internal Talent Acquisition team. Any resume submitted by an agency in the absence of a signed agreement will automatically become the property of Recursion, and Recursion will not owe any referral or other fees. raw.description:
With 75 years of experience, our focus is on helping the most vulnerable children overcome poverty and experience fullness of life. We help children of all backgrounds, even in the most dangerous places, inspired by our Christian faith.

Come join our 31,000+ staff working in nearly 100 countries and share the joy of transforming vulnerable children’s life stories!

Key Responsibilities:


Please submit your CV and Cover Letter in English.

This is a remote/homeworking opportunity open to candidates internationally. To facilitate collaboration across our international team, we have a preference for candidates located within approximately ±4 to 5 hours of the United Kingdom's time zone (GMT/BST). We nevertheless welcome applications from qualified candidates in other eligible locations. Final appointment will be subject to the selected candidate residing in a country where World Vision International (WVI) is registered and able to employ staff.


JOB PURPOSE

The Senior Advisor, Children, Digital and AI strengthens World Vision International's (WVI) external influence and positioning on children's digital rights, Artificial Intelligence (AI) governance and digital participation. The role develops evidence-informed policy positions, thought leadership and coalition engagement, working across Child-led and Digital Advocacy (CLAD) and through a matrix relationship with Global Partnerships and Influence (GP&I) to connect children's voices and rights in the digital environment and systems-influencing opportunities under the global strategy “Our Promise” (OP3), shift 3.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES

External Thought Leadership and Policy Influencing — Children, Digital and AI:

  • Develop and position World Vision's agenda on children in digital environments and AI, going beyond online safety to address digital rights, data governance, AI systems affecting children, and children's participation in digital futures.
  • Track and analyse global policy, regulatory and multilateral developments relevant to children and AI/digital environments, providing timely intelligence and positioning advice to CLAD, GP&I and Advocacy & External Engagement (A&EE) leadership.
  • Develop high-quality thought leadership content — papers, briefs, op-eds, speaking notes and external statements — that positions WVI as a credible and distinctive voice in digital rights and AI policy for children.
  • Represent WVI in relevant external policy forums, multi-stakeholder consultations, regulatory processes and events, coordinating closely with GP&I to ensure coherence with wider WVI policy positions.
  • Work with the matrix line into GP&I to align WVI's positioning on children and digital/AI with broader systems-influencing and multilateral engagement priorities.

Coalition, Partnership and Multi-stakeholder Engagement

  • Lead or coordinate WVI engagement in a small number of priority external coalitions or multi-stakeholder networks focused on children's digital rights, AI governance, online safety or children in digital environments.
  • Develop and maintain an external stakeholder map of priority actors, coalitions, regulatory bodies and thought leaders in the children, digital and AI space, using it to identify entry points and influence opportunities.
  • Negotiate and operationalise engagement plans with key external partners, brokering opportunities to amplify children's voices and WVI's positions in relevant global debates.
  • In coordination with the matrix relationship into GP&I, ensure WVI's coalition engagement on children and digital/AI is aligned with wider systems-influencing strategies and avoids duplication.
  • Work with the Senior Advisor, Child-led and Digital Advocacy to identify joint coalition opportunities and ensure internal complementarity.

Policy, Evidence and Positioning Development

  • Commission, synthesise and produce evidence and analysis on the impact of digital environments and AI on children's rights, wellbeing and participation, translating emerging research into actionable policy asks and advocacy content.
  • Develop and maintain WVI's policy positions on priority children and digital/AI issues, including processes for updating positions in response to fast-moving regulatory and policy developments.
  • Ensure WVI's evidence and positioning draw on children's lived experience and field-level insight, working with the Senior Advisor, Child-led and Digital Advocacy to integrate child voice into external content.
  • Coordinate with Safeguarding, CPP and digital/technology colleagues to ensure policy positions are grounded in operational reality and do not duplicate technical safeguarding ownership.
  • Work with GP&I on quality assurance of content for multilateral, regulatory and digital rights audiences.

Internal Advisory Support and Organisational Alignment

  • Provide specialist advisory support to CLAD, GP&I, Partnerships and Coalitions and Campaigns (PACC), CPP, Local to Global (L2G) and other A&EE teams on children and digital/AI issues, enabling colleagues to engage confidently in relevant external spaces.
  • Support the Senior Director, CLAD with strategic advice on how digital and AI developments affect WVI's child participation and advocacy agenda.
  • Contribute children and digital/AI expertise to Shift 3 design, delivery and reporting, particularly where emerging technology intersects with Outcome 3.3 or wider advocacy priorities.
  • In coordination with the Senior Advisor, Child-led and Digital Advocacy, contribute to internal capability building on digital and AI literacy for advocacy staff and field offices.

REQUIRED KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE FOR THE ROLE

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in international development, law, public policy, digital rights, communications, human rights or a related field.
  • At least ten (10) years of relevant experience in digital rights, AI policy, online safety, children's rights advocacy or related fields, in an international NGO, policy, regulatory or civil society context.
  • Demonstrated track record of developing and placing thought leadership content — policy briefs, op-eds, speaking engagements, consultations or publications — in relevant external spaces.
  • Experience engaging with multi-stakeholder coalitions, regulatory processes, UN or multilateral bodies, or digital governance forums.
  • Strong policy analysis and writing skills, with the ability to translate complex technical and regulatory issues into clear, compelling advocacy content.
  • Experience working across teams and with senior leaders on external positioning and coalition strategy.

PREFERRED KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE FOR THE ROLE

  • Deep knowledge of AI governance debates, digital rights frameworks, data protection law and online safety regulation as they affect children.
  • Familiarity with relevant international processes and bodies —e.g., UNCRC, WEF, ITU, OECD AI Policy Observatory, Global Digital Compact and equivalent mechanisms.
  • Experience working in or with child rights or child participation organisations.
  • Understanding of how digital platforms, algorithmic systems and AI affect children's rights and wellbeing in practice.
  • Experience with collective impact or systems-change influencing approaches.
  • Knowledge of World Vision's programming and advocacy frameworks, particularly Shift 3.

LANGUAGE REQUIREMENTS:

  • Fluency/outstanding professional and technical spoken and written English, with demonstrated ability to write for policy and public audiences. Fluency in another language (French, Spanish, Arabic, Portuguese) is an added advantage.

TRAVEL AND/OR WORK ENVIRONMENT REQUIREMENT:

  • This is a remote/homeworking position within a globally distributed team spanning Eastern Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and the Americas.
  • The role may occasionally require flexibility in working hours to accommodate meetings and collaboration across multiple global time zones.
  • The role requires the ability to work effectively across diverse cultures, geographies, faith traditions, and time zones, demonstrating strong emotional intelligence, cultural sensitivity, and adaptability in a global environment.
  • The successful candidate will possess excellent relationship-building and influencing skills, with the ability to engage respectfully and effectively with colleagues, partners, and stakeholders from diverse cultural and contextual backgrounds.
  • The position requires the ability and willingness to travel nationally and/or internationally up to 25% of the time.
  • Travel will primarily support external representation, coalition engagement and policy forums.
  • Capability to participate in extended virtual meetings across multiple time zones.

Applicant Types Accepted:

Local Applicants Only

World Vision is a Christian humanitarian organisation with a mission centred on following Jesus Christ in service to the world´s most vulnerable children. Therefore, in all locations to the fullest extent legally permissible, the successful applicant will affirm our core documents, observe conduct compatible with Christian principles, serve at a high level of professional ethics and strive to act in accordance with cultural sensitivities. Furthermore, regular attendance with team and office devotions, chapel and prayer gatherings are expected in line with policies in the World Vision host location and its departments.

raw.description:
Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Senior IT Project Manager to lead a complex, enterprise-wide SAP S/4HANA enhancement initiative. This project involves a core enterprise business application with numerous interconnected systems, business processes, technical dependencies, and cross-functional stakeholders.

The ideal candidate will have a strong background in enterprise IT project management, SAP/ERP implementations and enhancements, systems integration, vendor coordination, and project governance. This individual must be highly organized, proactive, and capable of managing multiple concurrent workstreams while maintaining alignment across technical teams, business stakeholders, external vendors, and executive leadership.

The Project Manager will oversee the full project lifecycle, ensuring deliverables, schedules, resource plans, risks, and budget estimates are effectively managed. The successful candidate will establish accountability, facilitate decision-making, and drive execution in alignment with organizational priorities and established project management standards.

Current SAP Environment

The enterprise SAP landscape includes a cloud-based, multi-tiered environment with multiple interconnected platforms and solutions, including:

  • SAP S/4HANA
  • SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC)
  • SAP Business Data Cloud (BDC)
  • SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP)
  • SAP Datasphere
  • SAP Service and Asset Manager (SSAM)

The environment also includes integrations with a broad range of internal and external enterprise applications, including:

  • Vendor management and portal solutions
  • SAP SuccessFactors, including Recruiting, Onboarding, Employee Central, and Compensation
  • Enterprise document management systems
  • Asset management and infrastructure management applications
  • IT service management and asset tracking platforms
  • Business intelligence, analytics, and dashboarding tools
  • Budgeting and financial planning systems
  • Microsoft Dynamics 365
  • Engineering project management platforms
  • Financial institutions and benefits providers
  • External government and regulatory entities

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and coordinate internal and external project teams across multiple IT initiatives and workstreams of varying complexity.
  • Manage projects throughout the entire lifecycle, including initiation, planning, execution, monitoring, controlling, and closure.
  • Develop, maintain, and manage detailed integrated project plans and schedules, including task-level activities, deliverables, milestones, dependencies, and critical paths.
  • Establish and maintain project budgets, cost estimates, financial forecasts, and ongoing cost tracking.
  • Coordinate resource planning and allocation to ensure appropriate staffing and resource availability throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Forecast resource capacity requirements and proactively identify potential constraints, conflicts, and staffing gaps.
  • Establish and maintain project governance frameworks, including defined roles and responsibilities, decision-making processes, escalation paths, and accountability measures.
  • Collaborate with business owners, subject matter experts, technical teams, and other stakeholders to define, validate, and manage project scope and requirements.
  • Identify, assess, and mitigate project risks, issues, dependencies, and change impacts.
  • Coordinate cross-functional activities and manage dependencies across related projects, systems, and implementation partners.
  • Manage vendor relationships and coordinate deliverables, schedules, and dependencies with system integrators and other external partners.
  • Develop and maintain project documentation, status reports, decision logs, risk and issue registers, and required approvals and signoffs.
  • Communicate project status, progress, risks, budget considerations, and key decisions to stakeholders and executive leadership.
  • Facilitate project meetings, governance reviews, and stakeholder discussions to drive alignment and timely resolution of issues.
  • Conduct lessons-learned sessions and identify opportunities to improve project delivery processes and outcomes.
  • Ensure adherence to established project management methodologies, governance standards, documentation requirements, and organizational procedures.

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum of 10 years of experience managing IT projects of varying sizes and complexity.
  • Demonstrated experience managing enterprise-level SAP/ERP implementations, enhancements, or transformation initiatives.
  • Experience managing complex systems integrations, project scope, schedules, communications, vendors, resources, and project risks.
  • Experience overseeing high-profile technology vendors and implementation partners across on-premises and cloud environments.
  • Proven experience managing multi-year, enterprise-wide technology initiatives with multiple workstreams and interdependent deliverables.
  • Expert-level proficiency in developing and maintaining integrated project plans using Microsoft Project and/or Microsoft Project Online.
  • Strong understanding of project governance, budget management, resource forecasting, and project controls.
  • Exceptional leadership, stakeholder management, conflict resolution, and negotiation skills.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills, including the ability to communicate complex technical information to business and executive audiences.
  • Ability to manage competing priorities, anticipate project challenges, and drive accountability across cross-functional teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Project Management Professional (PMP) certification.
  • Experience working with complex, cloud-based SAP environments and interconnected enterprise applications.
  • Experience coordinating system integrators, third-party vendors, and large cross-functional implementation teams.

raw.description:
The Client Success & Strategy team at Force Therapeutics is the engine that powers the implementation, support, success, renewal and growth of Force's growing portfolio of Hospitals, Health Systems and Orthopedic Specialty Practices throughout the US. The Client Success team works with each client in a highly customized fashion to ensure they reach their unique goals while living our mission to extend Force's reach and impact via hospitals and health system partnerships across the country. We are looking for an experienced Implementation Lead who can confidently own multiple client implementations at once and help raise the bar for the implementation team as a whole.

As the Implementation Project Lead, you will be responsible for leading organizations through implementation on the Force platform. You'll own a portfolio of concurrent implementations of varying complexity, from the initial implementation kick off through first patient live and a seamless hand off to the Client Success Manager. You'll also serve as a mentor to our Implementation Associate, sharing best practices and helping build a consistent, high-quality implementation experience for every client.


What you’ll do:

Client Implementation Ownership: You will lead a portfolio of simultaneous implementation projects ranging from standard to complex. The process starts with support during the final stages of the sales process to ensure we're gathering the appropriate client information to inform implementation timelines through first patient live on the Force platform. You'll partner cross-functionally with internal clinical, product, and technical teams as needed, including on projects with integration components.

Project Management & Prioritization: Build and maintain project plans for each implementation, manage timelines and dependencies, proactively flag risks, and keep every project on schedule based on agreed upon timeframes with client stakeholders. Leverage tools such as Monday, Confluence, and Claude to organize, prioritize, and automate workflows effectively across your portfolio so that no project loses momentum, and escalate risks early when they arise.

Client Engagement & Accountability: Serve as the primary point of contact for your clients throughout implementation. Lead client meetings with confidence, secure commitments from client stakeholders, and drive them to complete their deliverables on time. Keep clients well informed and moving forward, even in busy hospital and health system environments with competing priorities. Comfort working autonomously and holding a high level of accountability for project deliverables.

Training and Presentation: Act as the subject matter expert in implementation best practices for the Force platform. Lead engaging training sessions that are tailored for end users, including surgeons, clinicians, and administrative staff, and deliver recommendations and updates to client leadership.

Operational Consistency: Proactively identify and contribute to initiatives that drive repeatability, consistency, and scalability across the implementation function, such as playbooks, templates, and process improvements. Create and leverage automations whenever possible to guarantee consistency and accountability throughout the implementation process.

What you bring:

About Us:

BW Converting is a strategic alliance of resources and services that bring together several Barry-Wehmiller companies — Paper Converting Machine Company (PCMC), Winkler + Dünnebier (W+D), STAX Technologies, Hudson-Sharp, Baldwin Technologies and Northern Engraving and Machine. These industry leaders offer trusted brands and innovative technologies in the design, manufacture, and service of high-performance converting and packaging machinery for the tissue, nonwovens, hygiene, bag-converting, mailing, and printing industries.Barry-Wehmiller is a diversified global supplier of engineering consulting and manufacturing technology for the packaging, corrugating, sheeting and paper-converting industries. By blending people-centric leadership with disciplined operational strategies and purpose-driven growth, Barry-Wehmiller has become a $3 billion organization with nearly 12,000 team members united by a common belief: to use the power of business to build a better world.

Job Description:

The Customer Support Technicianwill utilize technical knowledge and controls expertise to independently support one product line at a high level and provide basic support for 1-2 additional product lines by resolving customer issues, testing new technology, and assisting in the development of proactive services. This dual role position serves as both the primary customer service representative and technical service representative for all incoming second shift requests, working independently with minimal supervision.


Schedule: 3:30PM – 12:30AM Sunday through Thursday.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for all incoming customer requests during second shift, triaging calls appropriately-routing parts inquiries to the parts department, escalating issues to the next shift when necessary, or providing direct technical support as the situation requires.
  • Communicate with customers from a technical perspective to understand and resolve equipment issues.
  • Respond with urgency to resolve unplanned customer issues, including providing breakdown support for component replacements (loading HMIs, drives, PLCs) as necessary.
  • Provide support for “on the go” programming changes with minimal supervision
  • VPN into customer machines remotely to troubleshoot PLCs, drives and devices during second shift hours
  • Document customer issues and resolutions in the asset management system to develop equipment history files for future troubleshooting and support.
  • Utilize ERP system to find parts and arrange shipment to customer outside normal business hours
  • Utilize technical skills and expertise in controls and processes to support the team and customers.
  • Review customer data routinely and react to alarms, investigate customer downtime, develop insights and provide actions for customers for improved productivity and efficiency.
  • Identify continuous improvement opportunities to increase overall effectiveness and support proactive and measurable process improvement results to ensure consistency and standardization of best practices and tools.
  • Proactively communicate with product line engineering team by recommending machine changes and bringing forward the voice of the customer.
  • Engage in the evaluation, implementation, and testing of new technology
  • Create and sustain an environment of safety.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE:

  • A two-year associate degree in electro-mechanical, electrical design, or a related field and five years of machine troubleshooting experience, or a high school diploma and seven years of machine troubleshooting experience.
  • Expert in controls and machine processes for print equipment.
  • Knowledge or skills on flexographic printing presses is a plus but not a requirement

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, ABILITIES:

  • Proficient in Rockwell and Indramat software
  • Knowledgeable Rockwell and Indramat hardware
  • Strong technical and troubleshooting skill set with the ability to diagnose and resolve issues independently
  • Excellent customer service skills with the ability to manage multiple types of inquiries and prioritize effectively
  • Self-motivated with strong decision-making capabilities
  • Proficient in mechanical, pneumatic and control systems.
  • Ability to travel several weeks per year to customer sites and the main factory for training

COMPETENCIES:

  • Customer Focus – Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.
  • Instills Trust – Gaining the confidence and trust of others through honesty, integrity, and authenticity.
  • Drives Results - Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.
  • Communicates Effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.
  • Optimizes Work Processes - Knowing the most effective and efficient processes to get things done, with a focus on continuous improvement.
  • Collaborates – Building partnerships and collaborating with others to meet shared objectives.
  • Ensures Accountability - Holding self and others accountable to meet commitments.

LEADERSHIP RESPONSIBILITY:

This position does not directly lead other team members.

WORK ENVIRONMENT/PHYSICAL DEMANDS:

  • Bend, squat, climb, grasp, reach, lift or otherwise move about frequently and for extended periods of time
  • Lift, move or otherwise transfer up to 50 lbs. frequently, or more occasionally
  • Walk, stand or otherwise move about continuously
  • Exposure to typical machine shop physical hazards which may require respiratory protection
  • Typically sits, grasps items and performs keyboarding for occasional operation of a computer
  • Occasionally travel by car or air
  • Position is fully remote with occasional travel requirements
  • Second shift schedule with ability to train on first shift as required

Compensation

The approximate pay range for this position is $36 - $45 per hour. Please note that the pay range is a good faith estimate at the time of posting and may vary based on factors such as experience, skills, and geographic location.
