Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Senior IT Project Manager to lead a complex, enterprise-wide SAP S/4HANA enhancement initiative. This project involves a core enterprise business application with numerous interconnected systems, business processes, technical dependencies, and cross-functional stakeholders.

The ideal candidate will have a strong background in enterprise IT project management, SAP/ERP implementations and enhancements, systems integration, vendor coordination, and project governance. This individual must be highly organized, proactive, and capable of managing multiple concurrent workstreams while maintaining alignment across technical teams, business stakeholders, external vendors, and executive leadership.

The Project Manager will oversee the full project lifecycle, ensuring deliverables, schedules, resource plans, risks, and budget estimates are effectively managed. The successful candidate will establish accountability, facilitate decision-making, and drive execution in alignment with organizational priorities and established project management standards.

Current SAP Environment

The enterprise SAP landscape includes a cloud-based, multi-tiered environment with multiple interconnected platforms and solutions, including:

  • SAP S/4HANA
  • SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC)
  • SAP Business Data Cloud (BDC)
  • SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP)
  • SAP Datasphere
  • SAP Service and Asset Manager (SSAM)

The environment also includes integrations with a broad range of internal and external enterprise applications, including:

  • Vendor management and portal solutions
  • SAP SuccessFactors, including Recruiting, Onboarding, Employee Central, and Compensation
  • Enterprise document management systems
  • Asset management and infrastructure management applications
  • IT service management and asset tracking platforms
  • Business intelligence, analytics, and dashboarding tools
  • Budgeting and financial planning systems
  • Microsoft Dynamics 365
  • Engineering project management platforms
  • Financial institutions and benefits providers
  • External government and regulatory entities

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and coordinate internal and external project teams across multiple IT initiatives and workstreams of varying complexity.
  • Manage projects throughout the entire lifecycle, including initiation, planning, execution, monitoring, controlling, and closure.
  • Develop, maintain, and manage detailed integrated project plans and schedules, including task-level activities, deliverables, milestones, dependencies, and critical paths.
  • Establish and maintain project budgets, cost estimates, financial forecasts, and ongoing cost tracking.
  • Coordinate resource planning and allocation to ensure appropriate staffing and resource availability throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Forecast resource capacity requirements and proactively identify potential constraints, conflicts, and staffing gaps.
  • Establish and maintain project governance frameworks, including defined roles and responsibilities, decision-making processes, escalation paths, and accountability measures.
  • Collaborate with business owners, subject matter experts, technical teams, and other stakeholders to define, validate, and manage project scope and requirements.
  • Identify, assess, and mitigate project risks, issues, dependencies, and change impacts.
  • Coordinate cross-functional activities and manage dependencies across related projects, systems, and implementation partners.
  • Manage vendor relationships and coordinate deliverables, schedules, and dependencies with system integrators and other external partners.
  • Develop and maintain project documentation, status reports, decision logs, risk and issue registers, and required approvals and signoffs.
  • Communicate project status, progress, risks, budget considerations, and key decisions to stakeholders and executive leadership.
  • Facilitate project meetings, governance reviews, and stakeholder discussions to drive alignment and timely resolution of issues.
  • Conduct lessons-learned sessions and identify opportunities to improve project delivery processes and outcomes.
  • Ensure adherence to established project management methodologies, governance standards, documentation requirements, and organizational procedures.

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum of 10 years of experience managing IT projects of varying sizes and complexity.
  • Demonstrated experience managing enterprise-level SAP/ERP implementations, enhancements, or transformation initiatives.
  • Experience managing complex systems integrations, project scope, schedules, communications, vendors, resources, and project risks.
  • Experience overseeing high-profile technology vendors and implementation partners across on-premises and cloud environments.
  • Proven experience managing multi-year, enterprise-wide technology initiatives with multiple workstreams and interdependent deliverables.
  • Expert-level proficiency in developing and maintaining integrated project plans using Microsoft Project and/or Microsoft Project Online.
  • Strong understanding of project governance, budget management, resource forecasting, and project controls.
  • Exceptional leadership, stakeholder management, conflict resolution, and negotiation skills.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills, including the ability to communicate complex technical information to business and executive audiences.
  • Ability to manage competing priorities, anticipate project challenges, and drive accountability across cross-functional teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Project Management Professional (PMP) certification.
  • Experience working with complex, cloud-based SAP environments and interconnected enterprise applications.
  • Experience coordinating system integrators, third-party vendors, and large cross-functional implementation teams.

raw.description:
The Client Success & Strategy team at Force Therapeutics is the engine that powers the implementation, support, success, renewal and growth of Force's growing portfolio of Hospitals, Health Systems and Orthopedic Specialty Practices throughout the US. The Client Success team works with each client in a highly customized fashion to ensure they reach their unique goals while living our mission to extend Force's reach and impact via hospitals and health system partnerships across the country. We are looking for an experienced Implementation Lead who can confidently own multiple client implementations at once and help raise the bar for the implementation team as a whole.

As the Implementation Project Lead, you will be responsible for leading organizations through implementation on the Force platform. You'll own a portfolio of concurrent implementations of varying complexity, from the initial implementation kick off through first patient live and a seamless hand off to the Client Success Manager. You'll also serve as a mentor to our Implementation Associate, sharing best practices and helping build a consistent, high-quality implementation experience for every client.


What you’ll do:

Client Implementation Ownership: You will lead a portfolio of simultaneous implementation projects ranging from standard to complex. The process starts with support during the final stages of the sales process to ensure we're gathering the appropriate client information to inform implementation timelines through first patient live on the Force platform. You'll partner cross-functionally with internal clinical, product, and technical teams as needed, including on projects with integration components.

Project Management & Prioritization: Build and maintain project plans for each implementation, manage timelines and dependencies, proactively flag risks, and keep every project on schedule based on agreed upon timeframes with client stakeholders. Leverage tools such as Monday, Confluence, and Claude to organize, prioritize, and automate workflows effectively across your portfolio so that no project loses momentum, and escalate risks early when they arise.

Client Engagement & Accountability: Serve as the primary point of contact for your clients throughout implementation. Lead client meetings with confidence, secure commitments from client stakeholders, and drive them to complete their deliverables on time. Keep clients well informed and moving forward, even in busy hospital and health system environments with competing priorities. Comfort working autonomously and holding a high level of accountability for project deliverables.

Training and Presentation: Act as the subject matter expert in implementation best practices for the Force platform. Lead engaging training sessions that are tailored for end users, including surgeons, clinicians, and administrative staff, and deliver recommendations and updates to client leadership.

Operational Consistency: Proactively identify and contribute to initiatives that drive repeatability, consistency, and scalability across the implementation function, such as playbooks, templates, and process improvements. Create and leverage automations whenever possible to guarantee consistency and accountability throughout the implementation process.

What you bring:

Experience in Digital Health or SaaS: You bring 3–5 years of experience implementing SaaS or other health tech platforms, ideally with hospitals, health systems, or specialty practices. Exposure to EMR integrations and interoperability standards (HL7, FHIR, etc.) is a plus.

Project Management Skills: You have a strong track record of managing multiple implementation projects simultaneously, with an emphasis on delivering on schedule with a high degree of client satisfaction. You are proficient with project management platforms such as Monday.com and have hands-on experience using AI tools to automate routine tasks, streamline workflows, and make implementation delivery more efficient and scalable.

Organization and Prioritization: You are highly organized, detail-oriented, and skilled at prioritizing competing demands across several clients and workstreams at once.

Confident Communicator and Presenter: You are comfortable with public speaking and leading training for groups of end users, both virtually and in person. You have a strong presence and can command attention and drive action from client stakeholders at all levels.

Adaptability: Ability to adapt and operate in complex environments while successfully managing simultaneous projects.

Why Force

At Force Therapeutics, we’re reshaping the future of remote therapeutic care. Our trailblazing platform, backed by insights from over 70 leading healthcare centers and millions of clinically-validated patient data points, not only intelligently extends clinicians' reach but also engages patients at every pivotal moment of their care journey, from surgery scheduling to recovery. Serving 700,000 patients across hundreds of national facilities and validated by 145 studies, our impact resonates in both clinical and financial spheres. As we edge closer to a transformative phase of explosive growth, we're seeking dynamic team members to join our journey.

At Force Therapeutics, the well-being and growth of our team members comes first. Our robust benefits package reflects this commitment, ensuring that every aspect of our employees' professional and personal lives is supported:

  • Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance: Comprehensive coverage to ensure you and your family's health needs are always met.
  • 401k Retirement Planning: To set you up for long-term financial security with a company match.
  • Pre-tax Commuter Benefits: Pre-tax option towards parking and transportation to help you get around town.
  • Generous PTO: Ample vacation time, unlimited safe and sick time, volunteer time off, and extra holidays, so that you take the time you need.
  • Summer Fridays: A nod to work-life balance, ensuring you get the most out of those sunny summer days.
  • Remote-Friendly Workplace: We believe doing your best work means providing the flexibility to do that work in the environment where you feel most productive.

Pay Transparency Notice

At Force Therapeutics, we prioritize transparency and fairness in all aspects of our business, including the way in which we compensate our people. To ensure that all candidates and employees understand our compensation structure, we provide clarity on pay ranges for each role. Our intention is to provide equal opportunities, eliminate pay gaps, and maintain competitive salaries benchmarked against industry standards.

The base salary range for this role is : $105,000 - $115,000 per annum*

*Salaries are determined based on qualifications, experience, and other relevant factors. Adjustments may be made to accommodate local market conditions and geographic cost-of-living differences.

Equal Employment Opportunity at Force

Force Therapeutics values diversity and is committed to creating an inclusive environment for all team members. We base all employment decisions on merit, qualifications, and business needs, without regard to race, color, religion, belief, national or social origin, sex, age, physical or sensory disability, HIV status, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, marital status, military service, or any other protected status. We proudly encourage candidates of diverse backgrounds and experiences to apply.

Disclaimer for Job Postings

Our company only posts job openings on our official website and LinkedIn. We do not use social media platforms or personal messaging apps for job postings. Legitimate communication from our company will come from official email addresses associated with our domain (forcetherapeutics.com). If you encounter what you suspect to be a fraudulent job posting or communication claiming to be from our company, please report it to us immediately via .

“Mineralys Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on developing medicines to target hypertension and related comorbidities such as chronic kidney disease (CKD), obstructive sleep apnea (OSA) and other diseases driven by dysregulated aldosterone. Its initial product candidate, lorundrostat, is a proprietary, orally administered, highly selective aldosterone synthase inhibitor. Mineralys is headquartered in Radnor, Pennsylvania. For more information, please visit Follow Mineralys on LinkedIn, Twitter and Bluesky”

Mineralys is a fully remote company.

Regional Sales Director

The Regional Sales Director (RSD) will play a critical role in the successful launch and growth of Mineralys’ first commercial product within an assigned region. This leader will be accountable for translating national strategy into regional execution, driving business performance through strong field leadership, cross-functional partnership, and disciplined execution against launch objectives.

The RSD will build and lead a high-performing team of territory managers, foster deep customer relationships, and ensure alignment with corporate priorities, compliance standards, and Mineralys’ values. This is a highly visible field leadership role requiring strong business acumen, launch experience, and the ability to lead with urgency in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment.

Key Responsibilities

Commercial Leadership / Launch Execution

  • Lead all regional launch planning and execution activities to ensure successful market entry and sustained product uptake
  • Translate national brand strategy into actionable regional business plans and field execution priorities
  • Lead team to achieve or exceed sales goals, market share targets, and key performance metrics at launch and beyond
  • Monitor market dynamics, customer feedback, and competitive intelligence to adjust strategy in real time
  • Drive accountability for performance through data-driven decision making and disciplined execution

Team Leadership / Coaching

  • Recruit, onboard, develop, and retain top-performing territory managers across the region
  • Lead, coach, and motivate a team of approximately 8–12 territory managers
  • Establish and maintain high level of disease state, clinical and product knowledge
  • Evaluate performance of territory managers and coach to skill and career development through regular field contact
  • Foster a high-performance culture focused on accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement
  • Build strong succession plans and talent pipelines

Customer / Market Engagement

  • Develop and maintain relationships with key healthcare providers, health systems, integrated delivery networks (IDNs) and strategic accounts
  • Partner with territory managers on key customer interactions, access challenges, and develop account strategies
  • Support pull-through with IDNs, organized customers, and priority accounts
  • timely and effectively sharing of customer insights with internal stakeholders

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner closely with Market Access, Marketing, Medical Affairs, Training, Operations, and HR to support launch readiness and execution
  • Provide field-driven input into brand planning, messaging, and tactical adjustments
  • Collaborate with Area Sales Directors and peers to share best practices and drive consistency across regions
  • Support national meetings, launch planning sessions, and field communications

Compliance / Operational Excellence

  • Ensure all regional activities are conducted in full compliance with company policies, industry regulations, and legal standards
  • Manage regional budgets and resources effectively
  • Maintain accurate forecasting, CRM utilization, and reporting discipline
  • Uphold Mineralys’ values of collaboration, integrity, quality, trust, and urgency

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree preferred
  • 8+ years of pharmaceutical / biotech sales experience
  • 3+ years of people leadership experience in a district / regional manager role
  • Proven success leading specialty sales teams and exceeding performance goals
  • Prior launch experience required; first-launch / startup biotech experience strongly preferred
  • Experience in cardiovascular, nephrology, hypertension, or related specialty markets strongly preferred
  • Demonstrated success in recruiting and developing top talent
  • Strong business planning, analytical, and coaching skills
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, highly collaborative environment
  • Willingness to travel extensively within region

Leadership Profile

  • A strong coach who develops people and builds winning teams
  • Highly accountable, with a bias for action and urgency
  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity and helping build infrastructure
  • Collaborative and able to influence across functions
  • Resilient, adaptable, and energized by launch environments

Travel

  • This position requires up to 60% travel. Frequently travel is outside the local area and overnight.

These positions are eligible for standard Company benefits including medical, dental, vision, time off and 401K, as well as participating in Mineralys incentive plans are contingent on achievement of personal and company performance. Actual compensation may vary from posted hiring range based on geographic location, work experience, education, and/or skill level.

US Salary Range: $180,000 - $215,000

This role helps partners follow Malbek delivery standards and provides the tools, training, product guidance, and governance needed to implement and support Malbek’s Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) solutions.

Job Summary

This individual-contributor role works closely with the Partner Enablement Manager and cross-functional teams to improve partner adoption, implementation consistency, technical readiness, and customer delivery outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

Implementation Governance & Program Execution

  • Plan, track, and coordinate partner-led implementations, technical readiness activities, and enablement milestones.
  • Manage visibility across action items, risks, issues, dependencies, status updates, and escalation follow-through.
  • Maintain standard program artifacts, including trackers, RAID logs, readiness checklists, and playbook compliance tools.
  • Support reporting, steering committee preparation, readiness reviews, and governance discussions.Own the day-to-day partner oversight process, influencing successful delivery outcomes.

Partner Enablement & Readiness

  • Support partner onboarding, product training, methodology workshops, certification, and technical enablement.
  • Maintain playbooks, implementation guides, best practices, training content, and enablement artifacts across the partner portal and LMS.
  • Serve as a day-to-day partner contact and gather feedback to improve program structure, training, governance, and resources.

Technical Enablement & Solution Quality

  • Guide partners through Malbek CLM configuration, solution design, customer use cases, and implementation best practices.
  • Review partner configurations for alignment with Malbek standards and customer requirements.
  • Advise on workflow automation, approvals, data migration, integrations, AI-enabled capabilities, QA testing, and adoption-focused configuration.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Systems, Legal Studies, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Experience: 4–5 years in SaaS implementation, project coordination, partner programs, customer success, technical enablement, product training, or delivery operations.
  • Core skills: Experience with implementation plans, trackers, RAID logs, readiness checklists, status reporting, governance meetings, escalations, configuration reviews, and partner enablement activities.
  • Technical aptitude: Ability to learn enterprise software configuration, translate requirements into practical guidance, and troubleshoot functional or technical delivery questions.
  • Preferred exposure: CLM processes, workflow design, SaaS configuration, data migration, integrations, APIs, reporting, AI-enabled capabilities, partner portals, LMS platforms, CRM systems, or partner ecosystems.
  • Communication and work style: Strong documentation, communication, presentation, training, facilitation, analytical, and problem-solving skills; able to work independently in a fast-paced, remote-first environment; ability to build strong relationships and trust; able to influence without direct authority.
  • Work authorization and travel: Must be authorized to work full-time in the United States. Malbek does not provide visa sponsorship for this position. Ability to travel up to 15%, primarily domestic.

About Us:

BW Converting is a strategic alliance of resources and services that bring together several Barry-Wehmiller companies — Paper Converting Machine Company (PCMC), Winkler + Dünnebier (W+D), STAX Technologies, Hudson-Sharp, Baldwin Technologies and Northern Engraving and Machine. These industry leaders offer trusted brands and innovative technologies in the design, manufacture, and service of high-performance converting and packaging machinery for the tissue, nonwovens, hygiene, bag-converting, mailing, and printing industries.Barry-Wehmiller is a diversified global supplier of engineering consulting and manufacturing technology for the packaging, corrugating, sheeting and paper-converting industries. By blending people-centric leadership with disciplined operational strategies and purpose-driven growth, Barry-Wehmiller has become a $3 billion organization with nearly 12,000 team members united by a common belief: to use the power of business to build a better world.

Job Description:

The Customer Support Technicianwill utilize technical knowledge and controls expertise to independently support one product line at a high level and provide basic support for 1-2 additional product lines by resolving customer issues, testing new technology, and assisting in the development of proactive services. This dual role position serves as both the primary customer service representative and technical service representative for all incoming second shift requests, working independently with minimal supervision.


Schedule: 3:30PM – 12:30AM Sunday through Thursday.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for all incoming customer requests during second shift, triaging calls appropriately-routing parts inquiries to the parts department, escalating issues to the next shift when necessary, or providing direct technical support as the situation requires.
  • Communicate with customers from a technical perspective to understand and resolve equipment issues.
  • Respond with urgency to resolve unplanned customer issues, including providing breakdown support for component replacements (loading HMIs, drives, PLCs) as necessary.
  • Provide support for “on the go” programming changes with minimal supervision
  • VPN into customer machines remotely to troubleshoot PLCs, drives and devices during second shift hours
  • Document customer issues and resolutions in the asset management system to develop equipment history files for future troubleshooting and support.
  • Utilize ERP system to find parts and arrange shipment to customer outside normal business hours
  • Utilize technical skills and expertise in controls and processes to support the team and customers.
  • Review customer data routinely and react to alarms, investigate customer downtime, develop insights and provide actions for customers for improved productivity and efficiency.
  • Identify continuous improvement opportunities to increase overall effectiveness and support proactive and measurable process improvement results to ensure consistency and standardization of best practices and tools.
  • Proactively communicate with product line engineering team by recommending machine changes and bringing forward the voice of the customer.
  • Engage in the evaluation, implementation, and testing of new technology
  • Create and sustain an environment of safety.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE:

  • A two-year associate degree in electro-mechanical, electrical design, or a related field and five years of machine troubleshooting experience, or a high school diploma and seven years of machine troubleshooting experience.
  • Expert in controls and machine processes for print equipment.
  • Knowledge or skills on flexographic printing presses is a plus but not a requirement

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, ABILITIES:

  • Proficient in Rockwell and Indramat software
  • Knowledgeable Rockwell and Indramat hardware
  • Strong technical and troubleshooting skill set with the ability to diagnose and resolve issues independently
  • Excellent customer service skills with the ability to manage multiple types of inquiries and prioritize effectively
  • Self-motivated with strong decision-making capabilities
  • Proficient in mechanical, pneumatic and control systems.
  • Ability to travel several weeks per year to customer sites and the main factory for training

COMPETENCIES:

  • Customer Focus – Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.
  • Instills Trust – Gaining the confidence and trust of others through honesty, integrity, and authenticity.
  • Drives Results - Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.
  • Communicates Effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.
  • Optimizes Work Processes - Knowing the most effective and efficient processes to get things done, with a focus on continuous improvement.
  • Collaborates – Building partnerships and collaborating with others to meet shared objectives.
  • Ensures Accountability - Holding self and others accountable to meet commitments.

LEADERSHIP RESPONSIBILITY:

This position does not directly lead other team members.

WORK ENVIRONMENT/PHYSICAL DEMANDS:

  • Bend, squat, climb, grasp, reach, lift or otherwise move about frequently and for extended periods of time
  • Lift, move or otherwise transfer up to 50 lbs. frequently, or more occasionally
  • Walk, stand or otherwise move about continuously
  • Exposure to typical machine shop physical hazards which may require respiratory protection
  • Typically sits, grasps items and performs keyboarding for occasional operation of a computer
  • Occasionally travel by car or air
  • Position is fully remote with occasional travel requirements
  • Second shift schedule with ability to train on first shift as required

Compensation

The approximate pay range for this position is $36 - $45 per hour. Please note that the pay range is a good faith estimate at the time of posting and may vary based on factors such as experience, skills, and geographic location.

Data Processing Engineer - I/O

Mountain View, CA / Hyderabad, IN / Remote

About DataPelago:

DataPelago is at the forefront of revolutionizing data processing for traditional analytics and cutting-edge GenAI preprocessing. We are building an innovative data processing engine that is transforming how Apache Spark, Apache Flink, Ray and others operate on diverse, large-scale data. Our team of engineers drive and adopt advances in hardware-accelerated computing, parallel processing of large-scale data, query optimization, distributed systems, compilers, machine learning, and cloud-native computing. We are looking for specialists to join our engineering team and shape the future of accelerated data processing.

The Opportunity:

As a Data Processing Engineer - I/O, you will be a key individual contributor in advancing data
read and write capabilities of DataPelago’s data processing engine. You will enhance functional
breadth, performance, scale, and reliability of the DataPelago engine in reading and writing large scale data of various data types from diverse data sources and data sinks. This is a unique opportunity to make a significant impact on a category-defining product and work with a talented team of engineers.

What You'll Do:

  • Architect: Influence the architecture of how our data processing engine interfaces with data
    sources and sinks, catalogs, data formats.
    • Design: Lead design of functional and performance enhancements to adapters/connectors,
    data representations, data filtering, caching and more in our data processing engine.
  • Core Development: Individually design, implement, test, optimize, and maintain components of the data processing engine.
  • Innovation and Differentiation: Analyze technology roadmap of existing and emerging data
    formats and libraries, open table formats, catalog services, and more (e.g., Apache Arrow,

WHY JOIN FCS

At Florida Cancer Specialists & Research Institute, we believe our people are our strength and we invest in them. In addition to having a positive impact on the people and communities we serve, associates benefit from significant professional opportunities, career advancement, training and competitive wages.

Offering competitive salaries and comprehensive benefits packages to include tuition reimbursement, 401-K match, pet and legal insurance.

A LITTLE BIT ABOUT FCS

Since 1984, Florida Cancer Specialists & Research Institute & Research Institute (FCS) has built a national reputation for excellence. With over 250 physicians, 220 nurse practitioners and physician assistants and nearly 100 locations in our network. Utilizing innovative clinical research, cutting-edge technologies, and advanced treatments, we are committed to providing world-class cancer care. We are recognized by the American Society of Clinical Oncology (ASCO) with a national Clinical Trials Participation Award, FCS offers patients access to more clinical trials than any private oncology practice in Florida. Our patients have access to ground-breaking therapies, in a community setting, and may participate in national clinical research studies of drugs and treatment protocols. In the past five years, the majority of new cancer drugs approved for use in the U.S. were studied in clinical trials with FCS participation prior to approval.

Through our partnership with Sarah Cannon, we are one of the largest clinical research organizations in the United States. Often, FCS leads the nation in initiating research studies and offering ground-breaking new therapies to patients.

Come join us today!

PRIMARY TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Budget & Forecasting Leadership
    • Serve as the finance subject matter expert for budgeting and forecasting for FCS at a consolidated level, with clear ownership of consolidated results, PDP, gross margin, and adjusted operating profit.
    • Own the models and analytical frameworks for building budgets & forecasts.
    • Develop and refine transparent, repeatable reporting and models that explain performance drivers and support executive understanding of changes over time.
  • Executive Reporting and Decision Support
    • Deliver concise, executive-ready reporting packages that summarize performance, explain results, and highlight risks and opportunities.
    • Build “so what” insights that help leadership understand what is changing, why it matters, and what actions may improve outcomes.
    • Tailor analyses for different leadership audiences.
  • Analytical and Strategic Support
    • Support the full range of analytical, reporting, and strategic needs for FCS.
    • Contribute to strategic planning efforts and leadership requests.
    • Help prioritize opportunities to improve financial performance and strengthen visibility into key business drivers.
  • Reporting Automation, Data Quality, and Governance
    • Build and enhance repeatable reporting tools and dashboards that provide timely and accurate performance visibility.
    • Improve efficiency through automation, standardized reporting logic, and disciplined data governance.
    • Ensure outputs are auditable, scalable, and easy for stakeholders to interpret.
  • Continuous Improvement and Cross-Functional Collaboration
    • Partner across finance, operations, and practice leadership to identify opportunities for process improvement and stronger performance management
    • Recommend enhancements to tools, reporting routines, and analytics approaches that improve visibility, alignment, and decision support over time.

EDUCATION/CERTIFICATIONS & LICENSES:

  • Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree (MBA, MS or similar) in finance, analytics or related field preferred.
  • CPA or CFA a plus

EXPERIENCE:

  • 8+ years of progressive experience in FP&A, financial modeling, or analytics, with a demonstrated track record of leading complex forecasting and budgeting initiatives in a large, matrixed organization.
  • Experience collaborating with C-suite executives & across multiple functions to affect solutions.
  • Excellent financial modeling & problem-solving skills.
  • Executive presence and experience with presentations to various leadership levels.
  • Ability to provide strategic recommendations and influence stakeholders to make decisions.

CORE COMPETENCIES, KNOWLEDGE/SKILLS/ABILITIES:

  • Deep expertise in advanced analytics, statistical modeling, and AI/ML applications for forecasting. Mastery of Excel, Sigma/Power BI/Tableau, and financial systems (e.g., Workday, SAP, Oracle, Hyperion).
  • Financial systems experience with ability to reconcile information from multiple sources.
  • Motivated self-starter that is well organized, dependable, efficient and results-oriented.
  • Strong time management and organization skills with flexibility to work in a fast-paced and changing work environment.
  • Prior leadership experience a plus.

VALUES:

  • Patient First – Keeping the patient at the center of everything we do
  • Accountability – Taking responsibility for our actions
  • Commitment & Care – Upholding FCS vision through every action
  • Team – Working together, one team, one mission

Expectations for all Employees

Every FCS employee is expected to regularly conduct themselves in a professional and respectful manner, to comply with all labor laws, workplace policy and workplace practices. Employees are expected to bring issues of any forms of workplace harassment, discrimination or other potential improprieties to the attention of their management or the human resources department.


#FCS-FIN


SCREENINGS – Background and drug screens

Safeguarding our patients and each other is an important part of how we deliver the best care possible to the communities we serve. All offers of employment at Florida Cancer Specialists & Research Institute are contingent upon clear results of a thorough background screening. Additionally, as a condition of employment, FCS requires all new hires to receive various vaccinations, including the influenza vaccine, barring an approved exemption. In addition, FCS is a drug-free workplace, and all new hires will be subject to drug testing. Medical Marijuana cards are not recognized.

Note: We’re thrilled by the interest in this role! To help our team manage the volume of applications, we kindly ask that you avoid calling or emailing to check on your status. We’ll be sure to reach out if you’re selected to move forward.

About Transgender Law Center

Transgender Law Center (TLC) is the largest national, trans-led organization working to set all people free. We champion the rights of all transgender and gender-nonconforming people to make their own choices and live freely, safely, and authentically. Prioritizing BIPOC, disabled, and HIV+ communities, we advance community-driven strategies that harness trans knowledge, power, and joy to ensure that we all not only survive but thrive at all ages and phases of life.

You can learn more about our work at .

About the Position

This position is within TLC’s litigation team and will focus on investigating, developing and litigating cases on behalf of trans and gender-nonconforming people.

Key Responsibilities

  • Investigate and develop potential new cases, including corresponding with and meeting with potential clients, conducting research, finding and reviewing records, and drafting demand letters.
  • Develop litigation strategy, manage relationships with co-counsel, perform legal research, and draft or edit briefs.
  • Assume responsibility for all stages of litigation, including motion practice, discovery, trial, appeals, settlement negotiations, and settlement monitoring.
  • As needed, join and support existing teams working on previously-filed litigation.
  • When necessary, support TLC’s legal services project, including reviewing inquiries, researching local and state laws, policies, and procedures, and crafting responses with personalized legal information.
  • Engage in direct advocacy on behalf of criminalized people by, for instance, calling or sending advocacy letters to public defenders or prison officials, and identifying other creative solutions.
  • Develop and draft written resources including know-your-rights material and sample legal documents.
  • Engage in education efforts for community members and attorneys, including speaking at conferences, trainings, and webinars.
  • Participate in organization-wide activities and shared responsibilities that support team alignment and culture.
  • Support the work of the legal team and the organization generally.
  • Other duties as assigned.

The position is full time and may include travel and occasional work at nights and on weekends.

Qualifications & Requirements

  • Membership in the bar of one or more states.
  • Must have at least two to four years of post-graduation experience practicing law in the areas of civil rights litigation, criminal defense, immigration, or legal aid.
  • Experience working with pro-bono attorneys preferred.
  • Experience with legal or policy advocacy relating to incarceration, criminalization or law enforcement.
  • Familiarity with transgender and gender nonconforming communities.
  • Experience working with communities of color and transgender communities.
  • Deep understanding of intersecting oppressions including anti-Blackness, white supremacy, transphobia, ableism, misogyny, colonialism, and capitalism.
  • Strong writing, editing, and legal research skills and experience with public speaking.
  • Skill at working collaboratively both within the organization and with other groups.
  • Strong personal organization and time management skills.
  • Creativity and good judgment.
  • Enthusiasm for the work of the organization and its potential.
  • Willingness to travel and to work long hours when necessary.

Benefits

  • Medical/dental/vision (TLC covers 100% of premiums for employees, 80% for dependents)
  • Employer-funded Health Reimbursement Account (currently $3,500 per year)
  • Employer-funded Lifestyle Spending Account (currently $1,500 per year)
  • Optional employee-funded Flexible Spending Account
  • Employee Assistance Fund that can grant financial assistance for certain qualifying disasters and personal hardships
  • Short-term and long-term disability insurance
  • 3 weeks’ sick leave
  • 19 days’ vacation (24 after 3 years’ employment) and 12 holidays
  • Organizational ‘slowdown’ in winter and summer, including, historically, 2 weeks paid time off in the summer and 2 weeks paid time off at the end of the year (separate from employee vacation time)
  • 2-month paid sabbatical program available after 5 years of employment
  • Retirement plan with partial organizational matching
  • Indemnity insurance for critical illness, hospital confinement, and accidents
  • Professional development & coaching
  • Office setup, phone and internet reimbursement (if working from home)
  • Additional mental health, budgeting, travel, and pet benefits

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

All interested individuals, including Black, Indigenous, and other people of color; women and femmes; people with disabilities; and people who are transgender, intersex, lesbian, gay, bisexual, or queer are particularly urged to apply. raw.excerpt: We are looking for a Senior QA Automation Engineer to drive quality engineering practices across a next-generation Workforce Management (WFM) and Customer Experience (CX) platform.
raw.description:
We are looking for a Senior QA Automation Engineer to drive quality engineering practices across a next-generation Workforce Management (WFM) and Customer Experience (CX) platform. You will own test automation across the full test pyramid (unit, component, integration, contract, end-to-end, and performance), with a strong focus on component and integration testing of cloud-native applications and microservices. You will build and maintain automated test frameworks using JUnit and Playwright or Cypress, ensuring the reliability, performance, and scalability of the platform. The role involves close collaboration with software engineers, architects, product teams, and domain experts across Workforce Management, including forecasting and schedule generation and optimization. The ideal candidate combines strong test automation expertise with a quality-first mindset and the ability to influence engineering practices across the development lifecycle.

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain automated test frameworks using Playwright and/or Cypress, JUnit, and modern test automation practices.
  • Build and execute automated test suites at every level: unit (JUnit), component, integration, contract, API, end-to-end, and regression.
  • Own component and integration testing of microservices, validating service behavior, data flows, and API contracts both in isolation and across service boundaries (e.g., using Testcontainers, WireMock, or Pact).
  • Design and run performance and load tests to validate scalability, throughput, and response times under peak contact-center volumes.
  • Design and automate test scenarios for Workforce Management functionality, including forecasting, schedule generation, and scheduling rules and constraints.
  • Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and quality gates.
  • Collaborate with developers, architects, product managers, and business stakeholders to define acceptance criteria and quality standards.
  • Analyze defects, identify root causes, and drive quality improvements across the SDLC.
  • Establish quality engineering standards, reusable automation assets, and test strategies across multiple product streams.
  • 6+ years of QA Automation experience.
  • Proven experience designing component and integration test suites for Java microservices (e.g., Spring Boot Test, Testcontainers, WireMock, REST Assured);
  • Strong hands-on experience with Playwright and/or Cypress using TypeScript or JavaScript.
  • Experience with contract testing (e.g., Pact, Spring Cloud Contract).
  • Experience with performance and load testing tools and practices (e.g., JMeter, Gatling, k6).
  • Experience testing REST APIs, microservices, and distributed systems.
  • Experience testing WFM forecasting and scheduling engines or other complex rule-based business systems, e.g., validating forecast outputs against historical volume and handle-time data, staffing calculations against service-level targets, and generated schedules against labor rules, shift patterns, breaks, and skills.
  • Experience integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and quality gates.
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Contact Center, CX, CCaaS, Routing, or Voice platforms.
  • Understanding of telephony, IVR, call flows, agent routing, and customer interaction systems.

We offer:

  • Culture of relentless performance: join an unstoppable technology development team with a 99% project success rate and more than 30% year-over-year revenue growth.
  • Competitive pay and benefits: enjoy a comprehensive compensation and benefits package, including health insurance, language courses, and a relocation program.
  • ForeverRemote work culture: make the most of the flexibility that comes with remote work.
  • Growth mindset: reap the benefits of a range of professional development opportunities, including certification programs, mentorship and talent investment programs, internal mobility and internship opportunities.
  • Global impact: collaborate on impactful projects for top global clients and shape the future of industries.
  • Welcoming multicultural environment: be a part of a dynamic, global team and thrive in an inclusive and supportive work environment with open communication and regular team-building company social events.
  • Social sustainability values: join our sustainable business practices focused on five pillars, including IT education, community empowerment, fair operating practices, environmental sustainability, and gender equality.

* Miratech is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other protected status under applicable law.

Miratech helps visionaries change the world. We are a global IT services and consulting company that brings together enterprise and start-up innovation. Today, we support digital transformation for some of the world's largest enterprises. By partnering with both large and small players, we stay at the leading edge of technology, remain nimble even as a global leader, and create technology that helps our clients further enhance their business. We are a values-driven organization and our culture of Relentless Performance has enabled over 99% of Miratech's engagements to succeed by meeting or exceeding our scope, schedule, and/or budget objectives since our inception in 1989.
Miratech has coverage across 5 continents and operates in over 25 countries around the world. Miratech retains nearly 1000 full-time professionals, and our annual growth rate exceeds 25%.

raw.title: SEA Manager (f,m,x) - remote
raw.excerpt: Founded in 2017, refurbed is Europe’s fastest-growing marketplace for refurbished products, active in 23 European countries and having surpassed €2Bn in GMV — all while being profitable.
raw.description:
Founded in 2017, refurbed is Europe’s fastest-growing marketplace for refurbished products, active in 23 European countries and having surpassed €2Bn in GMV — all while being profitable. With beautiful headquarters in Vienna, we operate as a remote-first company and have been recognised as a Top DACH Employer by Kununu for four consecutive years.

Our mission is to make sustainable consumption the easy choice by enabling customers to buy products up to 40% cheaper while significantly reducing CO₂ emissions.

If you thrive in an environment that values momentum, ownership, and impact, you’ll feel at home here. We’re a fast-paced, high-performance team that works hard and challenges itself everyday. To enable this high-performance every team member enjoys full autonomy over their location (we’re remote-first).

Paid search is one of refurbed’s largest growth levers, with a high eight-figure annual budget across 23+ European markets. For our SEA team we are looking for an SEA Manager (f/m/x) to own Google Ads and Shopping for a portfolio of country accounts, and to help us grow in new categories beyond consumer electronics, such as home appliances and e-bikes.

You will report to the SEA Team Lead and work closely with our Markets team, Category Marketing and Supply.

WHO YOU ARE

  • You have 2–5+ years of hands-on experience in Google Ads (Performance Max, Shopping, Search and DemandGen), ideally in-house at an e-commerce or retail business. Other search engines are a plus.
  • You have relevant certifications in Google’s Skillshop.
  • You worked with feeds before such as GMC custom labels, feed rules, disapprovals and tools such as Channable, Productsup or similar.
  • You have confident, hands-on proficiency in Google Analytics, Ads Editor and Business Intelligence tools such as Looker studio/Tableau. SQL knowledge is a plus.
  • You’re curious, enjoy testing new approaches (e.g. automations, scripts, new ad formats) and stay on top of Google’s product updates.
  • You are strong with data. Spreadsheets are part of your daily work, and you want to understand what the data tells you as well as its limits.
  • You solve problems from first principles. When a campaign underperforms, you find out why before you change settings.
  • You use AI tools and automation to work faster but you check the output, implement feedback loops, and work to automate repetitive tasks.
  • You are confident with stakeholders and a strong communicator. You can explain results clearly to market, category and supply colleagues.
  • Your English is fluent. Another European language is highly desirable.

Location & eligibility: This role is open to candidates based in Europe (including UK) only with a valid right to work.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Own SEA and Shopping for a portfolio of country accounts: campaign structure, feeds, bidding and budgets, in line with market goals and our incrementality measurements.
  • Be the go-to partner for your markets’ teams on paid search priorities, local search trends and competitors.
  • Support the SEA Team Lead on multi-category: build growth cases and test plans with Category Marketing, and turn learnings into set-ups, playbooks and reporting the whole team can use.
  • Roll out category changes in your own accounts and help colleagues roll them out in theirs.
  • Build performance reporting for our Supply team and brand partners.
  • Cover colleagues’ accounts during absences, using shared runbooks, alerting and quality checks.
  • Automate repetitive set-up and reporting so new categories and markets do not mean more manual work.
  • Share your learnings with the team and contribute to our test roadmap.
  • Work with Google and Microsoft partner teams on new formats and betas.

WHY YOU WILL ENJOY WORKING WITH US:

Our Culture and Values:

  • Decisions should be made based on facts and not by hierarchy levels? We sure think so!
  • We embrace giving and receiving feedback, testing and welcoming new ideas, as well as sharing our knowledge across the company.
  • You fail sometimes? Well, so do we! We’re all just human, let’s learn from our mistakes to improve in the future!
  • No matter who you love, where you’re from, who you pray to, whether you pee sitting down or standing up – we are a bunch of talented people who enjoy spending our time making a difference!

Personal & Professional Development:

  • You'll have access to a dedicated learning budget within your department to support your growth, whether it's courses, conferences, or other learning opportunities that matter to you.
  • We partner with Likeminded, offering you private sessions with experts for your personal growth and mental health.
  • We frequently host internal workshops, allowing our teams to further develop their skills in different areas and enhancing collaboration across departments.

Flexibility:

  • We care about a healthy work/life balance. We not only function and support a fully remote setting but also offer the possibility to work from our beautiful office in the vibrant heart of Vienna – we love dogs, so feel free to bring your furry little buddy too 😊
  • We trust you to do the best job, so we don't care so much when you do it – you are able to self-organize.
  • You will also be invited to take part in our office weeks, happening three times a year, where you will have the chance to work side by side with your colleagues and enjoy the team-building events and on-site workshops

…and much more! See for further insights!

raw.excerpt: Job SummaryMedline is seeking a Senior Director of Medical Affairs to lead the medical and scientific strategy supporting the safe, effective, and appropriate use of our products.
raw.description:
Job Summary

Medline is seeking a Senior Director of Medical Affairs to lead the medical and scientific strategy supporting the safe, effective, and appropriate use of our products.

This highly visible leader will shape the future of our Medical Affairs organization, lead Medical Science Liaison teams, and guide clinical evidence generation, scientific communications, clinician education, and medical safety. Working across product divisions and enterprise functions, you will translate clinical insights into decisions that support innovation, patient safety, and business priorities.

Job Description

What You’ll Do

Lead Medical Affairs strategy and evidence generation

  • Develop and execute an enterprise Medical Affairs strategy aligned with product, division, and long-term business priorities.
  • Provide medical leadership throughout the product life cycle, from clinical development and study design through launch, post-market research, and evidence dissemination.
  • Identify evidence gaps and oversee clinical research, outcomes research, real-world evidence, investigator-initiated research, and post-market clinical activities.
  • Translate clinical data and stakeholder insights into recommendations for product development, innovation, and risk management.

Build clinical partnerships and lead scientific exchange

  • Develop relationships with clinicians, investigators, key opinion leaders (KOLs), professional societies, healthcare organizations, and academic institutions.
  • Build and manage KOL networks and clinical and scientific advisory boards.
  • Represent Medline at medical congresses, symposia, customer engagements, and clinician education programs.
  • Ensure scientific exchange and responses to medical information requests are balanced, evidence-based, and compliant with applicable requirements.

Oversee medical safety and compliance

  • Provide leadership for medical safety, vigilance, pharmacovigilance where applicable, benefit-risk assessments, and safety signal evaluation.
  • Guide Medical Affairs input into complaint handling, post-market surveillance, Health Hazard Evaluations, and Health Risk Assessments.
  • Establish policies, procedures, training, and controls that support compliant Medical Affairs activities.
  • Oversee medical review of grants and promotional, educational, and scientific materials.

Guide scientific communications and education

  • Set publication strategy and oversee manuscripts, abstracts, posters, white papers, evidence summaries, and other scientific content.
  • Lead internal and external education on Medline products and their supporting clinical evidence.
  • Chair the Scientific Review Committee and participate in product advisory boards and independent medical education grant committees.

Lead across the organization

  • Serve as the senior Medical Affairs partner to Quality, Regulatory, R&D, Clinical, Commercial, Legal, and Compliance.
  • Provide independent medical and scientific judgment on product development, labeling, regulatory submissions, safety, and commercialization.
  • Lead cross-functional teams through complex medical, scientific, and business issues while maintaining scientific independence.
  • Lead and develop Medical Science Liaison teams; define organizational structure, staffing, capabilities, and succession plans.

Required Qualifications

Education and industry experience — one of the following:

  • Bachelor’s degree in nursing or a related clinical, scientific, or technical field, plus at least 10 years of medical, scientific, or technical experience in the medical device, biotechnology, or pharmaceutical industry.
  • Master’s degree in a clinical, scientific, technical, public health, or related discipline, plus at least 8 years of relevant industry experience.
  • MD, DO, PhD, or equivalent doctoral degree, plus at least 5 years of relevant industry experience.

Additional requirements:

  • At least 5 years of direct people-management experience, including hiring, developing, and leading employees and leaders.
  • Experience in clinical and scientific writing, peer-reviewed publications, and interpreting and communicating complex clinical data.
  • Experience supporting product planning, development, publication strategy, scientific materials, and product launches.
  • Expertise in Medical Affairs strategy, medical device evidence generation, clinical research, medical safety, and scientific communications.
  • Strong understanding of U.S. regulatory and compliance requirements governing Medical Affairs and interactions with healthcare professionals.
  • Demonstrated ability to build clinical partnerships, lead cross-functional teams, and communicate effectively with executive, clinical, technical, and customer audiences.
  • Strong strategic planning, business acumen, budget management, and organizational leadership skills.
  • Commitment to scientific rigor, integrity, accountability, and patient safety.
  • Ability and willingness to travel domestically and internationally.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in a relevant discipline with at least 10 years of relevant industry experience, or an MD, DO, PhD, or equivalent doctoral degree with at least 7 years of relevant industry experience.
  • Senior Medical Affairs leadership experience in the medical device industry.
  • Experience overseeing medical safety, vigilance, grants, promotional review, clinician education, scientific communications, and clinical evidence development.
  • Established relationships with KOLs, investigators, professional societies, and healthcare organizations.
  • Experience building advisory boards and representing an organization at major medical and scientific conferences.
  • Success building or transforming a Medical Affairs organization and scaling compliant processes across a complex enterprise.
  • Medical Affairs Competency Certificate or comparable credential; active or previously active professional licensure or clinical credential.
